Title: Data-analist
Description:
Your mission




You’ll join a team that is in the process of further building the organization’s data capabilities. Together with your team of 4, you will work on developing and improving dashboards and data solutions used across different departments, such as logistics, finance, and HR.




In this role, you won’t just focus on building dashboards in Power BI. A big part of your work will involve understanding and preparing data. You’ll investigate where data comes from, how it is structured, and how it can be transformed into insights the business can actually use. To do this, you’ll work closely with stakeholders and the IT department to ensure the right data is available and usable.




Why you should consider this opportunity

You work at the intersection of business and data, with direct impact on domains such as logistics, finance, and HR
Plenty of room to contribute ideas on how data can be used more effectively across the organization
Close interaction with stakeholders, allowing you to see how your work directly supports the business
An environment where the data function is still developing and where you can contribute to its growth




Organization

You will join an international organization within the logistics sector. The company combines years of experience in transportation and logistics services with an increasing focus on data and digitalization.




This is what is expected from you

Experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role (minimum 1.5 years)
Strong knowledge of SQL and Power BI
Experience with cloud environments (they are on Azure)
Strong communication skills and the ability to work with different stakeholders
A proactive mindset and willingness to think along with the business




In return for your hard work, you will receive

Salary between €3,470 and €4,500 based on full-time employment (40 hours)
25 vacation days
Solid pension scheme
Travel expense reimbursement
Hybrid working with three days per week in the office, with a company car provided for commuting to the office
Tailored learning and development budget for your professional growth

Title: Data-analist
Description:
De Organisatie




Qcompany is een kleine, persoonlijke boutique firm in data. Een hecht team van jonge, nieuwsgierige mensen die plezier hebben in hun werk en in elkaar. Wij geloven dat data niet draait om tools, maar om denken, begrijpen en vertalen. Daarom leiden we mensen op, begeleiden we ze intensief en helpen we hen groeien in een vakgebied dat steeds belangrijker wordt. Zie ons als de engineers van jouw carrière: wij helpen je bouwen, bijstellen en versnellen — met aandacht voor inhoud, werk-privébalans en duurzame groei.

De Opportunity




Werk je nu in een officefunctie? Werk je met Excel, rapportages, controles of analyses, maar merk je dat je méér wilt dan alleen uitvoeren? Dan is dit je kans om de stap naar data te maken — zonder dat je al een data-expert hoeft te zijn. Bij Qcompany word je opgeleid tot data-analist. Je leert hoe je data gebruikt om vragen te beantwoorden, patronen te herkennen en organisaties verder te helpen. Na een intensief opleidingstraject ga je aan de slag bij opdrachtgevers, met name binnen de overheid, semi-overheid en grotere organisaties in Nederland. Daar werk je op het snijvlak van business en IT: je vertaalt vragen naar inzichten die ertoe doen.

Verantwoordelijkheden




Als data-analist houd je je bezig met het begrijpen en structureren van informatie. Je werkt met data uit verschillende bronnen en helpt opdrachtgevers grip te krijgen op hun cijfers, processen en prestaties. Je leert vragen te stellen achter de vraag, inzichten te vertalen naar heldere analyses en deze begrijpelijk te presenteren aan collega’s en stakeholders.

Je werkt nooit alleen: je maakt onderdeel uit van het Qcompany-team en krijgt begeleiding, feedback en ruimte om te leren — zowel inhoudelijk als persoonlijk.

Kwalificaties




Je hebt minimaal hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en al enkele jaren ervaring in een officeomgeving, bijvoorbeeld binnen finance, banking, beleid, administratie of een ondersteunende IT-rol. Je werkt graag met cijfers, overzichten en informatie en bent niet bang voor Excel of vergelijkbare tools.

Belangrijker dan je technische kennis is je nieuwsgierigheid: je wilt begrijpen hoe dingen werken en hoe data kan helpen om betere beslissingen te nemen.

Competenties




Je denkt analytisch en gestructureerd, maar kunt ook uitleggen wat je doet. Je durft vragen te stellen, ook als iets nog niet duidelijk is. Je vindt het leuk om te leren, feedback te krijgen en steeds zelfstandiger te worden. Daarnaast pas je goed in een open, informele omgeving waar eerlijkheid, plezier en samenwerking centraal staan.

Wat we bieden




Bij Qcompany krijg je geen standaard baan, maar een ontwikkelpad. We investeren stevig in opleiding en training binnen onze vier datadomeinen en begeleiden je stap voor stap richting een rol die bij jou past. Je werkt aan afwisselende opdrachten bij maatschappelijke en inhoudelijk interessante organisaties, terwijl je onderdeel blijft van een vast, betrokken team.

We bieden een omgeving waarin je jezelf kunt zijn, waar ruimte is voor plezier en waar groei niet alleen gaat over sneller of meer, maar vooral over beter




Interesse?




Lijkt het je interessant om je zelf te ontwikkelen tot Data Specialist? Solliciteer dan nu hieronder en wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op!

Title: Data Analist / BI Specialist
HTML:
Als Data Analist / BI Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat organisaties hun data omzetten in waardevolle inzichten. Je analyseert complexe datasets, vertaalt deze naar heldere rapportages en dashboards en adviseert stakeholders over datagedreven beslissingen. Met moderne BI-tools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik maak je informatie toegankelijk en begrijpelijk. Daarmee help je onze klanten – zoals de Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en VGZ – om hun beleid en processen te verbeteren en toekomstgericht te sturen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Je hebt een passie voor data en ziet het als jouw missie om cijfers en informatie te vertalen naar verhalen die impact maken. Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kunt schakelen tussen business en techniek. Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s en stakeholders en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar data centraal staat.


Wat kan je van ons verwachten?

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS krijg je de kans om te werken aan uitdagende en innovatieve data- en BI-projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties. Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en bieden naast een inspirerende werkomgeving:

  • Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 6.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach;
  • Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events;
  • Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen;
  • Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels;
  • Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt.


Persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS geloven we dat leren de sleutel is tot succes. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar zit in ons DNA. Daarom investeren we continu in jouw groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot bijvoorbeeld Senior Data Analist, BI Architect of Data Platform Specialist. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s, krijgt toegang tot kennisplatforms en blijft altijd scherp op de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar onder andere leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Daarbij benadrukken wij dat gelijke kansen voor iedereen een belangrijk uitgangspunt zijn in onze selectie.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo‑ of wo‑opleiding in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar;
  • Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring in een Agile omgeving met het analyseren en interpreteren van data en het vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen;
  • Vaardig in het ontwerpen van dashboards en visualisaties die inzichten helder presenteren met tools zoals PowerBi, Qlik of Tableau;
  • Sterke kennis van en ervaring met SQL en/of Databricks voor analyseren van grote datasets;
  • Kennis van actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse, data-ethiek en relevante wet- en regelgeving;

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Over onze klant

Voor onze opdrachtgever, een gerenommeerd full-service advocatenkantoor met meerdere vestigingen in de Benelux, zijn wij op zoek naar een Data Analyst. Het kantoor telt enkele honderden advocaten, fiscalisten, notarissen en supportmedewerkers, maar voelt door de betrokken en ondernemende cultuur allerminst als een grote, logge organisatie.

Ga jij ervoor zorgen dat data uit uiteenlopende bronnen wordt samengebracht en zo wordt gevisualiseerd dat deze bruikbaar is voor betere operationele en strategische besluitvorming? Dan is dit voor jou een mooie kans.




Jouw rol

In deze rol werk je nauw samen met de juridische en ondersteunende afdelingen van onze opdrachtgever. Je stemt met afdelingsmanagers en de directie af welke informatiebehoefte er speelt en onderzoekt wat er op het gebied van data mogelijk is. Samen met interne specialisten en collega's van de commerciële afdeling bouw je mee aan een datawarehouse en aan rapportages en dashboards, zodat business en directie beter onderbouwde keuzes kunnen maken.




Je bent betrokken bij de volledige dataketen: van het operationaliseren van nieuwe dataproducten en prototypes tot stabiele, gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen. Ook help je collega's bij het interpreteren van de resultaten.




Taken en verantwoordelijken

De nadruk van je werk ligt op het inzichtelijk maken van data: deze visueel en begrijpelijk vertalen naar de business, presenteren in heldere dashboards en helpen interpreteren.

Samen met afdelingsmanagers breng je hun informatiebehoefte in kaart en help je bij het formuleren van KPI's
Je zet datavisualisatie in om data beter te laten begrijpen en interpreteren
Je ondersteunt collega's bij het duiden van resultaten en komt met concrete verbetervoorstellen
Je werkt prototypes en ideeën uit tot productieklare dashboards, datasets en datamodellen
Je bouwt en beheert Power BI-rapportages, inclusief het koppelen van bronnen, datamodellering, DAX, visualisatie, performance en rijniveaubeveiliging (RLS)
Je ontsluit en combineert data uit bronsystemen via het datawarehouse, met SQL en basiskennis van api's
Je beheert de bestaande rapportages: incidenten oplossen, wijzigingen doorvoeren, releases afstemmen
Je beantwoordt ad-hoc datavragen vanuit de juridische en ondersteunende afdelingen
Je signaleert kansen voor verbetering, zowel inhoudelijk als technisch, en doet daarvoor voorstellen




Jouw profiel

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld richting Data/BI, (Bedrijfs)informatica, Analytics of Business IT
2 of meer jaar ervaring in een reporting- of analyserol
Bekend met SQL en rapportage tools
Je haalt moeiteloos inzichten uit data, weet deze te duiden en vertaalt ze naar heldere visualisaties
Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig, leert graag bij en volgt ontwikkelingen op het gebied van tools en technologie op de voet
Verandering zie je als kans, en je neemt daarin zelf initiatief
Je bent een gewaardeerde sparringpartner voor je team en andere afdelingen, en signaleert actief waar behoefte aan informatie ligt
Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels vloeiend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk




Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Een afwisselende functie in een ambitieus en collegiaal team, met een salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, aangevuld met goede secundaire voorwaarden, zoals:

27 vakantiedagen en een ruim mobiliteitsplan
Telefoon, laptop en een thuiswerkvergoeding
Een goede pensioenregeling
Mogelijkheid tot bonus op basis van prestatieafspraken
Hybride werken, deels thuis en deels op kantoor

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst, Python & SQL - Energy Trading & Optimization, Amsterdam (Hybrid)

Our client is an Amsterdam based energy trading and optimization company on a mission to accelerate the energy transition. The company has grown to over 40 people, with a 12 person tech organization split across software, infrastructure, and data teams.




You'll join a 3 person data team (a Team Lead and two Data Engineers) as the team's 4th member and its first dedicated Data Analyst. You'll work in a fully AWS-based environment, primarily using Python and PostgreSQL, turning incoming market and forecasting data into insight that directly supports trading decisions. This is a long-term, end-to-end project: you'll take ownership of making the underlying data accurate, validated, and usable for the business, with room to grow into more responsibility as a medior analyst.




The role is a mix of analysis and engineering, roughly 75/25: validating and benchmarking incoming data from external providers (including meteorological and energy market data), extracting insights from time series data, building dashboards, and shaping the data pipelines that feed the business's forecasting and trading strategies.




Team

3 people including the lead: 1 Team Lead, 2 Data Engineers. This hire becomes the 4th.




Tech stack

Python, PostgreSQL, AWS (Timestream and DynamoDB experience a plus), Docker and a bit of

Kubernetes a nice to have.




What we're looking for

3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst.
Strong Python skills for data analysis.
Hands-on SQL experience, particularly PostgreSQL.
Experience working in a cloud environment, specifically AWS.
An affinity for data engineering, and comfort with a role that's roughly 75% analysis and 25% engineering.
A proactive self-starter who takes initiative and can work independently.
Knowledge of the energy market is a plus.




Hours and hybrid

Full time, 40 hours per week. 3 days per week in the Amsterdam office, Monday and Friday compulsory, third day flexible.




Salary & contract

55 – 60 K range depending on experience.




Package

Fully covered travel allowance (NS Traject Vrij).
Sports subscription (up to €200/year).
Udemy account plus additional learning budget on request.
Monthly social activities.
Pension contribution.




Interview Process

Phone screening, take home assessment (one week to complete), final interview with the Data Team.




Interested? Please contact me at j.vanbaalen@doghouse.nl

Je analyseert complexe datasets, vertaalt deze naar heldere rapportages en dashboards en adviseert stakeholders over datagedreven beslissingen. Met moderne BI-tools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik maak je informatie toegankelijk en begrijpelijk. Daarmee help je onze klanten – zoals de Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en VGZ – om hun beleid en processen te verbeteren en toekomstgericht te sturen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Je hebt een passie voor data en ziet het als jouw missie om cijfers en informatie te vertalen naar verhalen die impact maken. Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kunt schakelen tussen business en techniek. Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s en stakeholders en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar data centraal staat.


Wat kan je van ons verwachten?

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS krijg je de kans om te werken aan uitdagende en innovatieve data- en BI-projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties. Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en bieden naast een inspirerende werkomgeving:

  • Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 6.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach;
  • Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events;
  • Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen;
  • Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels;
  • Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt.


Persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS geloven we dat leren de sleutel is tot succes. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar zit in ons DNA. Daarom investeren we continu in jouw groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot bijvoorbeeld Senior Data Analist, BI Architect of Data Platform Specialist. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s, krijgt toegang tot kennisplatforms en blijft altijd scherp op de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar onder andere leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Daarbij benadrukken wij dat gelijke kansen voor iedereen een belangrijk uitgangspunt zijn in onze selectie.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo‑ of wo‑opleiding in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar;
  • Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring in een Agile omgeving met het analyseren en interpreteren van data en het vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen;
  • Vaardig in het ontwerpen van dashboards en visualisaties die inzichten helder presenteren met tools zoals PowerBi, Qlik of Tableau;
  • Sterke kennis van en ervaring met SQL en/of Databricks voor analyseren van grote datasets;
  • Kennis van actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse, data-ethiek en relevante wet- en regelgeving;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • AI-affiniteit is een pré.


Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS?

  • 15 keer Top Employer!
  • Uitstekend salaris;
  • Vrije keuze leaseauto;
  • € 5000,- opleidingsbudget;
  • Aantrekkelijke bonussen;
  • Veel sociale evenementen;
  • Uitdagende projecten;
  • Gevarieerde opdrachten;
  • Gerenommeerde klanten.


Heb je interesse?

Wij vinden het leuk om op ons hoofdkantoor of één van onze lokale vestigingen of online kennis te maken. Solliciteer via onderstaande button of neem voor meer informatie contact op met ons recruitment team via:

Title: Data Analyst Excel - Remote
Description:
Job Description

Job Title: Data Analyst Excel

Job Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Key Responsibilities


Conduct in-depth data analysis using Microsoft Excel to extract actionable insights and support decision-making across teams.
Collaborate with project stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into meaningful analyses.
Review, clean, and validate datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Develop clear, concise reports and visualizations to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities in complex datasets, contributing to strategic initiatives.
Document methodologies, results, and recommendations with meticulous attention to detail.
Contribute expertise to enhance data-driven decision-making processes within the customer's team.


Required Skills And Qualifications


Proven experience performing data analysis in a business environment using Microsoft Excel as the primary tool.
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in data processing and reporting.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate analytical findings.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams to drive business outcomes.
Solid understanding of Excel functions, formulas, and data visualization tools.
Proficiency in identifying data inconsistencies and implementing corrective measures.
Experience working in fast-paced, data-driven organizations.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting cross-functional teams with data insights to inform business strategy.
Background in presenting analytical outcomes to diverse audiences.
Familiarity with additional data analysis tools or business intelligence platforms.

Title: Business Data Analyst People Insights
Description:
Business Analyst People Insights, Risk & Compliance

Turn HR data into meaningful business decisions.

As our new Business Analyst People Insights, Risk & Compliance, you'll help shape the future of HR by transforming workforce data into actionable insights. Working at the intersection of people, technology and analytics, you'll improve HR processes, support data-driven decision-making and help drive innovation across our global organization.

About Ahold Delhaize

We’re Ahold Delhaize, one of the world’s largest food retail groups. Together with our seventeen strong local retail brands in Europe, the United States, and Indonesia, we share a passion for delivering great food, value and innovations. By bringing ideas to the table and acting on them, you help create a healthier tomorrow. Together, we make better choices accessible for millions of people every day.

Your new team

As Business Analyst People Insights, Risk &Compliance, you'll join our HR Tech, Data Innovation & Associate Experience team.

Our HR organization is the driving force behind our people strategy. We continuously evolve the way we work by combining technology, data and innovation to create better experiences for our associates worldwide. Collaboration, ownership and continuous learning are at the heart of everything we do.

Key focus areas of your role

In this role, you'll translate HR data into valuable insights while helping improve processes, technology and decision-making across the organization. Working closely with HR, Technology and business stakeholders, you'll ensure reliable reporting, strong data governance and continuous improvement.

You will:


Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports and workforce analytics that support strategic decision-making.
Gather business requirements and translate them into data-driven solutions.
Improve HR data quality, governance and reporting standards across systems.
Identify opportunities to simplify and optimize HR processes through analytics and automation.
Evaluate and support the implementation of new HR technologies and digital solutions.
Partner with stakeholders on change management activities to drive successful adoption.
Define, monitor and report on HR KPIs, ensuring continuous improvement through data insights.


What’s in it for you?

At Ahold Delhaize, we create a caring culture where you feel safe and supported. Being part of our family of brands comes with cross-cultural teamwork, international experience, and room to explore across brands and functions. Your curiosity drives what’s next!

We value your well-being, both at work and beyond. That’s why we offer benefits like flexible work options, well-being initiatives, sabbatical leave, and family care. This way, you can add something meaningful to our recipe. We enjoy connecting in our office and encourage you to spend at least three days a week here, based on a forty-hour work week.

Plus:


Attractive bonuses
A gross annual salary € 52,000 to € 60,000
A first-rate pension plan
45 vacation days per year
Travel expenses or an NS travel card
A laptop and smartphone
Hybrid working environment
International career and development opportunities


The ingredients you bring

Everyone brings their own unique flavour. We believe this role comes to life when you bring:


A Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Data Science, Information Technology or a related field.
Experience as a Business Analyst or in HR Technology, HR Analytics or People Insights.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex HR data into clear business insights.
Experience working with BI and reporting tools (Power BI/DAX is a plus).
Knowledge of HR data governance, risk management or compliance.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.


Beyond your experience, your curiosity, growth mindset, collaboration and drive for continuous improvement will help you thrive in this role.

Apply now!

Are you keen to join the People Insights, Risk & Compliance team? Even if you don’t tick all the boxes, but you still believe you have the personality and skills that make you a suitable candidate, we strongly encourage you to reach out to us. Apply now via the button on this page, or feel free to contact Damjan Bugarski, Talent Acquisition Partner via damjan.bugarski@delhaize.rs if you have any questions.

At Ahold Delhaize and our local brands, we broadly define diversity as being inclusive of thoughts and skills, generational differences, LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disabilities, nationalities and more, and we accept all people for who they are.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Wil jij werken met grote hoeveelheden data én analyses ontwikkelen die direct bijdragen aan de groei van Pricewise? Dan is dit jouw kans. Binnen Mavriq en Pricewise hebben we ambitieuze groeiplannen, waarbij data een centrale rol speelt.




Als Data Analyst werk je direct samen met de Head of Marketing en begeef je je op het snijvlak tussen de business en BI. Het BI-team legt de basis voor een diepgaande data-infrastructuur. Jij bouwt hierop voort door onze enorme hoeveelheid data te analyseren, inzichtelijke te maken en te vertalen naar concrete commerciële acties binnen marketing en commercie.




We zoeken iemand die graag meebouwt aan de toekomst. Iemand die nieuwsgierig is, wil experimenteren, en bestaande werkwijzen durft uit te dagen en met behulp van onder andere AI-toepassingen steeds meer waarde uit data weet te halen.




Wat doe je als Data Analyst bij Pricewise?

Als Data Analyst vertaal je ruwe en complexe data naar heldere inzichten en oplossingen. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data, BI en business en helpt collega's om datagedreven beslissingen te nemen.




Dit vind je leuk om te doen

Ruwe en complexe data analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete oplossingen voor de business, met een focus op digital marketing en commerciële groei.
Kwantitatieve en voorspellende modellen ontwikkelen die bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming.
Dashboards en rapportages ontwikkelen waarmee collega's eenvoudig kunnen sturen op data.
Data pipelines & processen optimaliseren (bijv. voor SEA) en bijdragen aan betrouwbare, goed gestructureerde en breed inzetbare data binnen de organisatie.
Nieuwe toepassingen ontdekken op het gebied van AI en analytics om nog meer waarde uit data te halen.




Dit zoek jij in een baan

Een rijke dataomgeving waarin jouw analyses direct bijdragen aan de groei van Pricewise én miljoenen consumenten helpen betere keuzes te maken.
Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.000 tot €5.500 (exclusief vakantiegeld), passend bij jouw ervaring.
Een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling die aansluit bij de impact die je maakt.
Reiskostenvergoeding, een premievrij pensioen en aantrekkelijke extra's, zoals een sportschoolvergoeding.
Veel aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, met volop mogelijkheden om te leren van internationale collega's met expertise in data, analytics en digital commerce.
De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan een snelgroeiende internationale organisatie binnen een dynamisch e-commercelandschap.
Een ondernemende cultuur met korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om te experimenteren en te innoveren.
Gezellige teamuitjes, borrels en een dagelijks verzorgde gezamenlijke lunch.
Een prettige balans tussen samenwerken op kantoor en geconcentreerd werken vanuit huis.




Dit breng jij mee

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, in Data Analytics, Econometrie of een vergelijkbare richting.
Minimaal twee jaar ervaring in een datarol. Ervaring binnen e-commerce of digital marketing is een pré.
Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en proactief. Je ziet kansen, neemt initiatief en werkt graag samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines.
Sterke vaardigheden in Python, SQL en Excel. Je schrijft schone, production-ready code en bent goed thuis in data libraries.
Je bent nieuwsgierig naar de business achter de data en begrijpt hoe analyses bijdragen aan commerciële doelstellingen.
Ervaring met BI-tools, zoals Tableau, Looker of PowerBI, en het ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages.
Ervaring met (statistische) analyses en het ontwikkelen van voorspellende of kwantitatieve modellen is een pré.
Kennis van data-infrastructuur. Je begrijpt hoe datapipelines en datamodellen werken, kunt werken met tools als BigQuery en schakelt gemakkelijk met data engineers.
Affiniteit met (generatieve) AI. Je hebt ervaring met LLM's en AI-tools of bent enthousiast om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen.




Bedrijfsbeschrijving

Pricewise is een van de grootste vergelijkingssites op het gebied van energie, verzekeringen, internet, tv, leningen en meer. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Amsterdam bieden wij consumenten de mogelijkheid om gemakkelijk over te stappen naar de beste aanbieding in de markt. Via ons vergelijkingsplatform bespaarden al miljoenen mensen honderden euro’s per jaar.




Sinds 2024 is Pricewise onderdeel van Mavriq: een snelgroeiende internationale groep met meer dan vijftien vergelijkingsplatformen in Nederland, Spanje, Italië, Frankrijk, Duitsland en Mexico. Vanuit onze leidende positie bouwen we aan de toekomst van online vergelijken, waarin data een essentiële rol speelt.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




We bouwen met Just Good People een nextgen data team met leuke mensen met sterke data, AI, human & biz skills. Geen PPT-consultancy, maar datakansen kraken en echt waarde realiseren bij toffe klanten. En veel opleiding.




Zie jij in bergen info – naast getallen – vooral kansen? Wil je die liever omzetten in actie dan in rapporten die in een la verdwijnen?




Wil je maximaal leren door in korte tijd bij meerdere bedrijven in de keuken te kijken? Terwijl wij je helpen ontwikkelen op het snijvlak van data, business en people?




Dan hebben we de uitdaging voor jou.




🟡 Just Good People

Bij JGP hebben we twee simpele regels: We nemen goede mensen aan. En we zorgen goed voor deze mensen. Dat betekent dat we samen optrekken om jou maximaal in je kracht te krijgen op een manier die bij jou past.




🌱 Unieke data filosofie

“As machines get better at being machines, humans have to get better at being more human.”

Deze nieuwe tijd vraagt om een nieuw soort data professional. Bij Just Good People Data helpen we bedrijven versnellen met top notch data professionals met goed ontwikkelde data, business én human skills. En trainen je naar nog hoger niveau. Met aandacht voor:




Volgende levels in Data | AI
“Waarde denken” voor klanten/ gebruikers
Stakeholder management
Communiceren & inspireren




⚡ Wat je gaat doen

Je werkt aan projecten bij mooie bedrijven zoals Bol.com, Defensie, Action, Rabo, NS, AMC, ASML, Essent.




Denk aan:




Het maken van veel impact met data
Stakeholders meenemen in de kracht van data – op een begrijpelijke manier
Verbinden van mensen, processen en tech
Vertalen van data naar heldere inzichten, dashboards en rapportages die helpen bij besluitvorming
Signaleren van trends, kansen en verbeterpunten en stakeholders adviseren op basis van data
Meedenken over slimme oplossingen voor complexe vraagstukken




👩 Wie je bent




Je bent technisch sterk maar ook nieuwsgierig naar de mens achter de vraag
Je vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken simpel te maken
Je krijgt energie van verandering en nieuwe omgevingen
Je wilt blijven groeien in data, business én human skills
Je hebt 4+ jaar ervaring als Data Analist
Je hebt een WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Data Science of Econometrie
Je bent ondernemend en denkt in zowel risico’s als kansen
Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen strategie, business en data
Je durft vragen te stellen en bestaande werkwijzen uit te dagen
Je bent een echte teamspeler en communicatief sterk
Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels

Your role in our team

As a Junior Data Analyst Retail, you support client teams with analysis, dashboards, KPI insights and data quality checks. You work with data from retail processes such as sales, customer behavior, inventory, promotions, e-commerce or supply chain and help make insights understandable for business stakeholders. At CGI, you grow by working in projects with experienced data consultants, project managers and technical specialists.

Analyze datasets and translate findings into clear insights and visualizations.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI, Tableau or comparable tooling.
Perform basic data quality checks and document definitions, assumptions and issues.
Support requirements, user stories, KPI definitions and stakeholder questions.
Work with senior consultants, data engineers, business analysts and client teams.
Contribute to presentations, workshops and analyses for retail and consumer-services clients.


What You Bring


1-2 years of experience, internship or traineeship in data analysis, BI, business analysis or analytics.
Solid foundation in SQL, Excel and at least one BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.
Affinity with retail, e-commerce, supply chain, customer analytics or commercial analysis.
Able to explain data outcomes clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Accurate, eager to learn, communicative and comfortable with client contact.
Professional Dutch and English, or demonstrably quick to develop to that level.


We would also value


Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or demonstrable Power BI experience.
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900), Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) or comparable fundamentals.
Basic Python or R for data cleaning, analysis or automation.
Experience with KPIs such as revenue, margin, conversion, inventory, customer segments or promotion effectiveness.
Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence or working in an agile team.


Where will you work?

You will join CGI’s retail team and work on assignments where data, business questions and technology come together. You will have room to learn, while contributing from the start to analyses, dashboards and insights that help clients make better decisions.

What We Offer


A learning environment where you can grow quickly towards data consulting in retail.
Guidance from experienced consultants and access to CGI’s broader knowledge network.
Varied assignments where data directly influences commercial and operational decisions.
Room to obtain certifications and further develop your technical and consulting skills.
A team culture centered on collaboration, knowledge sharing and ownership.


Why CGI?

CGI is one of the world's largest IT consultancy firms. Our people keep the Netherlands running. Government agencies, banks, (aero-) space, infrastructure organizations and energy and manufacturing companies are clients of CGI. We work on interesting projects that touch the daily lives of millions of people. We are present regionally, augmented with global domain knowledge, our ecosystem, and colleagues spread all over the world. We are proud of the impactful projects that we, together with our colleagues, make a success.

At CGI, we place great value on diversity and inclusion, as this not only promotes collaboration but often leads to better results. We look forward to your contribution to our team!


Work in small self-managing teams consisting of experts in your field
Take control of your own career with the space to continue developing yourself

Part-time possibilities

Title: ML Researcher - Amsterdam/Remote
Description:
Machine Learning Researcher



Location: Amsterdam / Remote

Our client is a rapidly growing proprietary trading firm specialising in systematic trading and market-making across global futures markets. Combining a research-first culture with significant investment in technology and infrastructure, the firm empowers researchers to take ownership of ideas and directly influence trading performance. As the business continues to expand, they are seeking an exceptional Machine Learning Researcher to develop next-generation quantitative trading strategies and contribute to the firm's long-term research agenda.



The Opportunity



This is an opportunity to join a highly collaborative team at the intersection of machine learning, quantitative research, and systematic trading. You will work alongside experienced Quant Researchers, Traders, and Technology teams to identify alpha opportunities, build predictive models, and deploy research into live production environments.

The ideal candidate will have a strong academic background in machine learning or a related quantitative field, alongside a demonstrated track record of high-quality research through leading publications, competitive internships, or industry experience.



Responsibilities


Conduct cutting-edge machine learning research for systematic trading and market-making strategies
Develop predictive models using large-scale financial, market microstructure, and alternative datasets
Generate, evaluate, and refine alpha signals across global futures and other liquid markets
Collaborate closely with Quant Researchers, Traders, and Portfolio Managers to translate research into production strategies
Build and enhance research infrastructure, modelling frameworks, and data pipelines
Analyse large and complex datasets to extract meaningful insights and uncover inefficiencies
Present research findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Stay at the forefront of developments in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and quantitative finance


Requirements


PhD or Master's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or another highly quantitative discipline
Strong foundation in machine learning, statistical modelling, optimisation, and predictive analytics
Excellent Python programming skills with experience working in research environments
Experience handling and analysing large-scale datasets
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment


Preferred Background



Candidates are particularly encouraged to apply if they possess one or more of the following:

Publications at leading machine learning or AI conferences, including NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR and AISTATS
Internship or full-time experience at a leading proprietary trading firm, hedge fund, quantitative trading company, or top-tier technology firm
Academic background from a leading European or global university with a strong reputation in quantitative research and machine learning
Experience applying machine learning techniques to real-world prediction, optimisation, or decision-making problems
Exposure to financial markets, quantitative research, algorithmic trading, or market-making environments

Title: BI Specialist
Description:
Introduction

We are looking for an enthusiastic BI Specialist (Junior / Medior) to join our team! This is a hands-on role where you'll work end to end, from how data flows into Snowflake all the way through to the dashboards leadership and brand teams rely on every day. You'll learn fast, work alongside experienced engineers and analysts, and quickly start owning meaningful parts of the stack.




What will you do?

Build and maintain dbt models that turn data from our e-commerce platforms (Commercetools, Shopify) and advertising sources into clean, consistent business entities: orders, customers, products, revenue.
Contribute to our dbt Semantic Layer, helping make sure every dashboard and report across the company is built on the same definitions.
Develop Power BI reports and dashboards that are clear, performant, and actually used.
Help onboard new data sources onto the platform as the group continues to grow.
Write good SQL, document your work, and ship your changes through code review and CI/CD. We do things properly.




What are we looking for?

Must-have

At least 3 years of experience working in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a similar role
Strong proficiency in SQL: writing queries, performance optimization, and data modeling
Hands-on experience with data visualization tools, preferably Tableau or Power BI
Experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse

Bonus points for

Hands-on experience with dbt (Core or Cloud)
Comfort with Git and a pull-request-based workflow
Experience with Fivetran or another managed ingestion tool
Background in e-commerce data: orders, customers, marketing attribution
Familiarity with Commercetools or Shopify schemas
Exposure to semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML)
Python for tooling or light scripting
Curiosity about how AI tooling is changing analytics workflows
You have an affinity for a healthy lifestyle and interest in topics such as sports, health, and wellness.




Why This Role Is a Great Step

Modern stack, real best practices. Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Power BI. We use them properly, with version control, testing, and CI.

Variety. You'll work across multiple brands and source systems, all on top of a unified data model. That breadth is rare to find this early in a BI career.

Visibility and impact. What you build lands directly in front of senior leadership and brand teams. You see the impact of your work, quickly.

Mentorship and growth You'll work alongside experienced engineers and analysts who care about doing things well and want you to grow with us.

A great team. Friendly, collaborative, and based in our Haarlem office with regular in-person time together.




What do we offer?

26 vacation days and 8% holiday allowance
Health insurance allowance (€65)
Phone expense reimbursement (€20)
Internet expense reimbursement (€20)
Pension plan
A free daily lunch in our cozy kitchen
Fun Friday afternoon drinks, great parties, team activities, and dinners
Travel expense reimbursement, if applicable




Interested?

Are you the BI Specialist we are looking for? Send your CV and a short note to Britt Zandstra via Britt.zandstra@visionhealthcare.eu about a data project you're proud of, ideally one where you built something end to end. We care more about how you think than how polished the writeup is.




If you'd like to talk to someone on the team before applying, just let us know in your note and we'll set it up.




About Vision Healthcare

Vision Healthcare is a fast-growing European group of direct-to-consumer healthcare brands. We bring great products to consumers across the continent, and as we grow, our data platform sits at the heart of how the business makes decisions.

We're investing in a modern, scalable data foundation built on best-in-class tooling, and we're looking for a BI Engineer to grow with the team and the platform.

What are we looking for?

Must-have

  • Hands-on experience with data visualization tools, preferably Tableau or Power BI

Bonus points for

  • Experience with Fivetran or another managed ingestion tool
  • Background in e-commerce data: orders, customers, marketing attribution
  • Familiarity with Commercetools or Shopify schemas
  • Exposure to semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML)

  • Curiosity about how AI tooling is changing analytics workflows
  • You have an affinity for a healthy lifestyle and interest in topics such as sports, health, and wellness.


Why This Role Is a Great Step

Modern stack, real best practices. Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Power BI. We use them properly, with version control, testing, and CI.

Variety. You'll work across multiple brands and source systems, all on top of a unified data model. That breadth is rare to find this early in a BI career.

Visibility and impact. What you build lands directly in front of senior leadership and brand teams. You see the impact of your work, quickly.

Mentorship and growth You'll work alongside experienced engineers and analysts who care about doing things well and want you to grow with us.

A great team. Friendly, collaborative, and based in our Haarlem office with regular in-person time together.


What do we offer?

  • 26 vacation days and 8% holiday allowance
  • Health insurance allowance (€65)
  • Phone expense reimbursement (€20)
  • Internet expense reimbursement (€20)
  • Pension plan
  • A free daily lunch in our cozy kitchen
  • Fun Friday afternoon drinks, great parties, team activities, and dinners
  • Travel expense reimbursement, if applicable


Interested?

Are you the BI Specialist we are looking for? Send your CV and a short note to Britt Zandstra via Britt.zandstra@visionhealthcare.eu about a data project you're proud of, ideally one where you built something end to end. We care more about how you think than how polished the writeup is.


If you'd like to talk to someone on the team before applying, just let us know in your note and we'll set it up.


About Vision Healthcare

Vision Healthcare is a fast-growing European group of direct-to-consumer healthcare brands. We bring great products to consumers across the continent, and as we grow, our data platform sits at the heart of how the business makes decisions.

We're investing in a modern, scalable data foundation built on best-in-class tooling, and we're looking for a BI Engineer to grow with the team and the platform.

Title: Data Analyst - Internship
Description:
Job Description

ING’s purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and in business. Our strategy is built around our purpose and making the difference for people and the planet. We are an industry recognized strong brand with positive recognition from customers in many countries, a strong financial position, omni-channel distribution strategy and international network. If you want to work at a place where we believe that you can make the difference by using machine learning to generate data driven products and solve the most pressing business challenges

The team

The Global Retail organisation is end-to-end functional responsible for the three retail segments: Private Individuals, Business Banking, and Private Banking & Wealth Management. Key responsibilities are: to define and cascade down the segment strategy, manage commercial and financial performance, and first line risk and regulatory responsibilities. In our Global Retail strategy, Superior Customer Experience and Sustainability at heart in a safe & secure environment are the key enablers of business growth.

The head office teams will accumulate segment intelligence and best practices, ensure segment-wide consistency and scale successful local initiatives across the three segments. To put our customers first and really make the difference, we focus execution capacity close to the customer.

Roles And Responsibilities

The Data Analyst works with other analysts and local / group stakeholders on Customer Intelligence activities, in order to support the CoE in translating insights into improved strategic decision-making across the Retail Segments. The Data Analyst executes analytics projects and consolidates management reports using different types of data (customer, business, financials)

Role profile

As An Data Analyst, Your Responsibilities Include



Improve reporting process and data quality, making sure Global teams and local units are fully aligned on definitions and data management
Maintain current reports and improve the reporting processes to reduce manual processes, risks and complexity
Optimize reporting process and data quality, making sure Global Segment teams and country teams are fully aligned on definitions and data management.
Support the implementation of broader data-driven transformation at ING




How To Succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

Experience



Solid background in analytics including key tools (SQL, SAS, PowerBI)
Solid background and experience in (analytics) project management
Sound understanding of core retail segments and business models




Skills



Cultural- and organizational sensitivity developed through prior experiences in different international working environments
Solid understanding of all aspects of Retail Banking and how to manage RoE growth by means of the right diversified fee income strategy
Solid understanding of how to use data to generate insights and solve problems
Good communication skills: being able to ‘get people on board’ based on data analytics outcomes
Proven stakeholder management skills.
Sound experience in building and executing (customer journey) roadmaps with a focus on improving customer experience




Competencies



Strong interpersonal skills displaying cultural sensitivity in coordinating interactions with and between the different business units
Ability to translate future vision into a set of clear deliverables and communicate across levels
Content-wise can deal with high degree of ambiguity that comes with the exploration request
Can do mentality – go out of your own responsibilities and comfort zone to achieve the team target
High energy and commitment to deliver
Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office Excel and Power Point
Fluent in written and spoken English.




Rewards And Benefits

This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about your specialist area and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you.

You’ll Also Benefit From



Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on a 36 hours work week
Your own work laptop
Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues




During the duration of your internship at ING, it is mandatory to be enrolled at a Dutch university (or EU-university for EU passport holders).

Questions?

Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.

Title: Data Analyst Internship
Description:
About AguroTech

AguroTech is a fast-growing high-tech AgTech company developing sensor technology, weather stations, and software solutions that help farmers use resources more efficiently while improving yields. Our products are already delivering tangible results in the field across 25+ countries. Headquartered in Amsterdam, we are scaling internationally and continuously improving our data capabilities to support smarter and more sustainable agriculture.




The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst Intern to join our data and product development team.




You will become part of a multidisciplinary team working with sensor data, agricultural insights, and digital solutions. As an intern, you will gain hands-on experience working with real-world datasets and contribute to turning raw data from farms into valuable insights for farmers and our internal teams.




You will be involved throughout the data cycle — from collecting and cleaning data to analysis, visualization, and supporting data-driven decisions.




What you'll work on

You will join our data team and contribute to one or more concrete projects, depending on your interests and our roadmap. Examples of work include:

Data analysis: exploring sensor data, identifying patterns, and extracting meaningful insights.
Data visualization: creating dashboards and reports to communicate insights clearly.
Data quality: helping improve data collection processes, validation, and accuracy.
Automation: building scripts and workflows to streamline data processing and reporting.
Agricultural insights: analyzing field data to better understand crop conditions, irrigation behavior, and sensor performance.
Supporting the development of data-driven tools for farmers and internal teams.




What we're looking for

Currently studying Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field (HBO or WO).
Experience with data analysis tools such as Python, SQL, Excel, or similar.
Interest in working with real-world data and solving practical problems.
Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
Curious, proactive, and able to work independently.
Strong communication skills in English (Dutch is a plus, not required).




What we offer

A hands-on internship with real responsibility from day one.
Direct exposure to data analytics in a real-world AgTech product environment.
The opportunity to work with unique agricultural sensor data from farms around the world.
A dynamic, collaborative, and international team.
Learning opportunities, mentorship, and room for initiative.
A monthly internship allowance of €500.
An on-site position at our Amsterdam office.

Title: Digital Analyst
HTML:
Turn B2C data into sharper journeys, smarter trading and stronger growth.

Lijnden | B2C (Ecommerce, IT, UX & Online Merchandising) | 40 hours | Full-time

At Just Brands, we build menswear brands with character. PME Legend, Cast Iron and Vanguard each have their own voice, their own audience and their own place in the market. In B2C, growth is shaped by thousands of decisions across ecommerce, retail, CRM, digital marketing, site merchandising, site experience, IT, UX and marketplaces.

The challenge is not having more data. The challenge is knowing what matters, what it means and what to do next. That is where ecommerce performance, customer behaviour, trading insights and business intelligence come together.

But what really sets us apart is how we work together.

We’re team first. No ego, no unnecessary layers, no endless talking, no corporate theatre. We back each other, speak up, take ownership and keep pushing for better. We work hard, stay sharp and make sure there’s room to enjoy the ride too.

That’s where you jump onboard.

Why this role matters

This is where ecommerce analytics, B2C performance and digital decision-making become commercial impact. As our Ecommerce Performance Analyst, you support data-driven decision-making across all B2C channels: Retail, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing & CRM, Site Merchandising, Site Experience, IT & UX and Marketplaces.

You collect, analyse and interpret data to generate actionable insights that improve performance, customer experience and operational efficiency. You help teams understand what is happening, why it is happening and which actions will create better results. You are not here to build dashboards that quietly gather dust.

You are here to turn B2C data into decisions that teams trust, use and act on.

What you’ll do

  • Support data-driven decision-making across all B2C channels, including Retail, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing & CRM, Site Merchandising, Site Experience, IT & UX and marketplaces;
  • Collect, analyze and interpret data to generate actionable insights that improve performance, customer experience and operational efficiency;
  • Build, maintain and improve dashboards for ecommerce performance, customer behavior, campaign performance, trading, funnel performance and channel results;
  • Design forecasting tools to anticipate customer behavior, sales trends, demand patterns and commercial opportunities;
  • Provide performance analytics to senior stakeholders, supporting decision-making and P&L accountability across online channels;
  • Lead department-wide projects that improve data collection, data integration and financial insight generation across B2C operations;
  • Analyze ecommerce KPIs such as revenue, conversion rate, traffic quality, average order value, margin, retention, customer lifetime value, funnel drop-off and product/category performance;
  • Translate data into clear recommendations for Ecommerce, CRM, Digital Marketing, Site Merchandising, Retail, Marketplaces, UX and IT;
  • Monitor digital marketing and CRM performance across paid media, email, automation flows, campaign traffic and customer segments;
  • Support ecommerce trading rhythms with weekly and monthly insights on what is selling, what is slowing down and where commercial opportunities sit;
  • Analyze customer journeys and identify friction points across web shops, apps, landing pages, checkout, content and onsite experience;
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation, including test setup, measurement, analysis and learnings;
  • Improve data quality, tracking consistency, reporting definitions and governance across B2C;
  • Help teams understand the story behind the numbers by presenting insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What success looks like in your first year

  • B2C teams use your dashboards and insights in weekly and monthly decision rhythms;
  • Ecommerce, CRM, marketing, site experience and marketplace teams make better decisions based on trusted data;
  • You identify conversion, trading or customer journey opportunities that lead to measurable business improvements;
  • Forecasting becomes sharper and helps teams anticipate sales trends, customer behavior and commercial risks;
  • Data collection and integration improve, reducing noise, manual work and reporting confusion;
  • Senior stakeholders receive clearer performance analytics that support P&L ownership and better prioritization;
  • A/B tests and experiments create learnings that change how we build campaigns, pages and customer journeys.

What makes this role exciting

  • You work across the full B2C ecosystem: ecommerce, retail, CRM, digital marketing, marketplaces, site experience, UX and IT;
  • You sit close to revenue, conversion, customer behaviour, trading performance and P&L decisions;
  • You influence both commercial performance and customer experience for three strong menswear brands;
  • You work on dashboards, forecasting, experimentation and strategic B2C projects;
  • You help shape how a growing international business becomes more data-driven;
  • You turn scattered data into clear direction, which is where the magic gets wonderfully operational.

You’ll probably love this role if you…

  • enjoy turning messy data into clear direction and practical next steps;
  • like investigating why performance changes, not just reporting that it changed;
  • understand that good analytics is part numbers, part business sense and part storytelling;
  • get energy from working with ecommerce, marketing, CRM, UX, IT and marketplace teams;
  • care about both performance and customer experience;
  • prefer impact over perfection and want your work to change decisions.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, Ecommerce or a related field;
  • 5+ years of experience in ecommerce analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, performance analysis or B2C data analysis;
  • Strong knowledge of ecommerce KPIs: conversion rate, revenue, AOV, traffic quality, margin, retention, CLV, funnel drop-off and product/category performance;
  • Strong experience with GA4, SQL, Excel and Power BI or Tableau;
  • Experience building dashboards, reporting structures and forecasting models;
  • Experience with digital marketing analytics, CRM analytics, campaign performance and customer journey analysis;
  • Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, CRO or UX analytics is a strong plus;
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect commercial, financial and customer data;
  • Comfortable working with cross-functional teams in a fast-moving retail or ecommerce environment;
  • Strong communication skills: you can explain insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Fluent English; Dutch or German is a plus.

What Just Brands is really like

We’re team first. In B2C, that means we challenge assumptions with data, keep conversations sharp and turn insight into action. No ego. Just practical collaboration, honest decisions and a team that likes improving what actually matters.

You’ll Join a Company Where

  • People help each other out;
  • Ideas and people matter more than job titles;
  • Hard work matters, and so does enjoying the ride;
  • If something can be better, we improve it.

What you get

  • Salary depending on experience and background;
  • End-of-year bonus equal to one gross monthly salary;
  • Healthy and varied lunch every day;
  • Exclusive access to our own Gym, including classes such as boxing, yoga and padel;
  • Parties and drinks that will be talked about for years to come;
  • Staff discount on our clothing.

Ready to turn ecommerce performance data into decisions that change results?

Still reading? Good sign.

If you want to work close to ecommerce, CRM, marketing, marketplaces, customer behaviour and real commercial decisions, this could be your next step.

Ready to apply?

Title: Business & Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

In this role, you'll help turn data into meaningful business insights that support decision-making across Customer Service & Operations teams in Canon EMEA. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you'll identify reporting needs, translate requirements into solutions, and deliver insights that help drive performance and continuous improvement.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining business analysis, stakeholder engagement, and data expertise. You'll have the chance to influence how data is used across the organization and contribute to initiatives that have a visible impact on business results.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business challenges, gather requirements, and translate them into reporting and analytical solutions.
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI datasets and reports that provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models to support scalable and effective reporting solutions.
Build and maintain ETL data pipelines using SQL and SSIS, integrating data from multiple sources.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and data processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability through validation and monitoring processes.
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and business-friendly way.
Support continuous improvement of reporting, analytics, and data management practices.


Qualifications

Must Have


Experience in a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role.
Strong Power BI modelling and visualisation skills.
Strong ETL and SQL skills and experience working with complex datasets.
Proven experience working directly with business stakeholders and translating business requirements into reporting and analytical solutions.
Experience building and maintaining data models and reporting solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.


Nice to Have


Experience with SSIS and SQL Server environments.
Experience with Power Automate.
Knowledge of Customer Service and Operations environments.
Experience working with international stakeholders across multiple countries and cultures.
Working knowledge of Python.
Familiarity with Oracle Analytics Server (OAS)


Canon Core Behaviours


Drive for results
Focus on the Customer
Take ownership and accountability
Act as a team player
Shows courage and conviction
People orientated
Caring for self and others


Why Join Canon?

You'll be joining a highly visible team that supports decision-making across Canon EMEA. This role offers a strong mix of business engagement and technical work, giving you the opportunity to work directly with stakeholders, influence decisions through data, and contribute to meaningful business improvements.

You'll be part of an international environment where collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation are encouraged, with plenty of opportunities to further develop your analytical and business partnering skills.

What We Offer


Hybrid working policy & flexible working hours
Performance-based bonus
31 days annual leave
Pension plan
Bicycle plan
Up to 30% discount on Canon products
Full reimbursement of public transport costs and partial car cost reimbursement
Free parking, excellent subsidized restaurant
Onsite gym
Learning and development opportunities
International working environment
Exposure to stakeholders across EMEA
Opportunity to influence business decisions through data and analytics


Location

This position is based in Amstelveen, the Netherlands.

To ensure a smooth onboarding and effective collaboration, we are currently focusing on candidates already residing within the European Union.

Even if you don't meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Analist
Description:
Data Analist

Jij maakt het verhaal achter onze cadeaukaarten, loyaliteitsprogramma's en transacties leesbaar. Als Data Analist weet je niet alleen hóe we presteren, maar ook waarom en wat we morgen beter kunnen doen.




Jouw rol: jij ziet patronen waar anderen ruis zien

Als Data Analist ben je de spil tussen data en besluitvorming binnen Operations. Je maakt serviceprestaties inzichtelijk, bouwt aan sterke SLA's en KPI's, en zorgt dat dashboards en rapportages niet alleen kloppen, maar ook echt gebruikt worden.




Je bewaakt en optimaliseert onze SLA-prestaties en vertaalt operationele data naar heldere managementinformatie en introduceert XLA’s in de organisatie. Je duikt in klanttevredenheid (CSAT) en klantloyaliteit (NPS), legt verbanden tussen operationele prestaties en klantbeleving, en adviseert management en operationele teams over wat er nodig is om klanten écht tevreden te houden. Je bent eigenaar van de klanttevredenheidsrapportages en de verbeterplannen die daaruit voortkomen.




Daarnaast analyseer je klantdata en gebruikstrends, signaleer je risico's en kansen voordat ze problemen worden, en bouw je dashboards die zowel intern als extern hun werk doen. Je trekt de transitie naar Power BI verder, en je zet AI-tools in om sneller tot bruikbare inzichten te komen.




Je werkt nauw samen met Customer Support, Customer Onboarding en Sales, en schakelt regelmatig met Product Management, Support, Implementatie en OR&S. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de COO.




Over Intersolve

Complexe geldstromen achter merken die iedereen kent

Bij Intersolve ontwikkelen en beheren we oplossingen voor cadeaukaarten, loyaliteitsprogramma's, e-vouchers, wallets en sociale betaaloplossingen. Ons platform verbindt meer dan 800 partners, zoals bol, VVV, HEMA en Hunkemöller, en ondersteunt dagelijks miljoenen transacties. Title: Data-Analist
Description:
Bij ista Nederland bevinden we ons midden in een fundamentele transformatie. De komende jaren zetten we grote stappen in digitalisering, datagedreven werken en de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie. Data speelt hierin een steeds belangrijkere rol.




Binnen het team Business Insights werken we eraan om data toegankelijker, begrijpelijker en relevanter te maken voor de hele organisatie. Om deze ontwikkeling te versnellen, zoeken wij een Data-Analist die data weet te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en hiermee bijdraagt aan betere besluitvorming binnen het Management Team en de organisatie.




In deze rol werk je samen met een klein en ervaren team, waarin je de ruimte krijgt om te leren, impact te maken en actief bij te dragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van data binnen ista.




Dit ga je doen

Als Data-Analist vertaal je data naar stuurinformatie en draag je bij aan de verdere datagedreven ontwikkeling van ista.




Business analyse & data (Power BI)

Ontwikkel en onderhoud je dashboards en rapportages (voornamelijk in Power BI).
Je bouwt mee aan ETL-processen en de doorontwikkeling van het datawarehouse.
Vertaal je businessvragen van verschillende afdelingen naar concrete data-inzichten en rapportages.
Analyseer je data en formuleer je heldere conclusies en aanbevelingen.
Lever je proactief inzichten die bijdragen aan besluitvorming binnen het MT.
Ondersteun je de transformatie van ista-processen door het leveren van relevante business insights.




Inzichten & organisatiebrede ondersteuning

Voer je analyses uit op het gebied van bijvoorbeeld marktontwikkeling, concurrentie, financiën en HR.
Signaleer je trends en verbeterkansen op basis van data.
Automatiseer en optimaliseer je rapportages die nu nog handmatig worden uitgevoerd.
Draag je bij aan het toegankelijk maken van data binnen de organisatie.




PMO-ondersteuning & procesverbetering

Ondersteun je projecten en transformatietrajecten met data en voortgangsinzichten.
Werk je samen met verschillende afdelingen bij planning en voortgangsbewaking.
Help je bij het implementeren en borgen van verbeterinitiatieven binnen processen.




Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Werken bij een organisatie die volop digitaliseert, groeit en professionaliseert.




ista biedt jou:

Een rol waarin je direct impact hebt op besluitvorming en strategie.
Een aantrekkelijk salaris, het ista Keuze Budget en een vaste 13e maand.
De mogelijkheid om je verder te ontwikkelen in data-analyse, Power BI en business insights.
Samenwerking met een ervaren team waarin je veel kunt leren.
Een omgeving waarin data, technologie en duurzaamheid samenkomen.
Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en betrokken collega’s.
Faciliteiten voor hybride werken.




Hier herken jij jezelf in

Je beschikt over een minimaal afgeronde HBO opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Business Administration, Data, Finance of vergelijkbaar.
Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met data-analyse en procesoptimalisatie.
Je hebt affiniteit met data, dashboards en het genereren van inzichten.
Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met Power BI of vergelijkbare analysetools.
Je bent analytisch sterk en weet data te vertalen naar begrijpelijke conclusies.
Je stelt de juiste vragen om behoeften en achterliggende vraagstukken scherp te krijgen.
Je communiceert helder en weet inzichten overtuigend over te brengen op verschillende niveaus.
Je creëert draagvlak voor jouw analyses en weet om te gaan met weerstand.
Je werkt proactief en draagt bij aan verbetering en structuur binnen processen.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed.
Je hebt interesse in of staat open voor het gebruik van AI en nieuwe technologieën om efficiënter te werken.







Over ista Nederland B.V.

Wij geven gebouwen een toekomst. Dat doen we met producten en diensten die helpen de CO₂-uitstoot van gebouwen te verminderen. We beheren gegevens en processen die ervoor zorgen dat vastgoed duurzamer, efficiënter, veiliger en comfortabeler wordt.




Onze oplossingen zijn digitaal en ondersteunen vastgoedeigenaren, beheerders en bewoners bij de overstap naar duurzame en toekomstbestendige technologieën. Daarbij staat gebruiksgemak centraal: we maken duurzame keuzes toegankelijk en eenvoudig, zodat iedereen kan bijdragen aan de bescherming van het klimaat.




Wereldwijd hebben we meer dan 48 miljoen draadloze apparaten in gebruik en werken ruim 6.600 medewerkers in 21 landen aan energie-efficiënte gebouwen. Onze producten en diensten worden toegepast in meer dan 14 miljoen woningen en commerciële gebouwen bij ruim 470.000 klanten. In 2025 realiseerde de ista Group een omzet van € 1.287 miljoen.

Title: Sustainability Analyst - Analytics & Reporting
Description:
City : Rotterdam State : Zuid-Holland (NL-ZH) Country : Netherlands (NL) Requisition Number : 46742

At Bunge, sustainability is not a separate agenda—it is embedded in how we operate, source, process and deliver oilseed and grain products across the globe for food, feed and renewable fuel. As aSustainability Analystwithin our Global Sustainability team, you will play a key role in transforming complex sustainability data into meaningful insights that support business decisions, environmental performance management and external reporting.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytics, sustainability and business impact. Unlike many sustainability roles that focus on a single country or region, this position offers exposure to Bunge's global operations of 150 processing plants and supply chain footprint handling 200 mln tonnes of agricultural commodities across 50 countries, enabling you to contribute to sustainability performance on a broader scale.

What You'll Do

As part of the Sustainability Analytics & Reporting team, you will help ensure the availability, quality and integrity of sustainability data and analytics used across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:


Developing and improving analytical tools and reporting models related to environmental performance and forecasting.,
Supporting and peer-reviewing recurring and ad-hoc sustainability reporting deliverables for internal and external stakeholders.
Analyzing large sustainability datasets relating to energy, greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 1, 2 and 3), water, waste and other sustainability performance indicators.
Collaborating with stakeholders across Sustainability, Operations, Finance, Business Technology and other business functions to enhance data quality and reporting processes.
Supporting the development and continuous improvement of dashboards and reporting solutions, both through in-house Business Intelligence teams and through self-made solutions using Excel, Tableau and upcoming AI-driven analytical tools.
Contributing to the measurement, analysis and reporting of environmental sustainability performance.
Preparing reports, visualizations and presentations that translate data into actionable business insights.
Supporting internal controls and audit activities by maintaining high standards of data quality, documentation and reporting accuracy.
Identifying opportunities to improve, automate and streamline sustainability reporting processes.


What Makes This Role Unique

This is not a regional level sustainability role.

As part of our global Sustainability team, you will work across multiple regions, business units and operational environments, helping to drive sustainability insights and reporting across Bunge's worldwide footprint.

You will contribute to topics that are shaping the future of the food and agriculture industry, including environmental performance, sustainability reporting and evolving regulatory requirements. Your work will support decision-making at both operational and strategic levels, helping Bunge achieve its sustainability ambitions.

What We're Looking For

You are naturally analytical, curious and comfortable working with large and complex datasets. You enjoy understanding the story behind the numbers and can translate data into clear, actionable insights.

Additionally, you bring:


A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Sciences, Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, Business Management, Agronomy, Food Process Engineering or a related field.
Minimum 2 years working experience in sustainability reporting, sustainability analytics or sustainability auditing, involving CSRD and GHG Protocol, ideally with exposure towards agriculture commodities.,
Strong Excel skills and experience working with reporting, analytics or Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau, with a keen interest into using AI pragmatically.
The ability to work with complex datasets while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and a structured, analytical mindset.
Project management skills with the ability to manage multiple workflows, track deadlines and coordinate deliverables across multiple teams.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across functions and geographies.
Professional proficiency in English. Knowledge of Dutch, Portuguese and/or Spanish is welcomed.
Eligible to work in the Netherlands.


What We Offer

At Bunge, you'll join a collaborative and international environment where sustainability, innovation and data-driven decision-making come together.

We offer:


A highly visible role within Bunge's Global Sustainability organization.
The opportunity to contribute to sustainability initiatives with global reach and impact.
Exposure to a wide range of stakeholders across different regions, functions and businesses.
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
A dynamic and purpose-driven work environment within one of the world's leading agribusiness and food companies.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Attractive office next to Rotterdam Blaak station.


Interested?

Click theApplybutton and let’s connect.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Bunge (NYSE: BG), our purpose is to connect farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed and fuel to the world. As a premier agribusiness solutions provider, our team of :34,000 dedicated employees partner with farmers across the globe to move agricultural commodities from where they’re grown to where they’re needed—in faster, smarter, and more efficient ways. We are a world leader in grain origination, storage, distribution, oilseed processing and refining, offering a broad portfolio of plant-based oils, fats, and proteins. We work alongside our customers at both ends of the value chain to deliver quality products and develop tailored, innovative solutions that address evolving consumer needs. With 200+ years of experience and presence in over 50 countries, we are committed to strengthening global food security, advancing sustainability, and helping communities prosper where we operate. Bunge has its registered office in Geneva, Switzerland and its corporate headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Learn more at Bunge.com.

Every day our people exemplify these values, which represent Bunge at its core:


We Are One Team – Collaborative, Respectful, Inclusive
We Lead The Way – Agile, Empowered, Innovative
We Do What’s Right – Safety, Sustainability, With Integrity


If this sounds like you, join us! We value and invest in people who believe in our purpose and are excited to live it every day – people who are #ProudtoBeBunge

Amsterdam, Netherlands

Competitive salary and benefits

They are a leading digital platform operating at scale across a high-traffic consumer marketplace.
