Title: Data Visualization Engineer & Data Integration Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0242934

Data Visualization Engineer & Data Integration Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data available across operational, assessment, and planning environments, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve mission challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a national security mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to help U.S. Special Operations leaders better understand trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities across partner nation programs and operational activities.

As a client-facing Data Visualization Engineer & Data Integration Analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with Special Operations customers, planners, analysts, and mission partners to understand their questions and needs, then dig into data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deeper understanding of their data, you’ll also advise the client on what the information means and how it can be used to improve planning, assessment, partner engagement, and senior leader decision-making.

How You’ll Contribute:

As a data analyst on our team, you’ll:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, cleaning, interpretation, evaluation, integration, and analysis of operational and assessment data.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across planners, assessment analysts, operational environment analysts, and senior stakeholders.
Apply communication skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements, data trends, and analytical findings based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as SQL, Python, or R, visualization tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Apply data visualization through formats such as dashboards, graphs, tables, trackers, maps, and PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions across special operations, campaign assessment, partner nation engagement, and operational planning missions.



Work with us to drive large-scale decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience supporting data visualization, data analysis, data integration, business intelligence, dashboard development, or knowledge management
Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, integrating, analyzing, or visualizing data from multiple sources
Experience developing dashboards, visual reports, data trackers, executive-level data products, or recurring reporting tools
Knowledge of data visualization principles, data quality, workflow automation, data management, information management, or knowledge management practices
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and translate mission requirements into practical data solutions
Ability to work with planners, analysts, and operational stakeholders to define data requirements and translate complex information into clear visual products
Ability to develop repeatable templates, dashboards, trackers, data collection frameworks, or automated workflows that support recurring reporting and assessment cycles
TS/SCI clearance
HS diploma or GED



Nice If You Have:


Experience supporting a Theater Special Operations Command, Geographic Combatant Command, or other Department of Defense client
Experience with security cooperation, partner force development, irregular warfare, counterterrorism, special operations, exercises, or campaign assessment
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, or SharePoint lists
Experience with SQL, Python, R, JavaScript, Databricks, application programming interfaces, or data transformation tools
Experience supporting Mission Command System – Common Operational Picture, Maven Smart System, Palantir, Advana, Tableau, ESRI, or other mission data platforms
Knowledge of Africa regional security dynamics, partner nation operational environments, transnational threat networks, or campaign planning processes
Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, National Security Studies, or a related field preferred; Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, National Security Studies, or a related field a plus



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,500.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Marketing Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Fashion und Lifestyle, 6.500 Mitarbeiter:innen, 13 Department Stores, Online-Shops in 13 Ländern, 1.500 Marken, 21 Restaurants & Confiserien, 15 erstklassige Services, drei Friseur-Salons und stets ein besonderes Einkaufserlebnis – das ist Breuninger. Ein Traditionsunternehmen, das internationale Wege geht, seine Ziele klar definiert und innovative Möglichkeiten schafft

Ab sofort | remote möglich | Vollzeit

Stellenbeschreibung

Datengetriebenes Arbeiten ist genau Dein Ding? Perfekt! Als Marketing Analyst (m/w/d) bist Du Teil unseres Data Insights Teams und sorgst dafür, dass datenbasierte Entscheidungen unsere Marketing- und CRM-Strategien nachhaltig voranbringen. Mit Deinem analytischen Blick identifizierst Du Optimierungspotenziale, leitest fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen ab und unterstützt unsere Fachbereiche dabei, das Beste aus ihren Daten herauszuholen.

Deine Aufgaben



Analyse von Marketing- und CRM-Daten zur Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen und Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Stakeholdern, um relevante Fragestellungen zu entwickeln und datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen.
Ganzheitliche analytische Begleitung von Marketing- und CRM-Tests, von der Konzeption über die Durchführung bis hin zur Auswertung der Ergebnisse.
Unterstützung unseres CRM Teams bei der Analyse von Kundensegmenten, Zielgruppen und Kampagnen zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Kundenkommunikation.
Aufbereitung komplexer Analysen sowie Entwicklung aussagekräftiger Dashboards und Visualisierungen für unterschiedliche Stakeholder.
Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Self-Service-Analytics-Lösungen für unsere Marketing- und CRM-Fachbereiche.




Qualifikationen

Bringe Deine analytische Stärke und Deine Begeisterung für datenbasierte Entscheidungen bei uns ein.



Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium mit quantitativem Schwerpunkt oder eine vergleichbare analytische Qualifikation.
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (ca. 3–4 Jahre) als Marketing Analyst:in oder in einer vergleichbaren analytischen Rolle – idealerweise im E-Commerce-Umfeld.
Erfahrung im CRM Analytics Umfeld ist ein Plus.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Analyse von Marketing-Performance-Daten, Attributionsmodellen sowie idealerweise CRM-Datenstrukturen.
Sicherer Umgang mit SQL und Datenbanksystemen.
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit der Google Cloud Platform.
Kenntnisse in Visualisierungstools wie Power BI oder Looker Studio.
Interesse an generativer KI und deren Einsatz zur Effizienzsteigerung entlang des gesamten Analyseprozesses.
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zum Data Storytelling sowie zur verständlichen Aufbereitung komplexer analytischer Zusammenhänge.
Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.
Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und Lernbereitschaft runden Dein Profil ab.

Title: Data & Analytics Specialist
Description:
ABOUT AARKE

Aarke is a Swedish design company redefining everyday kitchen appliances through premium materials, engineering, and timeless design. Founded in 2013, we are on a mission to re(de)fine the home appliances industry — combining Scandinavian design, exceptional quality, and top-tier materials in a category often overlooked by the design community.

Our flagship product, the Aarke Carbonator, has earned a devoted global following with customers in more than 30 countries. As we continue to scale internationally and expand into new product categories, we are looking for sharp, hands-on people to grow with us.




THE POSITION

This is a chance to own Aarke's entire data foundation and use it to help a fast-growing design brand grow. The Data & Analytics Specialist works as close to commercial decisions as to the data itself, and turns a strong data platform into better decisions across the business.

The role owns Aarke's data platform: the BigQuery warehouse, the data model, the pipelines and the Power BI reporting layer the company relies on. It is the source of truth across sales, e-commerce, marketing, operations, finance, product, claims and customer experience, and it gives the whole company reliable numbers to move quickly on. Keeping it accurate, available and trusted is what makes everyone else faster.

Just as important, this is an enabling role across the whole business. A large part of the job is helping Aarke grow and run well: on the commercial side, turning data into insight on sales, channels, conversion, customer lifetime value and retention; and on the operational side, giving Operations, Logistics and Finance the insight they need on inventory, supply, fulfilment, returns, service and cost-to-serve. The role works with the e-commerce, performance marketing and CRM teams as well as the operations, logistics and finance teams so decisions across the company are grounded in real numbers. It suits someone who enjoys sitting between business and technology, wants to keep learning across both, and brings findings to the teams rather than waiting to be asked.




The role owns the platform and makes it easy for others to use. Teams across the company work with the data and run their own tools, while this role holds the model, the quality and the standards everyone relies on. We are looking for someone who is not tied to any one technology: someone who builds well on what we have today, keeps a clear view of what good looks like elsewhere, and is confident and bold enough to bring in better ways of doing things when they will move the business forward. It reports to the COO and works closely with the Online and Commercial teams as well as Operations and Finance.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Data Platform Ownership

• Own the BigQuery medallion warehouse, including architecture, pipelines, data quality and the canonical data model across all business domains.

• Own the Power BI semantic layer and the reporting infrastructure the company builds on.

• Keep the platform correct, available and trusted as the single source of truth, and resolve discrepancies between systems.

• Work with the external data consultancy during a handover period as specialist support, and take over the platform knowledge as the original build team transitions out.




Analytics that Drives Growth and Performance

• Turn data into insight across the whole business, covering both the commercial side (sales and channel performance, conversion, customer lifetime value, repeat purchase, retention and margin) and the operational side (inventory, supply, fulfilment, returns, service levels and cost-to-serve), and bring it to the teams who can act on it.

• Work closely with the Online and e-commerce team on the analytics behind the webshop and marketplaces, including funnel, conversion, channel mix and customer behaviour across markets.

• Support Performance Marketing with the data and reporting they need to measure and improve spend, attribution and channel return.

• Support CRM with the data behind lifecycle, subscription and retention performance.

• Support Operations and Logistics with the data behind inventory health, supply and demand, fulfilment and 3PL performance, returns and cost-to-serve, so the operation can be run and improved on real numbers.

• Provide the data and reporting Finance needs for margin, cost and performance analysis across products and channels.

• Bring findings to the business without being asked. This includes surfacing patterns they should know about, beyond the reports they request.

• Own the cross-domain questions and data that do not obviously belong to any single team.




The Data Platform and Reporting

• Build and maintain the BI models and reporting to definitions set by Finance and the business owners.

• Set the standard for how data is modelled, named and trusted, so the whole company works from the same numbers and can move quickly on them.

• Partner with Finance, who own the metric definitions (net sales, GP2, active subscriber, and so on), while this role builds the models that produce them.

• Work alongside the Online, CRM and Performance Marketing teams, who run their own channel tools such as GA4, Polar and Klaviyo. This role owns how that data flows into the warehouse and ties together, rather than owning the tools themselves. This is a key interface with the work the online team holds today.




Ways of Working

• Work as part of a small data and systems team, clear on who is responsible for what, and ready to help across the edges.

• Partner with the Automation & AI Specialist. This role looks after the data platform and reporting, the other looks after systems and automation.

• Use AI in day-to-day work and build data that is easy for the wider team to query and use.




QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong data engineering capability, comfortable owning a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery or equivalent), pipelines and a medallion-style architecture.

• Strong analytical and commercial sense, able to turn data into decisions rather than only dashboards.

• Hands-on with SQL and a BI or semantic layer (Power BI or equivalent).

• Experience across e-commerce or consumer-goods data, spanning commercial data (sales, marketing) and operational data (inventory, supply chain, logistics, fulfilment), is an advantage.

• AI-fluent in working method, and curious about applying AI to analysis and tooling.

• Fluency in English.




PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

• Proactive, and shares insight with the business rather than waiting to be asked.

• Takes care of the numbers and wants them accurate and trusted across the company.

• Improvement-minded, and keeps the platform healthy and makes it better over time.

• Collaborative, and owns the platform without gatekeeping it, helping teams get what they need.

• Comfortable taking over and looking after something the original team is moving on from.

• Not tied to any one technology, keeps up with what good looks like elsewhere, and is confident enough to challenge the current setup and try better ways of doing things.




WHY AARKE?

At Aarke you get to work with consumer products that people genuinely love — and contribute to building the paid media engine that helps us grow globally. We are a small, hands-on team where your work has real impact and visibility.

We offer a collaborative environment, strong learning opportunities, and the chance to grow within a fast-scaling international company. Our headquarters is in central Stockholm, Vasastan.




WHAT NOW?

Please submit your application through career.aarke.com/jobs. We review applications continuously.

For questions about the role, please contact Anna Korling (Chief People Officer) at anna@aarke.com.

We are looking for someone who is not tied to any one technology: someone who builds well on what we have today, keeps a clear view of what good looks like elsewhere, and is confident and bold enough to bring in better ways of doing things when they will move the business forward. It reports to the COO and works closely with the Online and Commercial teams as well as Operations and Finance.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Data Platform Ownership

• Own the BigQuery medallion warehouse, including architecture, pipelines, data quality and the canonical data model across all business domains.

• Own the Power BI semantic layer and the reporting infrastructure the company builds on.

• Keep the platform correct, available and trusted as the single source of truth, and resolve discrepancies between systems.

• Work with the external data consultancy during a handover period as specialist support, and take over the platform knowledge as the original build team transitions out.


Analytics that Drives Growth and Performance

• Turn data into insight across the whole business, covering both the commercial side (sales and channel performance, conversion, customer lifetime value, repeat purchase, retention and margin) and the operational side (inventory, supply, fulfilment, returns, service levels and cost-to-serve), and bring it to the teams who can act on it.

• Work closely with the Online and e-commerce team on the analytics behind the webshop and marketplaces, including funnel, conversion, channel mix and customer behaviour across markets.

• Support Performance Marketing with the data and reporting they need to measure and improve spend, attribution and channel return.

• Support CRM with the data behind lifecycle, subscription and retention performance.

• Support Operations and Logistics with the data behind inventory health, supply and demand, fulfilment and 3PL performance, returns and cost-to-serve, so the operation can be run and improved on real numbers.

• Provide the data and reporting Finance needs for margin, cost and performance analysis across products and channels.

• Bring findings to the business without being asked. This includes surfacing patterns they should know about, beyond the reports they request.

• Own the cross-domain questions and data that do not obviously belong to any single team.


The Data Platform and Reporting

• Build and maintain the BI models and reporting to definitions set by Finance and the business owners.

• Set the standard for how data is modelled, named and trusted, so the whole company works from the same numbers and can move quickly on them.

• Partner with Finance, who own the metric definitions (net sales, GP2, active subscriber, and so on), while this role builds the models that produce them.

• Work alongside the Online, CRM and Performance Marketing teams, who run their own channel tools such as GA4, Polar and Klaviyo. This role owns how that data flows into the warehouse and ties together, rather than owning the tools themselves. This is a key interface with the work the online team holds today.


Ways of Working

• Work as part of a small data and systems team, clear on who is responsible for what, and ready to help across the edges.

• Partner with the Automation & AI Specialist. This role looks after the data platform and reporting, the other looks after systems and automation.

• Use AI in day-to-day work and build data that is easy for the wider team to query and use.


QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong data engineering capability, comfortable owning a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery or equivalent), pipelines and a medallion-style architecture.

• Strong analytical and commercial sense, able to turn data into decisions rather than only dashboards.

• Hands-on with SQL and a BI or semantic layer (Power BI or equivalent).

• Experience across e-commerce or consumer-goods data, spanning commercial data (sales, marketing) and operational data (inventory, supply chain, logistics, fulfilment), is an advantage.

• AI-fluent in working method, and curious about applying AI to analysis and tooling.

• Fluency in English.


PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

• Proactive, and shares insight with the business rather than waiting to be asked.

• Takes care of the numbers and wants them accurate and trusted across the company.

• Improvement-minded, and keeps the platform healthy and makes it better over time.

• Collaborative, and owns the platform without gatekeeping it, helping teams get what they need.

• Comfortable taking over and looking after something the original team is moving on from.

• Not tied to any one technology, keeps up with what good looks like elsewhere, and is confident enough to challenge the current setup and try better ways of doing things.


WHY AARKE?

At Aarke you get to work with consumer products that people genuinely love — and contribute to building the paid media engine that helps us grow globally. We are a small, hands-on team where your work has real impact and visibility.

We offer a collaborative environment, strong learning opportunities, and the chance to grow within a fast-scaling international company. Our headquarters is in central Stockholm, Vasastan.


WHAT NOW?

Please submit your application through career.aarke.com/jobs. We review applications continuously.

For questions about the role, please contact Anna Korling (Chief People Officer) at anna@aarke.com.

Title: Data Analyst - Team Intelligence
Description:
At Voyado, hundreds of retailers rely on dashboards, exports and shared analytics experiences to understand their business and make decisions. Behind every metric, dashboard and export sits a series of product decisions: what should be measured, how it should be defined, and how it should work consistently across customers, markets and products.

We’re now looking for Data Analysts to join Team Intelligence in Stockholm and help shape the analytics products our customers will rely on for years to come.

About The Role

As a Data Analyst in Team Intelligence, you will work with analytics products that scale across Voyado’s product portfolio. You will help harmonise how data, KPIs and analytics surfaces work across products such as dashboards, BI Export and DeltaShare.

Your focus will be on building analytics experiences that are accurate, consistent and useful for many customers — not creating one-off reports for individual stakeholders.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Analytics Engineers and domain teams to understand customer needs, investigate data discrepancies, define shared metrics and contribute to the broader product roadmap for analytics across Voyado.

Who you are

You have a product mindset and see dashboards, metrics and analytics experiences as products that need ownership and continuous improvement. You’re comfortable working closely with Product Managers, engineers and other stakeholders, and you enjoy creating clarity where definitions, data or expectations differ.

You’re curious, analytical and enjoy understanding how data works beneath the surface. When numbers don’t add up, you want to find out why.

Most importantly, you care about building analytics that people can trust. We'd love to see that you also have:


Experience working as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst or in a similar analytics-focused role.
Strong SQL skills.
Experience with BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar.
Experience owning dashboards, reports or data products over time.
Ability to translate business and customer questions into clear data requirements.
Strong communication skills and experience working with multiple stakeholders.


High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.

You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.

At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.

Some of our benefits:


30 days of vacation
Wellness allowance
Personal development opportunities
Summits and team activities


Four days from the office and one day from home

About Voyado

Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.

More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.

We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.

Ready to make an impact?

Fantastic! 🎉

A quick note about our recruitment timeline: As many of us will be taking some well-deserved summer vacation, this process will move a bit slower than usual.

We’d still love to hear from you as soon as possible!

Thank you for your understanding, and we hope you’ll apply! 🌞

Additional information

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.

Making it personal with AI

We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

Title: Data Specialist
Description:
We are Posti, a versatile, modern, and international logistics expert with 400 years of experience. Today, we connect people and businesses by delivering information, emotions, and goods with the help of 13,000 experts across the Nordics and Baltics. We make everyday life easier for you, businesses, and society while building a more sustainable future for us all.

Är du noggrann och trivs med att arbeta i olika projekt? Har du stark samarbetsförmåga? Är du duktig på att omvandla verksamhetsbehov till flexibla tekniska tjänster? Arbetar du obehindrat i en internationell leverantörsmiljö och vet hur man framgångsrikt leder outsourcade tjänster?

Då borde du söka rollen som Data Specialist och ansluta till vårt mycket kompetenta och lösningsfokuserade team inom Business Data & Insights (BDI).

Vårt BDI-team är en central del av affärsenheten Fulfillment and Logistics Services (FLS), som verkar i Finland, Sverige och Norge. Som ett multinationellt team spelar vi en nyckelroll i att utveckla lagerverksamheten och driva digitaliseringsinitiativ. I denna roll får du möjlighet att bidra i engagerande projekt och arbeta med mycket varierande och omfattande datamängder. Vi är engagerade i din professionella utveckling genom kontinuerliga lärandemöjligheter, inklusive utbildningar, kurser och branschcertifieringar.

Din Profil


Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning (ekonomi, industriell ekonomi, business intelligence)
Erfarenhet av SQL och Power BI
Viss erfarenhet av versionshantering (GitHub)
Starka kvantitativa, analytiska och problemlösande färdigheter
Förmåga att ta initiativ och vara innovativ
God kommunikativ förmåga i tal och skrift på engelska och svenska
Intresse för logistik och materialflöden


Meriterande


Kunskap om Python och Spark
Erfarenhet av Confluence och JIRA


Du kommer att ansvara för att stödja och samarbeta med operativa och affärsinriktade kollegor, samla in och tolka krav samt översätta verksamhetens behov till robusta datatjänster. Med din kompetens inom data och programmering kommer du att designa och implementera effektiva datalösningar. I rollen som data specialist kommer du att samla in data från flera källor, säkerställa datakvalitet och integritet samt förbereda data för användning i verksamheten.

Du arbetar nära kollegor med olika professionella bakgrunder, vilket gör att god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga är avgörande. Vi söker en öppen och nyfiken person som tar initiativ, bidrar med nya perspektiv och vidareutvecklar befintliga lösningar. Du bör trivas med att arbeta med olika teknologier och vara flexibel i en dynamisk och föränderlig miljö. Vårt team består av både data specialists och data scientists, vilket ger möjlighet att arbeta i spännande och affärskritiska projekt. Du kommer även att samarbeta nära med IT-avdelningen och externa konsulter i en integrerad och framåtblickande arbetsmiljö.

Placering

Stockholm eller Jönköping

Skicka in din ansökan (Vi ser gärna att CV/Personligt brev är på engelska ) inklusive löneanspråk, senast den 16/8 via Postis rekryteringssystem Workday.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande från vecka 34.

Honer Kadiri, Head of Business Data & Insights

Title: Dataanalytiker
Description:
Vill du bidra till att lösa en av vår tids största samhällsutmaningar? Trivs du i en miljö som präglas av handlingskraft och samhällsengagemang?



Utbetalningsmyndigheten är en innovativ myndighet under utveckling. Genom att jobba hos oss får du vara med och forma en verksamhet som upptäcker, förhindrar och förebygger välfärdsbrott och felaktiga utbetalningar från statliga myndigheter och kommuner. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där du får stort ansvar och mandat att påverka. Hos oss kommer ditt engagemang och din kompetens göra skillnad.



Ansvar och arbetsuppgifter



Som dataanalytiker arbetar du med att förädla data och utveckla dataanalyser/urvalsmodeller som har till syfte att identifiera enskilda felaktiga utbetalningar från välfärdsmyndigheter och andra aktörer. I rollen ingår även att förvalta, följa upp dataanalyser/urvalsmodeller samt att presentera analysarbetet och dess resultat. En viktig del är även att identifiera databehov, bistå i arbetet med att ta in nya datakällor till vår databas och att bistå i att skapa förutsättningar för att lämna ut data till aktörer som har rätt till detta.



Du hjälper även till att utveckla verksamheten och skapa förutsättningar för ett rättssäkert och effektivt dataanalysarbete. Rollen innebär ett tvärfunktionellt arbete som också kräver ett nära samarbete med andra myndigheter och aktörer.



Rollen som dataanalytiker är placerad på avdelningen dataanalys. För att kunna göra dataanalyser har myndigheten ett omfattande datalager som successivt håller på att byggas ut. Avdelningen arbetar även med att genomföra dataanalyser inom myndighetssamverkan mot organiserad brottslighet.



Vi söker dig som har



• Akademisk utbildning inom statistik, systemvetenskap eller annan utbildning som vi bedömer relevant för rollen.



• Minst tre års aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet av att själv formulera frågor mot större datamängder med SQL.



• Minst tre års aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet av att genomföra olika typer av analyser av data genom programmering i till exempel Python.



• Erfarenheter av att samarbete med olika kompetenser och externa aktörer



• God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska.



Det är meriterande om du även har



• Erfarenhet av att genomföra presentationer av analysarbetet och dess resultat



• Erfarenhet av att genomföra riskbaserade urval/urvalsprofiler.



• Erfarenhet av ett agilt arbetssätt.



Efterfrågade förmågor och färdigheter



För att lyckas och trivas i rollen som dataanalytiker är du mål- och resultatorienterad och har en god problemlösande analysförmåga. Du har ett kreativt förhållningssätt och är initiativtagande. Vidare har du god samarbetsförmåga och är pedagogisk.



Den statliga värdegrunden sammanfattar och synliggör de viktigaste kraven som gäller för statsanställda, att arbeta i staten innebär att följa den. Vi ställer även höga krav på säkerhetsmedvetenhet.



Övrigt



Myndigheten är placerad i Stockholm i moderna lokaler i närheten av Gullmarsplan. Säkerhetsprövning kan bli aktuellt. Befattningen är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Sex månaders provanställning kan bli aktuellt.



Vi strävar efter att alla medarbetare ska ha en hållbar arbetsmiljö och balans mellan jobb och fritid. Vi erbjuder många förmåner för dig som anställd.



I denna rekrytering söker du med ditt CV. Istället för att bifoga ett personligt brev vill vi att du svarar på några frågor kring din kompetens kopplat till jobbet. Vi ber dig svara utförligt på dessa frågor. Läs mer om hur rekryteringsprocessen går till här. Arbetsprov kan bli aktuellt i urvalsprocessen. Utbetalningsmyndigheten arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.



Är du intresserad?



Vill du veta mer om rollen kontakta avdelningschef Gabriella Bremberg på telefon 010-572 75 04 eller enhetschef Mark Sayar på 010-572 75 36. Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet, men tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.



Kontaktpersoner för de fackliga organisationerna är Anna Frängsmyr (Saco-S) 010-572 75 78 och Michael Ohlsson (ST) 010-5727512.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Vi söker en Data Analyst med fokus på DORA-regelverket. Uppdraget är ett hybridupplägg med krav på närvaro på plats 2–3 dagar per vecka.

Rollen handlar i huvudsak om att arbeta nära verksamhetens intressenter för att fånga upp datakrav och fungera som stöd i datarelaterade frågor. Konsulten ansvarar för att spåra och kvalitetssäkra dataflöden så att transparens och ansvarsskyldighet upprätthålls, samt för de processer som styr inmatning, lagring och hämtning av information i registret över tredjeparts-IKT-avtal och i DORA:s regulatoriska spårbarhetsmatris.

En central uppgift är att kartlägga vilket dataunderlag som registret kräver – exempelvis vilka enheter som nyttjar IKT-tjänster och hur IKT-applikationer kopplas till affärsprodukter och tjänster. Rollen innebär även löpande uppföljning och förbättring av datans kvalitet, korrekthet och fullständighet, samt att dokumentera och föreslå arbetssätt, rutiner och standarder för datastyrning.

Skallkrav:


God erfarenhet av Power BI, inklusive inläsning av stora datamängder, bearbetning och modellering via Power Query och Power Pivot, relationsuppbyggnad samt framtagning av interaktiva rapporter för publicering på interna rapportservrar och användning i ledningsrapportering.
Förmåga att strukturera, prioritera och tidsplanera arbetet så att deadlines hålls.
Tidigare erfarenhet av att samla in och registrera information i DORA Register of Information (RoI).
Kunskap inom datasäkerhet och regelefterlevnad, inklusive datakryptering och åtkomstkontroll.
Kännedom om samt praktisk erfarenhet av RoI:s tekniska genomförandestandard (ITS).
Mycket god vana vid Microsoft Excel för dataanalys och rapportering, exempelvis formler, analysfunktioner och Power Query.
Goda kunskaper i engelska.


Meriterande:


Stark kommunikations- och samarbetsförmåga i intressentkontakter.
Förmåga att analysera datarelaterade problem och ta fram effektiva lösningar.
Hög noggrannhet i arbetet med att säkerställa datakvalitet och exakthet.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
We are super excited to announce that Robin Bodin is now looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Insights & Activation product area, focused on building the trusted data foundation that powers analytics, predictive models, and future AI capabilities across Voyado Engage.

Our mission is to make analytics data reliable, governed, and actionable end to end — from canonical data products and semantic standards to the metrics and insights surfaced to customers. As part of this journey, we’re evolving both our data foundations and analytics products to create a more scalable, transparent, and trustworthy platform.

We work in short feedback loops, close collaboration with stakeholders, and a strong belief that progress comes from learning and iteration — not just shipping.

About The Role

This is not a traditional BI or dashboarding role.

Team Intelligence is responsible for the analytics and reporting capabilities inside Voyado Engage. We’re evolving towards a modern analytics foundation where governed datasets, certified metrics and semantic definitions are treated as shared product assets that power both embedded analytics and future AI-driven experiences.

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll build and own the data products behind our customer-facing analytics. Working hands-on with SQL, Databricks and modern data tooling, you’ll model, validate and improve datasets, metric definitions and data quality processes. A key part of the role is identifying inconsistencies, duplicated logic and unclear ownership, and turning that into scalable and trusted solutions.

The role sits at the intersection of analytics, product and engineering. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX, analytics engineers and domain teams to ensure our analytics are understandable, consistent and reliable for customers

Some of the things you'll be up to:


Designing and building governed data products with clear schemas, quality tests, lineage and ownership
Writing SQL to model, transform and validate structured data
Building and maintaining semantic definitions and certified metrics across analytics surfaces
Collaborating with domain teams to improve data quality and upstream ownership
Contributing to documentation, contracts and standards that make analytics reliable and understandable
Supporting the foundation behind embedded BI and future AI-powered analytics capabilities


So, who are you?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical ownership with a thoughtful and collaborative mindset. You care deeply about data quality, consistency and building systems that others can trust and scale on top of.

You probably enjoy turning ambiguous business questions into clear and reliable metric definitions, and you prefer solving problems at the source rather than patching them downstream. You care about details like semantic clarity, documentation and naming conventions because you understand their long-term impact on both people and systems.

At the same time, you enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, UX and customer-facing teams to build analytics experiences that are both technically robust and genuinely useful.

Besides the above, we believe you've got:


Strong SQL skills for data exploration, transformation and validation
Experience with dbt or similar tooling for governed data transformations
Experience building or maintaining data products, semantic layers or certified metrics
Understanding of concepts such as lineage, data contracts, canonical entities and quality testing
Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery


Experience within retail tech, e-commerce, Databricks or lakehouse-style data platforms is considered a strong plus.

What's in it for you?

Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers and some examples of what we can offer you are:


An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.


Some of our benefits:


30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
Breakfast buffet on Fridays
Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
A wellness hour you can use every week


About Voyado

Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.

With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.

Ready to find out more?

Lovely! 🎉

Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!

Making it personal with AI

We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human so please, bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice because that’s what we care about the most.

Vacation period!

As we are heading out for the vacation period, feedback on your application might take a little longer than usual. Don't hesitate to send in your application, though; we'll do our best in getting back to you as soon as possible! 🌴

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
We are Sweden's leading app and marketplace for booking beauty and wellness services. As a SaaS company with industry-leading software, we empower more than 16,000 professionals across the country. Our platform brings together nearly every salon and clinic in Sweden, making it easy for consumers to book appointments with hairdressers, massage therapists, podiatrists, beauty salons, chiropractors, and many other specialists—all in one place.

On Bokadirekt.se, consumers can discover, book, and pay for treatments and services in just a few clicks. Every month, our platform is visited by 3 million consumers, and more than 2 million bookings are made through our website and app. We’re growing rapidly and are currently a team of more than 100 employees, with offices in Stockholm and Luleå.

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Analyst to join our Data & Analytics team and serve as the dedicated analytics partner to our Product organisation.

As a Product Analyst, you will help our product teams make better decisions through data. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to uncover user insights, measure product performance, and drive experimentation across the customer journey. You'll play a key role in establishing best practices for product analytics, event tracking, and experimentation while enabling teams to make confident, data-informed decisions.

Your insights will directly influence the experience of millions of consumers and thousands of professionals using Bokadirekt every month.

Beyond product analytics, we're looking for someone with an AI-native mindset—someone who knows how to leverage AI to work smarter while applying sound judgement to validate AI-generated insights and recommendations. This is an opportunity to shape how analytics, experimentation, and AI contribute to the continued growth of one of Sweden's most widely used consumer platforms.

What You'll Do


Drive product insights across the full customer journey by identifying user behaviour, friction points, drop-offs, and growth opportunities
Own A/B testing end-to-end, from experiment design and statistical validation to analysis and post-mortems
Champion our experimentation framework by coaching product managers, designers, and engineers on experiment design and data-informed decision-making
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to define, implement, and continuously improve reliable event tracking standards
Leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, improve productivity, and apply sound judgement when validating AI-generated insights


Who You Are


Degree in Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field
Proven experience (2–4 years) as a Product Analyst or Data Analyst, ideally in a technology-driven environment
Strong proficiency in SQL
Hands-on experience designing, analysing, and evaluating A/B tests
Experience working with product event tracking in fast-moving environments where processes and data are continuously evolving
Comfortable bringing structure to ambiguous situations and turning insights into action
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Looker), Amplitude, Mixpanel, Confidence by Spotify or similar
Professional fluency in English; Swedish is a plus


What We Offer


The opportunity to influence product strategy and user experience through data at one of Sweden's most widely used consumer apps
The opportunity to shape how product decisions are made through experimentation, analytics, and AI
A collaborative culture built on ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing
A flexible hybrid work model with four days in the office each week, including Wednesdays as our "Inspiration Day," when the whole company comes together for breakfast and shared activities
A modern office in the heart of Stockholm
A competitive salary and benefits package


About The Position

Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement

Location: Our office at Kungsgatan 38 in central Stockholm (hybrid)

Employment type: Full-time, permanent position

Application deadline: August 14

Application

We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Summer is here, and we are also taking some time to recharge. During the holiday period, our response times may be slightly longer than usual, and the recruitment process will resume from week 32.

Thank you for your patience. We wish you a wonderful summer and hope to hear from you soon!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Join the Supply Chain organization and play a key role in the In-Season Optimisation area. You’ll work with Gen-AI technologies and leverage SQL, programming tools, and BI best practices to deliver actionable insights and optimize product performance. You will:



Translate business processes and objectives into data-driven insights, helping the organization understand performance and make strategic decisions throughout the value chain.
Support the analysis and optimization of digital fulfilment flows, ensuring efficient inventory utilization, order sourcing, and customer delivery across the value chain.
Understand how cross-functional initiatives and programs impact what we do and the decisions we make.
Translate large volumes of data into actionable insights that guide strategic decisions across fashion retail and e-commerce.
Define, monitor, and visualize key KPIs to drive transparency and measure success.
Lead data modelling conversations to ensure optimal data structures and model performance within your product area.
Act as the go-to analytics expert within your business and product team, collaborating end-to-end on data-driven business development, value realization and business case validation.





WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH



You’ll be part of a truly international and cross-functional team, working closely with Business Process Leads, Data Scientists, Business Experts, and Product Managers. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do; our team brings together diverse backgrounds and perspectives to solve complex challenges and create real value for millions of customers across global markets. We work in an agile setup that encourages experimentation, continuous learning, and open dialogue.







WHO YOU ARE



We are looking for people with…



· A degree in Economics, Business, Supply Chain, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.



· Experience in analytics roles within retail, fashion, or tech-driven companies, ideally linked to product or business development., with the focus on Supply Chain.



· Proficient in SQL, Python, or R. Experience using modern data tools such as Git, Dataform and dbt is a plus.



· A solid understanding of analytical methods applied to real-world data problems.



· Experience using data visualization tools, e.g. Power BI or similar tools.



And people who are…



· Strategic thinkers with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for solving complex problems.



· Clear communicators who can transform data into compelling stories and practical recommendations.



· Team players who thrive in collaborative, agile environments and are comfortable working with a range of stakeholders.







WHO WE ARE



H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.



We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.



We offer all our employee’s attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a 25% staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 



· 30 days holiday



· We offer a collective agreement which includes pension and life insurance  



· H&M Incentive Program  



· Wellness benefit 4000kr/year  



· Benifex Benefits Portal  



· Community with activities 







JOIN US



Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.



Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact – and your part matters.

Your role

Operational Development within Procurement, SAAB Surveillance, is in a strong transformation phase where data, analytics, and digital tools are key enablers to improve efficiency, quality, and performance across procurement operations. We are now looking for a Data Analyst, who will be part of the Operational Development team supporting Procurement in Surveillance.

In this role, you will work closely with procurement operations, strategic buyers, and operational procurement teams, as well as cross-functional stakeholders, to transform data into actionable insights that drive operational improvements, process efficiency, and better decision-making. You will collect, structure, analyze, and interpret data from ERP and procurement-related systems to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, trends, and improvement opportunities across procurement processes, supplier interactions, and operational workflows. You will also develop and maintain analytical solutions using SQL and BI tools such as QlikSense or similar platforms, enabling transparency and supporting fact-based decision-making. The role combines hands-on analytics with strong collaboration in a highly operational environment. You will be part of a team where collaboration, curiosity, and delivery focus are central. We value openness, continuous learning, and a strong delivery mindset, where everyone contributes to driving real operational change.

This position can be based in Solna or Gothenburg.

Main responsibilities:


Drive data-driven operational improvement initiatives within Procurement Operations, SAAB Surveillance
Analyze operational procurement data to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, trends, and improvement opportunities
Work closely with procurement operations teams to understand processes, performance, and daily challenges
Support operational development initiatives through data analysis and insight generation
Build dashboards and reporting solutions using QlikSense or similar BI tools
Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, primarily from ERP systems
Develop KPIs and performance metrics to support operational excellence in procurement
Communicate insights, findings, and recommendations to operational and cross-functional stakeholders
Contribute to digitalization, automation, and process improvement initiatives within procurement operations
Continuously identify best practices and translate them into practical operational improvements



Your profile

We're looking for a structured, analytical, and hands-on individual who thrives in an operational environment. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by improving how things actually work in practice, not only in theory. You have a strong "do-it attitude" and enjoy solving real operational problems through data. With solid technical skills and strategic thinking, you're comfortable diving into complex challenges and translating them into clear, actionable insights. You take initiative without waiting for direction, and you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done. You work naturally close to the business, engaging with stakeholders across functions and turning technical knowledge into practical solutions. You're collaborative, communicative, and able to navigate a dynamic environment where priorities shift quickly. You enjoy change and actively contribute to improving processes, tools, and ways of working, combining your technical expertise with strategic perspective to drive real impact.

Master of Science (MSc) in Industrial Engineering, Industrial Economics, Mechanical Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or similar
Experience from manufacturing, industrial operations, procurement operations, or supply chain environments
Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel, and data analysis
Experience with BI tools such as QlikSense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar
Good understanding of operational procurement processes and supply chain workflows
Experience working with ERP systems (preferably IFS)
Ability to handle, structure, and analyze large and complex datasets
Strong communication skills in both English and Swedish
Several years of relevant experience within manufacturing, procurement, or supply chain is required



Meriting experience:


Experience with operational excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement methodologies
Experience with process automation tools
Experience with AI tools and business adoption in industrial settings
Data modeling or advanced analytics experience in operational contexts

Title: Data Cleansing Analytiker, visstidsanställning, Stockholm – Martin & Servera Restauranghandel
Description:
Är du den vi söker? Nu söker vi en Data Cleansing Analytiker till vårt team Process & Utveckling Artikel. Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning till och med augusti 2027. Du blir en nyckelspelare i vårt arbete med data cleansing för masterdataobjektet artikel. Du kommer fokusera på analysarbete kopplat till data cleansing i PIM och ERP genom att ta fram analyser som möjliggör ökad grad av massuppladdning och minskat behov av manuell rättning i våra artikelmasterdata system.

Uppdraget innebär att metodiskt analysera stora datamängder utifrån givna datapunkter med utgångspunkt i de regler som projektet tagit fram. För att bearbeta artikeldatan så effektivt som möjligt ska du identifiera mönster och genomföra massrättningar i PIM såväl som ERP. För de datapunkter som eventuellt inte går att massuppdatera kommer du samarbeta tätt med operativa resurser, tillsammans blir ni vår taskforce för artikelcleansing. Vi avser bygga upp ett systematiskt regelverk för att säkra effektivitet och uppdraget innebär följaktligen att vara den som styr logiken för våra rapporter och script som underlättar den manuella hanteringen samt säkrar förvaltning fram till migrering.

Du blir en del av Kategori & Inköp, och rapporterar till Chef Process & Utveckling Artikel. Vi har en stark intern gemenskap där vi arbetar tillsammans, stöttar varandra och har roligt på jobbet.

Ett hållbarhetsarbete i framkant

Hållbart företagande är en integrerad del i hur vi inom Martin & Servera utvecklar affärer. Vi är övertygade om att företag kan förändra samhället till det bättre. Vår hållbarhetsstrategi bygger på att maximera affärs- och samhällsnytta samtidigt som vi minimerar negativ påverkan på människa, djur och natur. Du blir en viktig del av det arbete som vi tillsammans gör varje dag för en mer hållbar framtid.

Stabilt och långsiktigt

Vi har en stark och långsiktig ägare i form av familjeägda Axel Johnson, vilket skapar både trygghet och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter inom koncernen.

Vi erbjuder dig

Hos oss får du ett spännande jobb med goda förmåner som generöst friskvårdsbidrag, sjukvårdsförsäkring och lunchsubvention. Vi värdesätter både prestation och balans mellan arbete och privatliv och erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete två dagar i veckan. För oss är det viktigt med en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö, därför utför vi slumpmässiga drog- och alkoholtester på våra arbetsplatser.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

Som Data Cleansing Analytiker arbetar du med att analysera och förbättra kvaliteten i våra artikelmasterdata i PIM och ERP. Du identifierar mönster i stora datamängder och tar fram lösningar som effektiviserar datarensningen och minskar behovet av manuella korrigeringar.

Du Kommer Bland Annat Att


Analysera artikeldata och identifiera datakvalitetsavvikelser.
Genomföra massuppdateringar och rättningar i PIM och ERP.
Ta fram analyser och underlag som möjliggör en högre grad av automatisering.
Utveckla och förbättra regelverk, rapporter och script som effektiviserar Data Cleansing-arbetet.
Samarbeta nära operativa kollegor för att säkerställa en effektiv hantering av artikeldata.
Bidra till långsiktiga förbättringar av datakvalitet och arbetssätt.


Viktigt För Att Jobbet Ska Passa Dig

Du är handlingskraftig, nyfiken och van att arbeta både självständigt och i team. Du är en självständig och lyhörd doer som har lätt för att sätta dig in i komplexa frågor. Du är lösningsorienterad, flexibel och har ett prestigelöst förhållningssätt. Du trivs med att jobba mot ett tydligt mål och agerar självständigt för att lösa ut de frågeställningar som analysarbetet genererar.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:


Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
Stark analytisk förmåga med erfarenhet av arbete med artikeldata
Dokumenterad erfarenhet av dataanalys och datakvalitetsarbete
Erfarenhet av GS1 standard
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med datadrivna förbättringar för att minska manuella insatser
Förmåga att identifiera och tydligt adressera problem och utmaningar


Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har


Erfarenhet från att jobba tvärfunktionellt
Erfarenhet av att ha jobbat med livsmedelsartiklar
Erfarenhet av arbete med PIM system
Erfarenhet av arbete med Affärssystem
Jobbat med AI


Hur går rekryteringen till?

Vi jobbar aktivt för mångfald och ser olikheter mellan människor som en styrka. Med målet att spegla alla våra kunder och samhället vi verkar i, söker vi människor i alla åldrar och med olika bakgrunder. I våra rekryteringar använder vi oss av personlighetstest. Det är för att kunna jämföra kandidater på ett så objektivt och rättvist sätt som möjligt. Vi gör också bakgrundskontroller. Läs mer om rekryteringsprocessen på vår hemsida.  

Med anledning av semesterperioden kommer samtliga ansökningar att behandlas först efter sista ansökningsdagen. Tack för förståelsen och vi ser jättemycket fram emot din ansökan!  

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-08-23.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

Anställningsform: Visstidsanställning till och med juni 2027.

Sysselsättningsgrad: Heltid, 100 %.

Adress: Lindhagensgatan 133, Stockholm.

Kontakt: Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Charlotta Fredhsdotter Holmberg, charlotta.fredhsdotterholmberg@martinservera.se, från och med 12 augusti. Då det är semesterperiod nu kommer vi att starta igång urvalet först efter 23 augusti. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via brev eller e-post.

Facklig företrädare: Anna-Lena Holsteryd, Anna-Lena.Holsteryd@martinservera.se

Martin & Servera är Sveriges ledande restauranggrossist och levererar dagligen drycker, färskvaror, livsmedel, utrustning, tjänster och kunskap till restauranger och storkök. Martin & Servera-gruppen består av moderbolaget Martin & Servera samt dotterbolagen Martin & Servera Restauranghandel med restaurangbutiker, Martin & Servera Logistik, Galatea och Sorundahallarna. 

Tillsammans gör vi på Martin & Servera-gruppen skillnad för alla som älskar mat och dryck. Med omtanke om varandra, våra kunder och vår planet gör vi varje dag lite godare. Som medarbetare hos oss är du en viktig del av vår framgång. Här tas dina erfarenheter, idéer och kunskaper tillvara och vi växer och utvecklas tillsammans. Välkommen till oss!

Title: Ecommerce Analyst
Description:
About the Digital Db Team

Db is a fast-growing brand creating innovative travel gear for creatives, athletes, and modern explorers. We're passionate about delivering outstanding customer experiences that match the quality of our products.

As we continue to scale our e-commerce business globally, we are looking for an Ecommerce Analyst to join our Digital team.




About the Job

This role sits within the Digital team and reports directly to the Chief Digital Officer to support digital analysis across our digital head functions.

Working closely with teams across Ecommerce, Marketing, Finance, and Operations, you will help us understand what's driving performance across our ecommerce business and identify growth opportunities.

You will be responsible for ensuring the business has the insights, reporting, and data quality needed to make informed decisions.

Whether it's breaking down campaign results, investigating changes in conversion rate, forecasting future performance, or identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey, you will play a key role in helping the team make better decisions and move faster.




Key Responsibilities

Data Quality & Reporting

Own the accuracy and consistency of our ecommerce data, ensuring GA4, on-site tracking, and Shopify data can be trusted.
Partner with the Finance and Operations teams, who own the commercial and transactional data foundation (including Business Central), so that ecommerce reporting ties back to a single, agreed source of truth.
Build and maintain the reports and dashboards the team relies on, ensuring key metrics are clearly defined and consistently measured.
Investigate and resolve tracking discrepancies across key platforms.
Utilize tools such as Claude and other modern technologies to improve analysis, reporting, and decision-making.

Ecommerce Analytics & Insights

Monitor and analyze ecommerce performance across key metrics such as traffic, conversion rate, revenue, average order value, customer behavior, and retention.
Identify trends, opportunities, and performance drivers across markets, categories, products, and customer segments.
Investigate unexpected changes in performance and identify root causes.
Translate data into actionable recommendations that support business growth and improve customer experience.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear and actionable way.

Commercial Performance & Planning

Analyze campaign, category, product, and market performance to identify growth opportunities.
Support forecasting, promotional planning, and commercial decision-making through data-driven insights.
Evaluate promotional activities and provide recommendations to improve future performance.
Deliver post-campaign analysis, highlight key learnings and opportunities, and share results with the Marketing team.
Monitor customer behavior throughout the purchase journey, including conversion trends and cart abandonment performance.

SEO Performance

Monitor and report on organic search performance.
Identify opportunities and measure the impact of SEO efforts.
Experimentation Support
Support Product and Development teams by providing data, analysis, and insights for experimentation and optimization initiatives.
Evaluate the impact of A/B tests and changes.




Qualifications & Skills

Experience

3+ years of experience in Ecommerce Analytics, Digital Analytics, Business Intelligence, Marketing Analytics, or a similar analytical role.
Experience working with Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Experience working within Shopify or a similar ecommerce platform.
Experience working with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI.
Experience working with digital marketing platforms and conversion tracking.
Experience working cross-functionally with multiple stakeholders and external partners.
Experience working within e-commerce, retail, or consumer brands.
Experience supporting experimentation, optimization, or A/B testing initiatives is a plus.
Experience analyzing ecommerce KPIs including conversion rate, customer acquisition, retention, average order value, and revenue performance.

Skills

Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into business recommendations.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.
Strong communication skills and the ability to present insights in a clear and actionable way.
Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
Comfortable working with large datasets and validating data quality; working knowledge of SQL is a plus.
Understanding of SEO principles and digital marketing measurement.
Interest in AI tools and emerging technologies.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Commercial mindset with a passion for ecommerce and customer experience.




What We Offer

The opportunity to work with a passionate and international team.
A dynamic, fast-paced work environment where your input makes a real impact.
Competitive compensation and benefits package.
Employee discounts on Db products.
An inclusive culture where you can be who you are and that values work-life balance, with flexibility and understanding to help you perform your best both inside and outside of work.
A fun group of people passionate about what makes Db connected to our strong communities: Outdoor activities, Urban Fashion, Meaningful Journeys, and Connecting with people across the world.







Application deadline:

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis from mid August.

Title: Analytics Engineer II
Description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer II to join Spotify's Platform Central Data (PCD) squad, a cross-functional Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering team within the Platform Mission. You’ll help build and maintain trusted analytical models, metrics, and data products that power developer productivity, platform health, and leadership decision-making. Working closely with Data Engineers, Product, Engineering, and Platform partners, you’ll translate platform signals into reliable, well-modeled data assets that help Spotify ship faster and safer.

What You"ll Do


Build and maintain analytical data models using dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) in BigQuery for a broad set of stakeholders
Build and operate reliable data pipelines using SQL, with a focus on testing, observability, and CI/CD
Help define and evolve key metrics for platform health, developer productivity, and ML/AI platform adoption
Partner with Data Engineers on upstream pipelines and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to scope and deliver insights
Improve data quality, performance, and cost efficiency across pipelines and models, including troubleshooting and backfills
Contribute to dashboards and self-serve data products that enable better decision-making across teams
Follow and contribute to data quality, testing, and documentation practices across the analytics layer
Participate in a fair support rotation for key datasets, pipelines, and analytical products


Who You Are


You have 2+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related field
You have strong SQL skills and experience with data modelling
You are experienced with dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) and a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks SQL
You are familiar with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Flyte
You care about data quality, reliability, and testability
You are comfortable working with BI/visualisation tools such as Looker or Tableau
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners
You are able to prioritize and deliver in a fast-moving environment
You have experience with platform or developer productivity data, experimentation, or ML/AI metrics


Where You'll Be

This role is based in London or Stockholm.

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice

Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
TL;DR - We are looking for analytics engineers to own the semantic and modeling layer of our warehouse by transforming raw data into well-defined, trustworthy datasets and metrics. You are obsessed with analytical consistency, designing impactful metrics, and building strong foundations for self-service analytics.

Why Lovable?

Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we’re just getting started.

We’re a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

What we are looking for:


Expertise with SQL, dbt, SQLMesh or similar tools (data modeling, testing, macros, docs)
Experience with data warehousing concepts, cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks) and BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, Metabase, etc)
Understanding of dimensional modeling, data contracts, and metrics/semantical layers
Familiarity with modern ELT and orchestration workflows (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, etc)
Strong business acumen and ability to translate domain logic into scalable data structures


What you will do:


Build and maintain data models, following modular, tested, and version-controlled practices
Partner with domain teams to understand business logic and codify it into reusable models and metrics
Define and document key metrics and data contracts across domains
Collaborate with Data Platform Engineers to optimize query performance and warehouse cost
Automate and maintain data documentation, lineage, and governance standards
Develop guidelines for analytics development, data modeling and structure conventions


Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:


Frontend: React
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)


And always on the lookout for what's next!

How We Hire


Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with recruiter.
Complete the general programming exercise.
Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
Tell us about your most impressive project.


About Your Application


Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal
