Title: Data Analyst - 10-month maternity cover
Description:
Driving Digital Transformation Through Insightful Analytics – Viby J.

Do you enjoy turning complex data into trusted insights that help an international business make better decisions? We are looking for a Data Analyst to join STARK Group IT in a 10-month maternity cover position from 1 October 2026 until 31 July 2027. As part of one of Northern Europe's largest digital transformation programmes, you will help turn business needs into trusted data, actionable insights, and scalable analytics solutions used across STARK Group.

If you are motivated by creating clarity from complexity and enjoy diving into data with a delivery focused mindset, this could be the role for you.

This role is based in Viby J, Aarhus.

Your Impact And What You Will Deliver

You will join the STARK Group IT Data Management team, consisting of four Data Analysts and two Data Management Specialists, where you will collaborate closely with experienced colleagues and contribute to continuously strengthening our data management and data analysis capabilities.

While you will be part of the Data Management team, your day-to-day work will be closely integrated with project teams and business stakeholders. The role follows a hybrid working model with three days per week in the office and two days working from home. To support collaboration and knowledge sharing, the Data Management team works together from the office every Tuesday. The remaining office days are typically spent alongside your assigned project team and key stakeholders.

In this role, you will work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, architects, data engineers, and BI developers. You will play a key role in translating business needs into data requirements, identifying and validating data sources, establishing source-to-target mappings, and helping ensure a common understanding of business rules, KPIs, and data definitions across business and technical teams.

A key assignment during this maternity cover will be supporting reporting initiatives within Athene, STARK Group's large-scale digital transformation programme consisting of 16 interconnected projects across the business. Working across multiple projects and stakeholders, you will help ensure that reporting needs are understood early, data dependencies are identified, and future reporting solutions are supported by reliable and well-structured data.

In this role you will:

Title: Data & Analytics Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
On Behalf of Hobbii we are looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer




About Hobbii




Hobbii is Denmark's fastest-growing e-commerce company within yarn and handicrafts. From our base in Copenhagen, we've built a global brand serving passionate makers in more than 12 markets, with an ambition to become the world's leading online yarn universe. Driven by scalable technology, creative energy, and data-driven commerce, we're turning our passion for craftsmanship into a global success story.

This is a rare chance to join a small, dedicated data team at Hobbii and turn raw, complex data into trusted, business-ready answers the whole company relies on.




About the role

You’ll work with stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Tech, serving the business with their data needs and helping users make the most of our customer-centric data. You’ll have full ownership of your data products end to end, as well as talking to and educating the business.




Key responsibilities




• Work closely with Finance, Product and Commercial to understand what they need, and translate it into clear, trustworthy answers

• Own shared KPI definitions such as AOV, CLV, and Margin in our Cube semantic layer, so the business measures things consistently

• Contribute to maintaining and building SQL models and dashboards, and help key stakeholders understand the implementation

• Build useful Metabase dashboards and utilise coding and AI tools to help answer business questions effectively

• Contribute to the Data Dictionary so non-technical users understand what they are measuring and can explore data with confidence




Your profile

You’ve probably been the data person somewhere small before, so you’re used to owning things end to end and figuring them out yourself. You’re as curious about the business as the tech, you’d rather answer a real question than build something clever no one asked for, and you’re comfortable talking to stakeholders.




We imagine you bring:

• Genuine business curiosity and the instinct to translate stakeholder questions into practical solutions, this matters as much as the tech

• Experience with a modern data warehouse such as Redshift

• Interest in semantic modelling, KPI logic, or reusable business definitions. Cube, dbt, or LookML experience is a plus

• Curiosity about using AI and MCP for SQL support, documentation, or data exploration

• English fluency, written and spoken, our company language

• A relevant degree or equivalent practical background




Why join Hobbii?

At Hobbii you’ll join a tight-knit team building something global from Copenhagen, and as one of the first data hires, you’ll have unusual ownership and room to shape how we work. You’ll see the impact of your work across the business every week, with real room to grow as the data function grows. We move fast, support each other, and have a lot of fun along the way.




We offer:

Competitive salary based on experience and skills
Flexible work setup – hybrid (HQ in Nordvest, Copenhagen)
6 weeks of paid vacation
Health insurance and paid parental leave
Catered lunch, great coffee, and lively Friday bars
Legendary company events and a welcoming, informal culture
A great staff discount on yarn




Interested?

FACTOR 7 is managing the recruitment process. For more information, please contact Recruitment Manager Omar Kamel at omar@factor7.dk or on +45 30 22 09 02.

Title: Fraud Analyst & Investigator
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
OM SKJOLDET

Vi er en Dansk fintech startup, der vender tilgangen til digital svindel på hovedet. Tænk hvis man kunne omsætte en phishing side til et signal som kunne stoppe alle fra at miste penge fra netop det svindelnummer. Det arbejder vi på. Og hvorfor? Vi oplevede hvordan digital svindel rammer helt almindelige mennesker, især dem tæt på os og koster i både tid og penge, det besluttede vi os for at gøre noget ved. Istedet for at reagere på svindel, stopper vi det proaktivt, udenfor bankens systemer, inden betalingen går igennem. Vi er et lille ambitiøst team bestående af to founders, udviklere og analytikere, der er gået ind i et nyt kapitel med investering og skalering. Og nu skal vores analysekapacitet følge med.

DIN ROLLE

Som Fraud Analyst og Investigator bliver du en central del af vores datateam – du analyserer svindelcases, sikrer kvaliteten af vores data og oversætter mønstre til indsigter, der gør vores produkt bedre og vores kunder klogere. Du arbejder tæt med det tekniske team og har direkte indflydelse på, hvordan vi forstår og bekæmper svindel.


Analyse og validering af potentielle svindelsider og digitale svindelcases
Kategorisering og kvalitetssikring af svindeldata for den finansielle sektor
Udarbejdelse af statistikker, dashboards og rapporter om svindeltendenser
Identifikation af mønstre og trends i data – fx typer af svindel, geografisk spredning og tidsmæssige tendenser
Bidrage med datadrevne indsigter baseret på kunde- og forretningsbehov
Samarbejde med det tekniske team om forbedring af datakvalitet og analysemetoder


DU BRINGER

Vi ansætter ikke bare dit CV. Vi ansætter din nysgerrighed, dit øje for detaljer og din lyst til at forstå svindel dybere end overfladen.


Erfaring med dataanalyse, statistik og datakvalitet
Arbejder struktureret og har øje for detaljer
Trives med at analysere og validere data frem for primært at udvikle software
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine analyser
Er nysgerrig og motiveret for at lære mere om digital svindel og cybersikkerhed


VI TILBYDER


En central analyserolle i en fintech startup med reel traction og store ambitioner
Direkte samarbejde med founding teamet og dine indsigter former produktet
Meningsfulde problemer i krydspunktet mellem data, AI og finansiel sikkerhed
Fleksibilitet og tillidsbaseret arbejdskultur i Lyngby
Mulighed for at vokse med virksomheden og forme din egen rolle

Title: Data Portfolio Analyst for Markets Data Office
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Copenhagen HQ, Denmark

Looking for your next career opportunity within Data Governance, where you can expand your critical data expertise in a fintech organisation?

Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of the Data Governance Programme. The function is structured across four domain areas Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk, and Market Risk reflecting how critical data is used across Markets.

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work within one of these domain areas and help improve how critical data is defined, monitored, and controlled. Your work will contribute to establishing consistent ways of working across the Markets Data Office, while supporting domain-specific needs. While your focus will be within a specific domain area, you will operate as part of a single Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling, and governance practices.

This is an opportunity to join early, shape how we work, and make a real impact on how data is governed at scale.

What You Will Do

You will work close to business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards, and technology teams to improve the quality and governance of critical data within your assigned domain area. Depending on the domain, this may include data such as instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, margin utilisation, or model data.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Identify and document Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) and support the governance of Critical Data Elements (CDEs) in your domain area
Analyse data to assess quality, identify issues, and support root cause investigations
Define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds, and supporting documentation used in monitoring and control activities
Contribute to ensuring data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use
Monitor quality outputs, track remediation activities, and escalate blockers where data issues are not being resolved
Collaborate with data owners, stewards, and stakeholders across business and technology
Support the implementation of data governance practices and controls


A key part of the role is ensuring that documentation is clear, structured, and maintainable, enabling transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone who is structured, curious, and motivated to work with data in a business context:


Experience in data analysis, data quality, or a related field
Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
Ability to understand data in the context of business processes
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams
Ability to produce clear and structured documentation
Experience with SQL or similar tools is an advantage
Experience with Great Expectation or Databricks is an advantage


What We Offer


The opportunity to help build a new data function from the ground up
Exposure to key business domains and critical data flows
A collaborative and learning-focused environment
A role where your work directly improves decision-making and operational quality


You will join Markets Data Office in the early stages of its journey, where your role will grow alongside the organisation. This means exposure to new challenges, increasing responsibility, and the opportunity to shape how data is managed across the business.

Inclusion at Saxo

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where different perspectives are valued. We encourage applications from all backgrounds and experiences.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 15 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How To Apply

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Analytics & Insight

Identify and quantify opportunities in platform data; translate findings into clear recommendations for product and business teams.
Design and maintain decision-oriented KPI frameworks accessible to front-line teams and senior management alike.
Conduct deep-dive analyses on product adoption, user behaviour, performance trends, and business impact — and design experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, significance testing) to test hypotheses that emerge.
Support benefit estimation and validation for platform product initiatives.

Data Craft & Self-Sufficiency

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, transform, and model data from multiple source systems.
Build reusable analytical datasets that support recurring analysis and reporting — working independently or alongside data engineering colleagues as needed.
Work within our Azure/Databricks cloud infrastructure, treating analytical datasets as data products: clear ownership, documented SLAs, versioning, and a feedback loop with end users.
Proactively identify data quality issues and work with upstream teams to resolve them.

Stakeholder Engagement & Delivery

Partner with product owners, Business users, and engineering teams to translate analytical needs into well-defined workstreams and communicate findings through data storytelling that connects insight to business priorities and drives action.
Own your analytical backlog — prioritise, set realistic expectations, and manage delivery independently.
Flag potential bias, fairness issues, or unintended consequences in analytical outputs and model inputs before they reach decisions.

AI/ML & GenAI

Build and maintain feature engineering pipelines and evaluation frameworks that enable AI/ML model development.
Use tools like Copilot (code completion) and Claude or ChatGPT (summarisation, documentation, data exploration) to accelerate analytical tasks — anchored to specific, validated workflows.
Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to ensure analytical outputs meet model input requirements (schema, distribution, data quality).

Skills & Experience

Education

Degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Natural Sciences, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Experience

3–6 years in business analytics or data analysis, ideally in a complex, large-scale data environment.
Proven track record delivering end-to-end analytical projects — from scoping through to stakeholder action.
Experience working in or alongside product or platform teams.
Hands-on use of AI tools (Copilot, LLM-based analysis, prompt engineering) as part of analytical or engineering workflows is a strong advantage.

Technical Skills

Strong SQL proficiency for extraction, transformation, and modelling across large datasets.
Python for data manipulation, analysis, and automation (pandas, numpy, and similar libraries).
Azure and Databricks experience; familiarity with data pipeline development, data modelling concepts, and data quality best practices.
Power BI or equivalent, with the ability to build clear, decision-oriented dashboards.
Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and how analytical pipelines feed into model development; practical use of AI coding tools (Copilot) and LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for analytical tasks — with the judgement to validate outputs and know their limits.

Behaviours & Mindset

Proactive and self-directed — you identify problems before being asked and take ownership.
Structured problem-solver — you break ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical tasks and communicate findings to diverse audiences without losing rigour.
Collaborative and stakeholder-savvy — you understand that great analytics only creates value when trusted and acted upon, and balance high standards with pragmatism about what fits the decision at hand.
AI-critical — you use GenAI tools effectively but validate outputs, flag governance concerns, and apply your own judgement before acting on recommendations.

Title: Business Intelligence (BI) Developer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
As Our Next Business Intelligence (BI) Developer You Can Play a Key Role in Shaping Our Company Strategy

You will work with diverse modern data platforms and support valuable data-driven decision-making. The role involves responsibility for designing, developing, and optimizing data pipelines while creating insightful reports and dashboards for a variety of stakeholders.

Get To Know Us

The RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing specialist insurance solutions across multiple lines of business in close partnership with leading insurance companies.

We are a global company of more than 325 employees, collaborating across borders while leveraging local market expertise in 17 locations. We combine deep underwriting expertise with hands-on, in-house claims handling, and high-quality internal business support, to deliver outstanding service and results to the market.

With us, you are trusted with responsibility. We invest in your development, value initiative, and give you the opportunity to shape your role, grow your expertise, and make a real impact.

About Your Team

You will join our Business Intelligence team, which currently consists of three members across Europe. You will join a small, highly skilled sub-team within our growing global IT function, working within the global Finance and Operations department. Our IT team brings together talented IT professionals across Denmark and the UK, combining strong technical talent with extensive insurance industry experience.

Your colleagues form part of our wider global IT team, operating across 17 countries, with 23 experts internationally.

What Will You Do?

Your work will directly to support data-driven decisions across the entire company and therefore we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented and a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills.

You will collaborate with colleagues across the entire company and work closely with key stakeholders, including analysts, to ensure a solid understanding of data requirements and delivery of optimized reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights.

Key responsibilities include:


Collaborating with analysts & internal stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver optimized reports
Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data platforms to support various business needs
Implementing data integrations solutions using ETL tools
Ensuring data quality and integrity across all data platforms
Monitoring and troubleshooting data issues to maintain reliability
Staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends to continuously improve the data architecture and BI capabilities


This position is newly created to support our growth strategy and add further value to the team. You will have the opportunity to bring your experience and insights, whilst learning new skills, and developing your career.

This position will be based in Copenhagen and is office based.

About You

We are looking for someone with a strong technical background and a proven ability to deliver results that support the business, while working effectively with stakeholders across an international organization. You should be a self-starter, who is curious, comfortable working autonomously, and has ambition to drive change. An interest in coaching and developing others is also an advantage.

To be successful in this role, you should have:


A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
5 or more years of professional experience in BI development
An excellent understanding of SQL with professional experience on top data platforms (e.g., PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL, Snowflake)
Experience deploying and managing data solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
Proficiency in at least one programming language; e.g., Python, Go, or Java
Experience creating reports and dashboards using BI tools like Power BI, Terraform, or Tableau
Hands-on experience designing and implementing ETL processes
A strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and database design
A proven track record of working effectively in a team, communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and solving complex data problems


Experience with the following is preferred but not required:


Large-scale data processing technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Iceberg)
Modern data tools like Trino and dbt (data build tool)
Terraform for infrastructure as code
DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD pipelines, version control)


You must have current residency in Denmark with the necessary work and residency permits in place before applying.

Spoken and written fluency in English is essential for this role, ideally together with a basic understanding of Danish. Other languages are an advantage.

How Do You Apply?

We are looking forward to receiving your CV and responses to the application questions. Please apply in English.

We wish to receive your application by August 3, 2026.

For more information, please contact Zubair Sabir, CTO via *protected email*.

Please note that we do not accept applications via e-mail. All further communication will be in English.

About The RiskPoint Group

The RiskPoint Group is one of Europe’s largest Managing General Underwriters (MGUs), providing best in class insurance solutions to businesses and their advisors globally. The RiskPoint Group operates as RiskPoint in Europe and Asia and RP Underwriting in the rest of the world.

With 325+ employees and 18 locations in Europe, North America, and Asia Pacific, the RiskPoint Group employs expert underwriting and specialized, in-house claims teams within Accident & Health, Transactional Risk, Property & Construction, Renewable Energy, Offshore Upstream, and Liabilities, including Financial Lines, Cyber, and Casualty.

The RiskPoint Group is a Coverholder with Lloyd’s of London and is backed by a strong panel of well-reputed insurance companies. The RiskPoint Group core values are: trust, openness & honesty, respect & tolerance, drive & dedication as well as being part of a winning team in a competitive environment.

Title: Dataanalytiker til Capital Market Development
Description:
Er du dygtig til at gennemskue og skabe mening i data, og har du erfaring med programmering? Tiltaler komplekse finansielle produkter og markeder dig? Så har vi en spændende mulighed i vores afdeling CMD Data & Derivatives.

Vi søger en ny dataanalytiker til vores team Quantitative Market Data (QMD), som kommer til at spille en central rolle i opbygningen af et solidt datafundament og udviklingen af datadrevne løsninger til kapitalmarkedsområdet i Jyske Bank – herunder understøttelse af vores kommende AI-løsninger.

Bliv en del af et ambitiøst og stærkt fagligt miljø

Capital Market Development leverer løsninger og koncepter til bankens kapitalmarkedsområde, der understøtter handel med en bred portefølje af finansielle instrumenter - primært for store erhvervs- og institutionelle kunder. Området består af ca. 50 specialister fordelt i tre afdelinger.

Du vil blive en del af Quantitative Market Data (QMD), hvor du sammen med dygtige kolleger inden for både IT og analyse arbejder tæt på forretningen med data som omdrejningspunkt.

Som en del af vores AI-satsning arbejder vi med at bringe data og modeller i anvendelse i nye forretningsmæssige sammenhænge, hvor et godt datafundament er afgørende. Du får derfor mulighed for at være med helt fremme i udviklingen af nye datadrevne løsninger.

Arbejd med komplekse data – og skab konkrete resultater

Ansvarsområderne i QMD er centreret omkring data og dataunderstøttelse af processer. En vigtig del af rollen er at skabe struktur og sammenhæng i data gennem modellering, så vi kan arbejde ud fra et fælles og konsistent datagrundlag.

Som dataanalytiker vil du:



Sparre med brugere og interessenter om anvendelse af kapitalmarkedsdata
Udvikle løsninger selvstændigt og i tæt samarbejde med områdets IT-udviklere
Identificere og omsætte forretningsbehov til datadrevne løsninger
Bidrage til analyser, modeller og værktøjer – herunder datagrundlag til AI-anvendelser
Arbejde med data fra strukturering til færdig implementering



Opgaverne varierer, men har altid afsæt i data og en ambition om at skabe målbar værdi.

Om dig og dine kvalifikationer

Du har en relevant faglig baggrund – fx cand.oecon, cand.scient.oecon eller lignende – og motiveres af at arbejde med data i en kompleks forretning.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:



Har gode analytiske evner og arbejder struktureret
Har forståelse for værktøjer der anvendes til dataanalyse og formår at omsætte denne viden til forretningsmæssig værdi
Har erfaring med at bruge AI-værktøjer og er nysgerrig på at udvikle dine kompetencer yderligere
Har interesse for programmering (gerne erfaring med SQL, R eller lignende)
Kan omsætte komplekse behov til konkrete løsninger
Er samarbejdsorienteret og bidrager engageret i dit team
Kommunikerer klart og formidler komplekse emner enkelt



Erfaring med finansielle produkter er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Hos os bliver du en del af et team med høj faglighed, stor indflydelse og kort vej fra idé til implementering. Vi arbejder i et miljø med godt samarbejde, høj motivation og fokus på løbende udvikling – både fagligt og personligt.

Ansøgning

Vi oplever mangfoldighed som en fordel i vores opgaveløsning og i vores fællesskab. Derfor opfordrer vi alle til at søge.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV og et motiveret skriv, hvor du beskriver dine færdigheder i forhold til jobbet og din bevæggrund for at søge hos os. Rekrutteringsprocessen varetages i samarbejde med HR Rekrutteringspartner Jens Trøst Poulsen.

Seneste ansøgningsfrist er d. 14. august 2026.

Title: Digital Solution Engineer – Offshore Wind Industry
Place: Vejle, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about developing, maintaining, and analysing data? Do you want to work in the offshore wind industry where your skills and expertise will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then keep reading – Cadeler is looking for a Digital Solution Engineer with your skills and interests!

Cadeler is a global partner in the offshore wind industry, specializing in wind farm construction and maintenance. We are part of an industry that is now, more than ever, both relevant and play a critical role in the energy transition with a strong long-term outlook. As our industry continues to develop, so do we! We are now looking for a Digital Solution Engineer to help optimise our operational performance within jacking and monopile installation.

What will you do?

As our new Digital Solution Engineer, you will act as a bridge between offshore operational teams and onshore engineering by translating operational data into actionable insights. Furthermore, you will work hand-in-hand with the BI team regarding the data platform, data validation, and the development of dashboards.

Your Main Tasks Include


Analyse operational data from vessel systems, jacking logs, geotechnical data, and installation records.
Develop dashboards and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Python-based dashboards, or similar) based on Cadeler’s data platform.
Identify trends, deviations, and performance improvement opportunities based on installation and jacking data. Support root cause analysis of operational events using data-driven methodologies.
Identify, propose, and refine engineering performance metrics in collaboration with the Operational Excellence and BI teams
Identify opportunities for performance optimization, cost reduction, and risk mitigation using data analytics.
Engage with clients when data-driven reporting or performance analysis is required


To succeed in this role

Being part of the Cadeler community means you will have a natural interest and care for the environment and our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Your environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for someone with a strong analytical and structured mindset, who possesses strong communication skills and is driven by curiosity and motivation to improve operations through digital solutions.

We think you will be a good match if you:


2–5 years of relevant experience
Academic degree in engineering (civil, mechanical, geotechnical, marine) or data science with strong technical/engineering exposure.
Experience with data analysis tools such as Python, Power BI, SQL, or similar.
Hands-on experience working with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake or equivalent technologies)
Experience in offshore wind, marine operations, heavy lift, or jack-up vessels is an advantage but not mandatory.
Experience working with large datasets and operational performance analysis.


Come work with us!

By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler is headquartered in Copenhagen, but we also have offices in Vejle, UK, US, and Taiwan, as well as colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIV).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Do you want to gain a deep understanding of the power market and contribute directly to trading decisions? Do you thrive in a high‑paced, data‑driven environment where your analytical skills shape tomorrow’s strategies? If you’re ready for a role with real responsibility and impact, join our team as a Quantitative Analyst and help drive disciplined, high‑quality trading outcomes.




We are seeking a highly motivated individual with strong quantitative skills to join our team as a Quantitative Analyst. In this role, you will work closely with the team, applying data‑driven insights, modelling, and risk thinking to take ownership of disciplined trading decisions. Your ability to transform analysis and code into actionable insights will directly contribute to improving the quality and profitability of our trading decisions.




In this role, you will gain deep insights into our trading strategies and tools that provide a significant competitive advantage. You can expect a steep learning curve and growth opportunities in an environment where flat hierarchy and team spirit drive our success. You will experience a high degree of autonomy and see your own ideas come to life and see your ideas quickly evolve into tangible solutions that make a meaningful impact on our trading operations.




Key Responsibilities

Market Analysis: Conduct in-depth, data‑driven analysis of power markets including supply and demand fundamentals, regulatory developments, weather‑driven patterns, and geopolitical impacts to uncover actionable trading opportunities and support strategic decision‑making.
Risk Management: Implement robust risk management practices by monitoring position limits, conducting stress testing, and assessing exposure to volatile market conditions to ensure controlled and compliant trading activities.
Tool Development: Develop, maintain, and optimize a range of analytical, real‑time monitoring, and reporting tools that enhance trading decision‑making and operational efficiency. Build automated dashboards and data pipelines to produce accurate, timely reports on trading performance, risk metrics, and key market trends.
Model Development: Continuously improve trading models through back testing and market‑driven data analysis to strengthen and support profitable trading decisions.
Collaboration: Work closely with the team to enhance trading strategies and technical setup, ensuring clear and consistent communication across all team members.
Trading Application: Apply insights from analysis, modelling and risk assessment to confidently support and execute well‑founded trading decisions that meet all required risk, compliance, and performance standards.




Qualifications and Requirements

As a candidate, we expect you:

Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mathematics‑economics, economics, statistics, engineering, or another quantitative field.
Have strong quantitative and analytical skills to interpret complex data and translate it into well‑founded trading insights.
Are proficient in Python and comfortable with coding. Experience with other code languages is considered an advantage.
Have a strong interest in financial and energy markets and a desire to deepen your understanding of power‑market dynamics.
Demonstrate excellent problem‑solving skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to adapt quickly to changing market conditions.
Communicate clearly and effectively, presenting technical and analytical concepts in a way that is easy for both technical and non‑technical team members to understand.




What We Offer

As an employer, we offer:

A full-time position that gives you the opportunity to apply your acquired skills.
Support in your role from experienced professionals.
Access to unique technologies and resources.
An opportunity to work at the forefront of power trading, contributing to groundbreaking strategies.
Opportunities for career growth and advancement.
Competitive compensation package.
A modern office in the heart of Aarhus.
Professional and committed colleagues with high ambitions.
Inspiring, collaborative, and innovative work environment.
A place where your contributions are recognized and have a meaningful impact on the company's success.




A Profitable Growth Company with a Clear Vision

ENZEE is an ambitious growth company specialized in energy trading across the European continent. We envision a sustainable world and therefore, every day at ENZEE is a day with purpose. We belief that well-functioning and efficient energy markets are a necessity towards a net zero future which is exactly where we contribute with our expertise.




The ENZEE team consists of highly qualified, experienced, and knowledgeable industry professionals with a wide range of expertise in the energy markets. As a member of our team, you can expect a steep learning curve, great career growth opportunities, and the possibility of making a significant contribution.




Jobstart & Type

Full-time position
Location: Aarhus




Please note that there is no application deadline for this position. Due to summer vacation, we will begin reviewing applications in week 34. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis after week 34, and we encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.




ENZEE is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and therefore we encourage all candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disabilities.




If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact us at recruitment@enzeecommodities.com. Inquiries will be answered from week 34.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Sønderborg, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to work for a company with solutions that contributes to Saab’s mission of keeping people and society safe?

Would you like to be a part of shaping the Future of Digital Engineering and building the Future of Engineering?

Engineering is evolving rapidly. Model Based Systems Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, connected engineering data, and digital collaboration are transforming how complex systems are designed and delivered.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help build the data foundation that enables modern engineering. You will connect engineering data, improve digital workflows, and prepare the organization for AI enabled engineering.

Your role

You will:


Develop data pipelines and system integrations across engineering tools
Improve data quality, consistency, governance, and traceability
Support Digital Thread and MBSE initiatives
Prepare engineering data for AI and advanced analytics
Design scalable data models and dashboards
Identify opportunities to automate engineering processes
Collaborate with engineers, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver practical solutions



Your Profile

You have experience in one or more of the following areas:


Data Engineering
Software Engineering
Systems Engineering
Data Science
Computer Science
Information Technology



Experience with Python, SQL, APIs, cloud platforms, Power BI, graph databases, engineering lifecycle tools, or AI technologies is an advantage but not a requirement.

More important than your exact background is your ability to solve complex problems, connect information, and turn data into business value.

We Are Looking For Someone Who


Thinks analytically and works in a structured way
Enjoys collaborating across technical disciplines
Is curious about new technologies and continuous improvement
Can translate engineering challenges into digital solutions
Takes ownership and delivers pragmatic results



Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, data, and emerging technologies.

Your work will help accelerate Digital Engineering, strengthen MBSE adoption, improve engineering efficiency, and establish the foundation for future AI capabilities.

If you want to build solutions that will influence how engineering is performed in the years ahead, we would like to hear from you.

What can you expect from us?

Saab Danmark is a company that is growing and you will therefore experience a company that is dynamic and able to adapt. In the Saab group we have a saying” Business is done between people”, and this is also the environment you can expect here. We offer:


Initial learning process with mentorship and support
Good career and development opportunities in a professional company
A vibrant and international atmosphere with colleagues from all over the world
Benefits that support our employees’ wellbeing
A variety of social activities, lunch scheme, pension as well as flexible work conditions
Focus on our teams, good cooperation and giving our employees the ability to take ownership of their tasks.



Candidates must be able to obtain a security clearance by the Danish Defence Intelligence Service. This entails that candidates, as a minimum, have had residency within NATO/EU for the last 7 years.

About Saab Danmark A/S

Saab in Denmark is part of the Saab Group with headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. At the same time, Saab Danmark is an independent legal company with a flat organisational structure. Our main business area is delivering integrated communication solutions to military markets in Denmark and abroad.

You can find further information about our integrated communication solution TactiCall, at www.saab.com/naval.

Title: Business Analyst - FP&A
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Role

We're seeking a driven Business Analyst to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and contribute to data-driven decisions from day one in a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and Product Owners. You'll play a key role in turning data into actionable insights with an analytical approach, including testing hypotheses, doing in-depth analysis and presenting findings for key stakeholders. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:


Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.
Assist with invoicing processes and mature existing logic towards a more automated process.
Structure and analyse raw data, translate business needs into data requirements, and collaborate with Tech on onboarding and integration.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations) to test what works before scaling.
Apply modelling techniques in Python (classification, regression, clustering, segmentation) where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Build and enhance Power BI reports using our Microsoft Fabric data platform, supporting both management and internal stakeholders.


What We Are Looking For In You


Experience in a commercial analytics, FP&A, consulting, or business analyst role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Excel and Power BI skills. Comfortable building reports and analytical views on a modern data platform (Microsoft Fabric or equivalent).
Experience with experimentation and hypothesis testing (A/B tests, causal inference and OLS).
Working Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn). Able to build and interpret classification, regression, and clustering models for commercial questions - not building production pipelines.
Strong commercial instinct. Comfortable presenting findings to senior stakeholders and translating numbers into recommendations.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open commercial question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis.
Interest in applied AI/ML - e.g. using LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows.


Why Join Us?


Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.


Great To Have (But Not Required)


Exposure to Power BI, SQL, DAX, Python, and/or Power Query.
ML & AI intuition, such as K-fold cross-validation, exploiting gradients and similar.
Familiarity with FP&A concepts: budgeting, variance analysis, forecasting cycles.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing


What we do at OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

Who We Are At OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Please note interviews for this role will be conducted in September

Title: Advanced Analytics Specialist, Supply Chain Intelligence
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about driving high-impact projects in a global supply chain? Do you want to play a key role in delivering transformational initiatives that shape how Ambu scales, operates, and delivers value to patients worldwide?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to shape how intelligence drives our supply chain.

We have recently evolved our analytics function into a Supply Chain Intelligence team within our Global Supply Chain organization, and we are seeking an Advanced Analytics Specialist to join us. The team’s ambition is clear: moving from describing what happened to knowing what to do next. You will play a central role in delivering this journey; building predictive and prescriptive models, enabling what-if scenarios and decision support, and strengthening the data foundation that underpins it all; while helping build a data-driven culture across the global supply chain.

At Ambu, we are on an ambitious growth journey - scaling our operations and capabilities to meet the rising global demand for our innovative medical solutions. As part of this journey, you will join a highly motivated team that values initiative, impact, and collaboration; and you will have a front-row seat in maturing how data and intelligence power our global supply chain.

The role

As an Advanced Analytics Specialist, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and deploy analytics solutions that move our global supply chain from descriptive dashboards to predictive and prescriptive intelligence. You will work across our five focus areas: data foundation, reporting & visibility, advanced analytics, decision support, and analytics enablement; with the greatest emphasis on advanced analytics and decision support.

This is a hands-on role where technical depth meets business-centric problem-solving. Working closely with the Advanced Analytics Manager, GSC, you will partner with stakeholders across corporate functions and manufacturing sites – bridging business and IT – to ensure that data becomes a strategic asset embedded in how Ambu’s supply chain makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced analytics & decision support (primary focus)


Develop, deploy, and maintain predictive and prescriptive models (e.g., forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization) that address concrete supply chain challenges across planning, operations, and distribution
Build what-if scenario and simulation capabilities that give leadership actionable decision support; not just reporting
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems, and analytical results into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership
Automate recurring analyses and workflows to free capacity across the organization for higher-value work
Take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from problem framing and data preparation to model deployment in collaboration with back-end IT, monitoring, and adoption


Data foundation, visibility & analytics enablement


Contribute to advancing our data foundation toward a single source of truth; improving data quality, governance, and data models in collaboration with IT
Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and standard GSC reporting where they create genuine visibility and value
Support upskilling across the global supply chain through training, documentation, and self-service enablement; helping embed a data-driven culture
Stay curious about new technologies (AI, machine learning, modern analytics tooling) and proactively bring relevant opportunities into the team


Suggested candidate profile

Skills

Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have:


2–5 years of experience in analytics, data science, or business intelligence roles. You may have gained your experience in a consultancy, an industrial company, or a data-driven scale-up
Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python (or R) for data preparation, analysis, and modelling
Solid experience with Power BI – including DAX and data modelling – and an eye for visualizations that drive decisions
Experience building predictive models (e.g., forecasting or machine learning) and bringing at least one into real operational use; you know the difference between a notebook and a solution people rely on
Strong business translation skills; you can turn a vague business question into an analytical approach, and an analytical result into a clear recommendation
A working understanding of supply chain processes (e.g., planning, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution); you don't need to be a supply chain expert, but you can speak the language of operations and understand the physical flows behind the data
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills; you build trust quickly and collaborate effectively across functions and levels
A proactive, structured and independent way of working: you thrive in a maturing environment where you help build the way, not just follow it


It is an advantage if you have experience with the following:


Deeper experience within supply chain planning, S&OP, or distribution analytics
ERP data (e.g., Infor), cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Fabric), or optimization and simulation techniques
Experience in integrating new data (e.g., through API/EDI) into database and semantic models
Experience in training or upskilling non-technical colleagues
Exposure to a GxP-regulated industry


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process at the beginning of August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Are you passionate about driving high-impact projects in a global supply chain? Do you want to play a key role in delivering transformational initiatives that shape how Ambu scales, operates, and delivers value to patients worldwide?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to shape how intelligence drives our supply chain.

We have recently evolved our analytics function into a Supply Chain Intelligence team within our Global Supply Chain organization, and we are seeking an Advanced Analytics Specialist to join us. The team’s ambition is clear: moving from describing what happened to knowing what to do next. You will play a central role in delivering this journey; building predictive and prescriptive models, enabling what-if scenarios and decision support, and strengthening the data foundation that underpins it all; while helping build a data-driven culture across the global supply chain.

At Ambu, we are on an ambitious growth journey - scaling our operations and capabilities to meet the rising global demand for our innovative medical solutions. As part of this journey, you will join a highly motivated team that values initiative, impact, and collaboration; and you will have a front-row seat in maturing how data and intelligence power our global supply chain.

The role

As an Advanced Analytics Specialist, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and deploy analytics solutions that move our global supply chain from descriptive dashboards to predictive and prescriptive intelligence. You will work across our five focus areas: data foundation, reporting & visibility, advanced analytics, decision support, and analytics enablement; with the greatest emphasis on advanced analytics and decision support.

This is a hands-on role where technical depth meets business-centric problem-solving. Working closely with the Advanced Analytics Manager, GSC, you will partner with stakeholders across corporate functions and manufacturing sites – bridging business and IT – to ensure that data becomes a strategic asset embedded in how Ambu’s supply chain makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced analytics & decision support (primary focus)

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain predictive and prescriptive models (e.g., forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization) that address concrete supply chain challenges across planning, operations, and distribution
  • Build what-if scenario and simulation capabilities that give leadership actionable decision support; not just reporting
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems, and analytical results into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership
  • Automate recurring analyses and workflows to free capacity across the organization for higher-value work
  • Take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from problem framing and data preparation to model deployment in collaboration with back-end IT, monitoring, and adoption

Data foundation, visibility & analytics enablement

  • Contribute to advancing our data foundation toward a single source of truth; improving data quality, governance, and data models in collaboration with IT
  • Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and standard GSC reporting where they create genuine visibility and value
  • Support upskilling across the global supply chain through training, documentation, and self-service enablement; helping embed a data-driven culture
  • Stay curious about new technologies (AI, machine learning, modern analytics tooling) and proactively bring relevant opportunities into the team

Suggested candidate profile

Skills

Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have:

  • 2–5 years of experience in analytics, data science, or business intelligence roles. You may have gained your experience in a consultancy, an industrial company, or a data-driven scale-up
  • Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python (or R) for data preparation, analysis, and modelling
  • Solid experience with Power BI – including DAX and data modelling – and an eye for visualizations that drive decisions
  • Experience building predictive models (e.g., forecasting or machine learning) and bringing at least one into real operational use; you know the difference between a notebook and a solution people rely on
  • Strong business translation skills; you can turn a vague business question into an analytical approach, and an analytical result into a clear recommendation
  • A working understanding of supply chain processes (e.g., planning, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution); you don't need to be a supply chain expert, but you can speak the language of operations and understand the physical flows behind the data
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills; you build trust quickly and collaborate effectively across functions and levels
  • A proactive, structured and independent way of working: you thrive in a maturing environment where you help build the way, not just follow it

It is an advantage if you have experience with the following:

  • Deeper experience within supply chain planning, S&OP, or distribution analytics
  • ERP data (e.g., Infor), cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Fabric), or optimization and simulation techniques
  • Experience in integrating new data (e.g., through API/EDI) into database and semantic models
  • Experience in training or upskilling non-technical colleagues
  • Exposure to a GxP-regulated industry

Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process at the beginning of August.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Do you have a strategic and analytical mindset? Do you possess a proactive attitude and thrive in a data-driven decision making environment? Do you fancy a career as a data scientist in Denmark’s largest retailer?

Then you might be our new colleague

We are looking for a business minded data scientist to be part of our Business Analysis team in Netto Finance, located at Netto HQ in Køge.

You and the team have the responsibility of driving strategic projects across business units utilizing and processing the huge amount of data available in Salling Group leading to insights that enable more informed business decision-making creating a difference for our customers.

Your Tasks And Responsibilities


Through data analyses create insights to support core retail and finance processes
Together with the team, design, develop and implement tools and models that utilize the data to create business impact in new ways
Ensure efficient data availability including tailor-build tools
Support the general data-driven transformation in Salling Group


Your Skills And Background

You have a Master’s degree within economics, IT or engineering (e.g. cand.scient, cand.oecon, cand.merc). Preferably, you have a couple of years’ of experience as a data scientist or in a similar role, where you have acquired the necessary skills to succeed as a data scientist.

Alternatively, you compensate for your lack of experience by being a top-performer and by having relevant experience in a student job during your studies. You have a natural interest in data and how it can be utilized to create business impact. Beside your passion for data, you have a strong business acumen enabling you to utilize the right data and making the best analysis for the problem at hand.

You have an analytical mindset, a structured way of working and is a real problem-solver. You have experience with extracting, cleaning and transforming data as well as data modelling creating measures and reports that fuel solid business decisions across Salling Group.

You have experience with programming/scripting languages such as R, Python, DAX and SQL.

As a person you are curious of nature and have an eagerness to take on a very steep learning-curve. You are proactive and have a ‘self-starter attitude’ and can independently focus, see opportunities and invite yourself to the table.

Fluency in Danish is an advantage.

We offer


An exciting career with a steep learning curve in an international company in continued growth, giving you extensive opportunity for both personal and professional growth
A diversified job with impact and responsibilities
Being part of a highly professional team in a dynamic environment offering you deep insights in retail
Competitive salary package and benefits


Are you the person for the job?

Send your application, resume and copy of your grades as soon as possible - and no later than August 14th 2026.

Please note that applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis and therefore the job application may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have proceeded with candidates to the screening or interview phase

Title: Datakonsulent til udvikling af fælles dataløsninger inden for indkøb og logistik
Description:
Datakonsulent til udvikling af fælles dataløsninger inden for indkøb og logistik,

Vil du være med til at udvikle datadrevne løsninger, der understøtter indkøbs-og logistikfunktionerne i Region Midtjyllands sundhedsvæsen?

Samt være en del af et datateam i udvikling?

Vi udvider teamet fra fire til fem medarbejdere og søger derfor en dygtig datakonsulent eller BI-udvikler, der vil være med til at udvikle fælles dataløsninger til fællesfunktionen for Indkøb og Medicoteknik.

Vi søger dig der har stærke tekniske kompetencer, har et skarpt blik for de fælles digitale løsninger og evnen til at omsætte komplekse data til indsigter, der skaber værdi for organisationen.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt datateam

I Indkøb & Medicoteknik kommer du til at arbejde i afdelingens datateam, der er en del af en tværgående stabsfunktion. Teamet har specialiseret sig inden for indkøbs- og logistikdata samt data omkring medicoteknisk udstyr.

Datateamet arbejder med hele BI-processen – fra ETL, datakvalitet og datamodellering til automatiseringer, rapportering og visualisering. Datateamet spiller en vigtig rolle i forhold til behovs- og procesafklaring omkring anvendelse af data i afdelingen. Teamet har ofte en aktiv rolle i hele processen fra koncept til endelig implementering af dataløsninger.

Du vil derfor få en bred kontaktflade til afdelingens mange fagspecialister inden for indkøb, logistik, bæredygtighed og medicoteknik.

Du kan forvente at skulle arbejde både selvstændigt ude i organisationen og som en del af et teknisk stærkt team, hvor du får mulighed for faglig sparring og udvikling. Vi har ligeledes tætte samarbejdsflader med regionens hospitaler og regionens afdeling for Digitalisering og IT.

Primære arbejdsopgaver i stillingen

For at sikre en stærk og robust datafunktion søger vi en kollega med kompetencer inden for især anvendelse af indkøbs- og logistikdata.

Udvikling og implementering af datadrevne løsninger via regionens standardværktøjer er hovedfokus i stillingen. Disse værktøjer er MSSQL til databaser, Tableau til visualiseringer og UiPath/Python til automatiseringer, hvilket derfor også vil være dine primære værktøjer i arbejdet. Vores indkøbs- og logistikdata stammer primært fra SAP S/4HANA-platformen, hvorfor kendskab til denne vil være en fordel.

Vores Opgaveportefølje Er Bred, Men Ofte Bygger Vi Driftsorienterede Værktøjer Med Udgangspunkt i Data Og Afdelingens Strategiske Målsætninger. Herunder Kan Nævnes Nogle Eksempler På Opgaver


Automatiseret berigelse af masterdata i vores varekatalog.
Automatisering af manuelle processer i forbindelse med de administrative dele af varehåndteringen.
Beslutningsstøtteværktøjer til varelogistikdrift for regionslager og ude på hospitalerne.
Løbende udvidelse og anvendelse af datagrundlag forbundet med hele processen fra indkøb til anvendelse af produkter fra leverandørerne.
Udvikling og implementering af KPI’er til opfølgning på tværs af hele indkøbsprocessen.


Vi søger en kollega, der


Har en relevant akademisk uddannelse inden for økonomi, logistik eller samfundsvidenskab, f.eks. Cand.merc., Cand.oecon. eller tilsvarende uddannelser på bachelorniveau.
Kan arbejde selvstændigt med kompleks databehandling og datamodellering samt skabe robuste dataløsninger.
Har et par års erfaring med Python, SQL og/eller Tableau.
Har kendskab til RPA-software (ideelt UiPath) eller VBA. Det vil være et plus, men ikke et krav.
Har dokumenteret erfaring med at omsætte komplekse problemstillinger gennem datamæssig forståelse og viden til konkrete tiltag og nye løsninger.
Kan drive processer gennem en vedholdende, imødekommende og positiv tilgang og kan lide at kommunikere med forskellige faggrupper.
Er initiativrig, engageret, ansvarsbevidst og er nysgerrig på den organisation, du bliver en del af.


Vi kan tilbyde dig

Indkøb & Medicoteknik tilbyder en attraktiv arbejdsplads og et meningsfyldt arbejde. Vi arbejder for, at det skal være nemt at være medarbejder og sikkert at være patient i Region Midtjylland.

Du kommer til at arbejde et sted med spændende og varierende opgaver, dygtige kolleger og samarbejdspartnere samt med gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.

Humor, trivsel og en uformel kultur vægtes højt på vores arbejdsplads. Det samme gør fleksibilitet. Det er vigtigt, at du har tid til et liv ved siden af arbejdet. Vi har derfor en flekstidsordning og mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra op til 2 dage om ugen.

Derudover har vi et sundhedsudvalg, der løbende afholder forskellige arrangementer.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Hovedtjenestestedet er Indkøb & Medicoteknik, Olof Palmes Allé 15, 8200 Aarhus N.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer inkl. betalt frokostpause og med flekstidsordning.

Ansættelsen sker med reference til områdelederen i Økonomi- og Dataenheden.

Dine løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Lønnen består af en grundløn evt. suppleret med funktions- og/eller kvalifikationstillæg, som fastsættes ud fra stillingens indhold samt dine kompetencer, erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Vi ønsker at ansætte med opstart 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt herefter.

Yderligere oplysninger

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til:


Områdeleder Astrid Kriegbaum Westphael på tlf. 2334 7977 eller via mail astwes@rm.dk
BI-udvikler Kim Skov Rasmussen på tlf. 3036 3169 eller via mail kimsrs@rm.dk


Grundet ferieafholdelse bedes du sende en sms i ugerne 29 til 31, så finder vi et tidspunkt til en snak.

Ansøgningsfrist

Ansøgningsfristen er tirsdag den 18. august 2026.

Samtaler afholdes mandag den 24. august 2026.

En eventuel 2. samtalerunde afholdes onsdag den 26. august 2026. Der indkaldes med kort varsel til begge samtalerunder.

Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores elektroniske rekrutteringssystem. Vælg det anførte link for at søge stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Bliv en del af en spændende afdeling

Indkøb & Medicoteknik Er En Regionsdækkende Enhed Med Ca. 200 Ansatte, Som Har Ansvaret For Indkøb, Logistik Og Medicoteknik i Hele Region Midtjylland


Vi står for alle regionens udbud, indkøbsaftaler og kontrakter,
Vi har ansvaret for varelogistikken, lige fra varen bestilles, til den leveres rette sted i regionen, hvilket også indebærer regionens fælleslager, der drives af en privat partner,
Vi anskaffer, drifter og vedligeholder det medicotekniske udstyr på regionens hospitaler og rådgiver hospitalerne på området.


Desuden arbejder vi for en bæredygtig udvikling af regionen. Vi indtænker regionens mål om mindre CO2-aftryk, mindre affald og mere genanvendelse i opgaveløsningen på alle vores ansvarsområder. Sammen med Center for Bæredygtige Hospitaler, der er en del af Indkøb & Medicoteknik, dækker vi næsten hele opgaven med Cirkulær Økonomi i Region Midtjylland.

Læs mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på vores karriereside.

Eller få et indblik i vores hverdag på LinkedIn.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

Title: Digital Solution Engineer – Offshore Wind Industry
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about developing, maintaining, and analysing data? Do you want to work in the offshore wind industry where your skills and expertise will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then keep reading – Cadeler is looking for a Digital Solution Engineer with your skills and interests!

Cadeler is a global partner in the offshore wind industry, specializing in wind farm construction and maintenance. We are part of an industry that is now, more than ever, both relevant and play a critical role in the energy transition with a strong long-term outlook. As our industry continues to develop, so do we! We are now looking for a Digital Solution Engineer to help optimise our operational performance within jacking and monopile installation.

What will you do?

As our new Digital Solution Engineer, you will act as a bridge between offshore operational teams and onshore engineering by translating operational data into actionable insights. Furthermore, you will work hand-in-hand with the BI team regarding the data platform, data validation, and the development of dashboards.

Your Main Tasks Include


Analyse operational data from vessel systems, jacking logs, geotechnical data, and installation records.
Develop dashboards and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Python-based dashboards, or similar) based on Cadeler’s data platform.
Identify trends, deviations, and performance improvement opportunities based on installation and jacking data. Support root cause analysis of operational events using data-driven methodologies.
Identify, propose, and refine engineering performance metrics in collaboration with the Operational Excellence and BI teams
Identify opportunities for performance optimization, cost reduction, and risk mitigation using data analytics.
Engage with clients when data-driven reporting or performance analysis is required


To succeed in this role

Being part of the Cadeler community means you will have a natural interest and care for the environment and our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Your environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for someone with a strong analytical and structured mindset, who possesses strong communication skills and is driven by curiosity and motivation to improve operations through digital solutions.

We think you will be a good match if you:


2–5 years of relevant experience
Academic degree in engineering (civil, mechanical, geotechnical, marine) or data science with strong technical/engineering exposure.
Experience with data analysis tools such as Python, Power BI, SQL, or similar.
Hands-on experience working with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake or equivalent technologies)
Experience in offshore wind, marine operations, heavy lift, or jack-up vessels is an advantage but not mandatory.
Experience working with large datasets and operational performance analysis.


Come work with us!

By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler is headquartered in Copenhagen, but we also have offices in Vejle, UK, US, and Taiwan, as well as colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIV).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

Apply

Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don’t hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible and no later than the 10th of August. You can expect to hear back from us after that date, due to vacation.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Geotechnical & Jacking Engineering Team Lead, Can Mollaibrahimoglu, on (+45) 2979 9623, and for practical matters please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

Title: Quantitative analyst for Short-term Power Trading
Description:
Quote

Join a leading analysis team in short-term power trading and support the development of quantitative strategies for proprietary trading and asset optimisation.

Here’s what the job entails

In this role, you will help optimise our trading performance by developing quantitative models that impact the decision-making process across our trading teams.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:


developing and enhancing quantitative models to drive trading decisions
taking active part in coding algorithmic trading infrastructure and optimisation engines used for live trading
conducting market research and strategy analysis aimed at improving overall PnL and operational robustness
collaborating with team members to ensure the operational stability of algorithms and tools developed by the team


Meet your team

As our new quantitative analyst, you will join our Intraday Analysis team, where we support the trading and asset optimisation teams by building quantitative models and trading tools. Our primary area of responsibility is to develop strategies, trading tools, and quantitative models that enable decision-making for our proprietary trading and asset business.

We are a team of 6 specialists in energy trading with backgrounds in economics and mathematics. We are a curious, dedicated, and highly analytical team who always strive to improve processes, systems, and strategies to fine-tune the infrastructural engine of our power trading business.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be developing models and analyses used for decision-making, we are looking for someone who has a data-driven approach and an eye for market risks while also evaluating other factors in your analyses. Also, as we operate in an ever-changing market, we see you as someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and can quickly adapt to market conditions.

We also imagine that you:


have an educational background in a quantitative field, for example, economics, mathematics, physics, statistics, data science, or engineering
have experience in a similar position, either in the energy industry, the financial markets or similar
have solid coding skills with the ability to write production-level Python code
have great communication skills as you should be able to explain your analyses to stakeholders who do not have the same insights as our team
are proficient in English - both written and verbal


Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life adjustable hours, part-time options & up to 2 work from home days/week

Fuel Fridays one paid Friday off every month (July and December excluded)

Top-tier parental leave up to 26 weeks paid, pension during leave & post-leave support

Unlimited paid child's sick days because family comes first

Extra time off 5 additional days on top of your 5 weeks

Senior days extra time off if you’re 55+

Attractive package 10% pension, health insurance, bonus scheme & more

Share savings the option to join Equinor’s attractive share programme

Home setup covered paid internet, phone & IT gear

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

Barista café high-quality coffee, always on us

On-site wellness state-of-the-art gym, physio, chiro and massage therapy

New HQ in the heart of Aarhus with stunning views, inspiring architecture and close to public transport

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.
