Title: Bliv dataanalytiker i Data Governance Execution & Technology hos Nykredit
Description:
Har du solide analytiske færdigheder og erfaring med at skabe overblik over komplekse datalandskaber? Motiveres du af at afdække dataflows, forstå forretningsprocesser og omsætte teknisk indsigt til tydelig dokumentation og konkrete data governance-leverancer? Og har du lyst til at være med til at optimere vores arbejdsgange og udforske, hvordan AI kan skabe mere effektive og værdiskabende data governance-processer? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Nykredit-koncernen er ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det betyder, at vi kan dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, når det går os godt, og at vi påtager os et særligt ansvar over for det samfund, vi er en del af. Det vil du også opleve, når vi kan byde dig velkommen som dataanalytiker.

Bliv en del af Data Governance Execution & Technology

Du bliver en vigtig del af et centralt team, der arbejder med at omsætte data governance-principper til praksis på tværs af Nykredit-koncernen. I tæt samarbejde med stakeholders fra forretning, IT og andre centrale funktioner skal du bidrage til at skabe transparens, dokumentation og fremdrift i arbejdet med datakvalitet, metadata, kritiske dataelementer, kilder og lineage.

Vi arbejder samtidig målrettet med at optimere og effektivisere vores processer, blandt andet ved at udforske og anvende AI som en naturlig del af data governance-arbejdet. Med din dataforståelse og forretningsmæssige nysgerrighed vil du bidrage til at skabe sammenhæng mellem forretningsprocesser, datakilder og regulatoriske krav.

Du forventes at kunne sætte dig ind i nye og komplekse forretningsområder, forstå værdikæder og identificere, hvor data skabes, transformeres og anvendes. Arbejdet kræver dataforståelse, analytisk struktur og evnen til at samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af forretning, IT, risikoområder og vores internationale teams. Du vil også være med til at identificere muligheder for at arbejde smartere, reducere manuelle processer og øge kvaliteten i vores leverancer – eksempelvis gennem bedre brug af værktøjer, standarder, automatisering og AI-understøttelse. Data Governance Execution & Technology er placeret i Aalborg og København, og da vi arbejder tæt sammen med vores søsterteam i Polen, er det vigtigt, at du kan kommunikere professionelt på engelsk.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:


Afdække, analysere og dokumentere datakilder, dataflows og lineage i tæt dialog med forretning, IT og relevante dataejere.
Bidrage til arbejdet med datakvalitet, metadata, kritiske dataelementer og autoritative kilder, så data bliver mere forståelige, anvendelige og styrbare.
Omsætte komplekse data- og forretningsforhold til tydelig dokumentation, beslutningsgrundlag og anbefalinger for både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.
Samarbejde tæt med stakeholders på tværs af forretning, IT og internationale teams for at sikre fremdrift, fælles forståelse og compliant løsninger.
Facilitere dialog med stakeholders for at afklare dataejerskab, forretningsbetydning, anvendelse og governance-behov.
Bidrage til optimering og effektivisering af data governance-processer, herunder identificere muligheder for automatisering og relevant brug af AI til at understøtte dokumentation



Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du har en relevant uddannelse eller solid erfaring inden for dataanalyse, business analysis, systemanalyse, data governance eller lignende. Du trives med at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi og har lyst til at dykke ned i komplekse datamodeller, kildesystemer og værdikæder. Erfaring fra den finansielle sektor, regulatoriske miljøer eller arbejde med Data Governance er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du kan skabe struktur, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte kompleksitet til brugbar viden.

Vi forventer, at dit CV afspejler, at du har:


erfaring med dataanalyse, SQL, SAS eller lignende værktøjer og evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt med komplekse datasæt,
forståelse for, hvordan data bevæger sig fra kildesystemer til anvendelse, og evne til at analysere og dokumentere dataflows, afhængigheder og transformationer,
erfaring med at kortlægge forretningsprocesser, værdikæder og dataflows for at identificere, hvor og hvordan data skabes, ændres og bruges,
interesse for Data Governance, herunder datakvalitet, metadata, lineage, kritiske dataelementer og autoritative kilder,
evne til at kommunikere klart med både tekniske specialister, forretningskolleger og ledelsesinteressenter,
gerne minimum fem års erfaring med dataanalyse, governance, dokumentation, stakeholder-samarbejde eller arbejde i en reguleret branche,
interesse for optimering, automatisering og anvendelse af AI som støtte til analyse, dokumentation og mere effektive arbejdsgange.



Dit nye team

Vi er et team med høj faglighed, uformel omgangstone og frihed under ansvar. Vi arbejder målrettet med at skabe fremdrift, struktur og gennemsigtighed i Nykredit-koncernens data governance-arbejde – fra teknisk afdækning og dokumentation til konkrete leverancer, der understøtter compliance, datakvalitet og bedre anvendelse af data. Vi har samtidig fokus på at arbejde smartere og mere effektivt gennem standardisering, optimering, automatisering og relevant brug af AI. Vi er et nyetableret team med fokus på eksekvering og teknologi, og vi lykkes gennem tæt samarbejde, nysgerrighed og en fælles ambition om at skabe orden i komplekse datalandskaber.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk

Title: Product Owner & Analytics Engineer
Description:
Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens dataplatform i en af Danmarks største energivirksomheder?

Har du evnen til at forstå forretningens behov, prioritere de vigtigste indsatser og omsætte dem til dataløsninger, der skaber værdi i praksis? Så er du måske vores nye Product Owner & Analytics Engineer.

En nøglerolle i udviklingen af OK's dataplatform
Du bliver en del af Data Engineering & BI, som har en central rolle i at gøre data til et strategisk aktiv på tværs af OK. Title: BI Consultant
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in its Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the business. As part of this journey, we are modernizing how data is managed, governed, and leveraged across our global organization.

We are looking for a BI Consultant to join our Data & Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing expertise with a passion for partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful business value through data and analytics.

The role

As a BI Consultant, you will work closely with business stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to understand business challenges, define analytical requirements, and deliver reporting and analytics solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

You will play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of our enterprise data and reporting landscape while contributing to the continued development of our BI and analytics capabilities built on Microsoft Azure and Power BI.

This role requires a consultative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements and identify opportunities to create value through data and analytics
Designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI
Translating business requirements into scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions
Contributing to the development and evolution of our Enterprise Data Platform and Data Warehouse
Ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of enterprise data and reporting solutions
Supporting data governance, data quality, and master data management initiative
Driving adoption of self-service analytics and promoting best practices across the organization
Collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and other members of the Data & Analytics team


Suggested candidate profile

Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a relevant educational background within Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience delivering Business Intelligence and analytics solutions in a modern data environment.

You are someone who enjoys solving business challenges through data and turning complex requirements into meaningful insights. You are equally comfortable discussing business objectives with stakeholders and diving into the technical details of data models, reporting solutions, and analytics.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, and collaborative. You take ownership, build strong relationships across the organization, and maintain high standards for quality, professionalism, and data integrity.

More Specifically, You Bring


Around 5 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Warehousing, preferably from an international business environment
Strong experience with Power BI, including semantic modelling, DAX, and dashboard development
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with enterprise data warehouses
Experience gathering and translating business requirements into technical solutions
Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing principles
Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Data Lake) is considered an advantage
Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management principles is beneficial
Familiarity with Agile ways of working is a plus


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process in August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Business Analyst
Company: DBI The Danish Institute of Fire and Security Technology
Place: Hvidovre, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you skilled at analysing data and translating it into business-related insights for management? Do you enjoy working with Power BI, data models and business questions? Then you might be our new Business Analyst .

We offer a role where your analyses, reports and insights will help provide management and business areas with a stronger foundation for decision-making.

About The Position

Our new Business Analyst will be part of the Data and Analysis team, working with business data management and analysis. You will focus on preparing business-related analyses and reporting solutions for management and internal stakeholders, including customer engagement trends and broader business analysis

Your Tasks Would Be


Prepare business-related analyses that support management reporting and internal decision-making.
Work with SQL, Power BI models, Excel and other relevant data sources to support analyses and reporting.
Present findings, assumptions and limitations clearly within the team and in prepared reporting material.
Contribute to building, maintaining and improving Power BI reports and relevant BI files.
Help simplify dashboard logic, coding and design so reports are understandable, consistent and easy to use.
Compare data across systems when needed, for example Business Central, CRM, SQL sources and Power BI models.
Investigate differences between reports, systems and data sources when needed.
Support validation before reports, dashboards or analyses are shared more widely by checking whether figures are reliable.
Document report logic, data definitions, calculation assumptions and known data limitations.
Support a more structured and transparent reporting environment where analyses, reports and BI files can be maintained by others in the team.
Ad hoc analyses


Work collaboratively as a team to support each other in validating data, analyses and reporting tasks before they are published or shared more widely.

An exciting growth opportunity

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the further development of DBI’s Data and Analysis area. You will help reduce manual and ad hoc reporting, transform Excel-based processes into more structured reporting solutions, and improve the way data is documented, validated and used across the organisation.

You will be part of a small dynamic team with flexible working conditions

As part of our team, which consists of 2 business analysts and 2 students and the manager of the function, you will experience a collaborative and supportive environment. We value clear communication, curiosity, responsibility and mutual support.

We understand the importance of work-life balance and trust you to manage your own schedule, planning your working days in a way that aligns with both your professional responsibilities and personal needs. While enjoying this flexibility, maintaining team collaboration and meeting deadlines is crucial.

Being a team player is essential, as we rely on clear communication, knowledge sharing and support across tasks. You will work with complex data and different stakeholders, so it is important that you can ask relevant questions, handle uncertainty and follow up when clarification or validation is needed.

Your background

We imagine that you have the following background and competencies:


You hold a master’s degree in economics, data, business analytics, business intelligence or a similar relevant field.
You have at least two years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence or performance follow-up in a business context.
You have strong analytical skills and a natural ability to identify patterns, causes and inconsistencies in data.
You are curious and interested in understanding business needs and how analyses can support better decisions.
You take responsibility for the quality of your analyses and reports, and you communicate openly if something is wrong, unclear or at risk.
You are comfortable presenting and discussing your findings with management, stakeholders and your immediate leader.
You can explain data, assumptions and limitations clearly, also to people who are not data specialists.


Additionally, You Are


A fast and good learner, willing to embrace new technologies and adapt to new ways of working.
Experienced with Power BI and Excel.
Familiar with data models, measures and reporting logic.
Experienced with Power Query and DAX, or motivated to develop further in these areas.
Analytical, structured and focused on improving processes and reducing unnecessary manual work.
Good at documenting definitions, assumptions and calculation logic.


Experience with Business Central, CRM/Dataverse, SQL, Power BI Service, semantic models or cross-system data validation is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Professional English, both written and spoken, is required. Danish is an advantage, especially for stakeholder dialogue and understanding local business context, but it should not be a barrier if you have strong English communication skills and strong analytical capabilities.

DBI offers you

DBI’s most important asset is the knowledge and dedication of its employees, and we are willing to invest in that. DBI prioritises ongoing training and professional and personal development.

DBI is characterised by being a good and developing workplace where collaboration is flexible and informal. We have state-of-the-art offices and facilities, and you will enjoy good employee benefits, such as a pension scheme, dental insurance and health insurance.

We also have an active employee and art association, and our chefs prepare delicious meals for us daily.

The workplace

The workplace is DBI’s headquarters at Avedøre Holme in Hvidovre. The role is hybrid, with primary workplace at DBI’s headquarters.

Want to know more?

If you want to know more about the job, feel free to contact Head of Business Data Management and Analysis, Tina Shahsavar, at +45 21363303.

You apply for the position via the button on the right 'Apply for position'. We only receive applications through the recruitment system.

We’re now looking for an Analytics Specialist to join our Danish team. In this role, you’ll help shape the data foundation and strategy for leading brands, driving app tracking and analytics initiatives alongside a skilled team.

With solid experience in analytics and data platforms, you have a passion for creating tracking and measurement solutions. You thrive on building strong partnerships and enjoy collaborating with both colleagues and clients to share insights and expertise.

We offer a dynamic, curiosity-driven culture where innovation is at the forefront. You’ll work with some of the industry’s best in digital marketing and martech, all driven to explore new frontiers in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Design and implement comprehensive measurement plans, driving analytics solutions across both websites and mobile apps.
Maintain high data quality by diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving tracking and technical issues.
Innovate and contribute new ideas, conducting research to advance analytics capabilities and methodologies.
Provide strategic guidance to clients, helping them optimize their analytics architecture and enhance the depth and accuracy of insights.


What We Are Looking For ✔️


Expertise in Tracking Methodologies: Expertise in tagging, data layers, and server-side tracking, especially within the Google stack (Google Analytics, Tag Manager, BigQuery).
Technical Proficiency: Confident in Javascript, web technologies (e.g., cookies, HTTP requests), and product APIs.
App Analytics Knowledge (preference): In-depth understanding of app analytics tools and platforms (e.g., Firebase, Appsflyer/Adjust, Amplitude/Mixpanel, SKAdNetwork).
Stakeholder Communication & Project Management: Skilled in engaging with stakeholders and managing project timelines effectively.
Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience with tracking technologies.
High Technical Skills: Capable of guiding customers seamlessly through the integration process.


What We Offer🌟

You can read our full offering in our handbook.


An intense learning environment where you will be able to grow and develop your skills and passions alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.
A culture that is built on collaboration, trust and innovation. We value having fun together - that’s why we also have regular afterworks, team events and a yearly festival.

30 days paid leave, flexible public holidays, parental pay, a solid pension scheme and key insurances. Or different offices also offer different perks such as health care contributions, healthy snacks & great coffee, EAP programs and your choice of PC or Mac.
A diverse environment with a high focus on inclusion and belonging. We speak over 27 native languages around Precis and our internal inclusion score is 4.3 out of 5.


We are committed to building an inclusive and fair workplace that attracts talent and advances its people, regardless of their background, experiences or perspectives. We believe that a diverse set of minds will continue to contribute to our innovative culture and our ability to reinvent ourselves constantly.

Title: Power BI Developer
Description:
Vil du omsætte data til værdifulde beslutningsgrundlag i en international koncern? Som Power BI Developer får du en central rolle i udviklingen af brugervenlige Power BI-løsninger, hvor du i tæt samarbejde med forretningen skaber rapporter og dashboards, der gør en reel forskel.




Få en nøglerolle i udviklingen af forretningsnære dataløsninger

Vores kunde er en international produktionsvirksomhed med en stærk markedsposition inden for byggesektoren. Virksomheden udvikler tekniske løsninger til professionelle kunder og arbejder målrettet med innovation, kvalitet og bæredygtighed.

Netop nu leder virksomheden efter en Power BI Developer, som kan sikre teknisk korrekt, letforståelig og ikke mindst brugbare data, der understøtter forretningen.




Du vil blandt andet få følgende ansvarsområder og arbejdsopgaver:

Udvikle og designe Power BI-rapporter og dashboards med fokus på datakvalitet og ensartethed på tværs af afdelinger
Vedligeholde og optimere eksisterende rapporter, herunder performance og datalogik
Oversætte forretningsbehov til konkrete rapportløsninger
Understøtte brugertræning og adoption af Power BI på tværs af organisationen
Bidrage til en datadrevet kultur ved at gøre indsigter tilgængelige og forståelige for forretningen
Arbejde med datamodeller og dataset i tæt samarbejde med kolleger på området




Du får base i Midtjylland, hvor du bliver en del af økonomi- og IT-afdelingen med rig mulighed for indflydelse på retningen.




Du gør data til værdifulde beslutningsgrundlag

Vi leder efter dig, som kommer med solid erfaring med Power BI. Du arbejder sikkert med rapportdesign, datavisualisering og udvikling af dashboards – alt sammen med fokus på at skabe intuitive løsninger for forretningen. Samtidig har du en god forståelse for datamodellering og relationer. Derudover har du et grundlæggende kendskab til SQL, Python og Copilot/AI.




Det vigtigste er dog, at du motiveres af at omsætte komplekse data til overskuelige og handlingsorienterede indsigter. Du har en analytisk og detaljeorienteret tilgang, men formår samtidig at gøre data forståelige og anvendelige for brugere uden teknisk baggrund.

Som person er du samarbejdsorienteret, nysgerrig og proaktiv. Derfor falder det dig naturligt at indgå i dialog om rapporteringsbehov, men også selv tage initiativ til at identificere hvilke data, der skaber værdi for forretningen.




Du har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund inden for f.eks. økonomi, informationsteknologi, datavidenskab eller lignende, som er et godt supplement til din forretningsmæssige forståelse. Derudover behersker du både dansk og engelsk flydende i skrift og tale.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About the Company

Our client is a global, technology-driven systematic investment manager operating across all major liquid asset classes. With a strong culture of innovation and a scientific approach to investing, they combine cutting-edge data, research, and engineering to deliver consistent, high-quality returns.




The Role

We are looking for an exceptional Data Scientist to join a high-performing Commodities desk. Sitting at the intersection of Research, Trading, and Engineering, you will play a critical role in ensuring the firm leverages its data effectively to drive investment decisions.




What You'll Be Doing

Collaborating with the trading desk to design and implement robust data pipelines
Working alongside data engineers to onboard relevant datasets into the firm's infrastructure
Implementing data transformations to produce high-value datasets used directly in investment decisions
Writing clean, well-structured Python code to extract, clean, and aggregate data from a wide range of raw sources and formats
Managing the full end-to-end process of onboarding new datasets
Proactively identifying and solving data-related problems to minimise time to production
Experimenting with novel data extraction methods to continuously improve the firm's data toolkit




What We're Looking For

3+ years of experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar quantitative role; buy-side experience is a strong advantage
Postgraduate degree (MSc or PhD) in a quantitative discipline - Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or similar
Advanced Python skills, including strong proficiency with data handling libraries such as Pandas and NumPy
Experience working with both traditional and alternative financial datasets
A genuine interest in financial markets and data-driven analysis
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across Research, Trading, Engineering, and external vendors
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment




Why Apply?

This is a rare opportunity to join a world-class quantitative investment firm at the forefront of data-driven investing. The team offers a collaborative, intellectually rigorous environment where your work will have direct impact on the firm's investment performance.

Title: Bliv Data Analyst i EIFO – en 12-måneders tidsbegrænset stilling med fokus på data og beslutningskraft
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med Power BI, datamodellering og visuel formidling – og vil du være med til at gøre data til et endnu stærkere beslutningsgrundlag i EIFO? I Danmarks Eksport- og Investeringsfond søger vi en nysgerrig og motiveret Data Analyst til en 12-måneders tidsbegrænset ansættelse, som vil være med til at udvikle rapportering, self service-løsninger og datadrevet beslutningsstøtte på tværs af organisationen.




I EIFO er vi i fuld gang med at løfte dataområdet, så indsigt bliver til konkrete resultater i forretningen. Vores Data-afdeling er relativt ny og i hastig udvikling, og vi indgår dagligt i fire tværfaglige teams på tværs af Data & Digitalisering. I dag er vi seks dygtige kolleger med erfaring inden for bl.a. datamodellering, produktkendskab, data engineering og rapportering – og vi fungerer som ejere af EIFO’s BI-løsning.




Vi deler viden, har et højt fagligt ambitionsniveau og en kultur præget af åbenhed, engagement og lysten til at bygge noget stærkt sammen.




Vi leder efter dig, der brænder for data, har blik for forretningens behov og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til enkle og værdiskabende dataløsninger.




Din nye rolle og ansvarsområder

Som Data Analyst bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at udbrede datadrevet beslutningsstøtte i EIFO. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med både Data-teamet og forretningen om rapportering, dashboards, semantiske modeller og self service-løsninger, der gør data lettere at anvende i hverdagen.




Du får mulighed for at arbejde med hele værdikæden fra forretningsbehov til færdig dataløsning.




I praksis betyder det, at du blandt andet skal:




1) Forstå og samarbejde – Arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen for at forstå behov, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte ønsker til konkrete dataløsninger. Bidrage til at definere KPI’er, begreber og succeskriterier, så løsningerne skaber reel værdi.




2) Modellere og udvikle – Udvikle og vedligeholde Power BI-rapporter, dashboards, målinger og semantiske modeller. Arbejde med DAX, datamodellering og dokumentation, så vores rapporteringsløsninger er robuste, forståelige og nemme at anvende.




3) Enable og formidle – Understøtte forretningen i at anvende data bedre gennem dialog, sparring, træning og løbende feedback. Hjælpe brugerne med at forstå datagrundlag, rapporter og mulighederne i self service, så data bliver en naturlig del af beslutninger og arbejdsgange.




Du vil få ansvar fra start, men også støtte fra erfarne kolleger i teamet. Rollen giver mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og være med til at præge, hvordan vi arbejder med BI, self service og dataanvendelse i EIFO.




Hvem er du?

Vi ser for os en kollega, der har et godt analytisk fundament, interesse for forretningen og lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os.




Vi forestiller os, at du kan se dig selv i følgende:

Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for fx økonomi, IT, data, business analytics eller lignende.
Har 2–4 års erfaring som Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst eller i en beslægtet rolle.
Har erfaring med Power BI og interesse for at bygge brugervenlige rapporter og dashboards.
Har kendskab til DAX, datamodellering og semantiske modeller.
Har forståelse for datakvalitet, dokumentation og fælles definitioner.
Er stærk til at formidle data og komplekse problemstillinger på en enkel og forståelig måde.
Har lyst til at undervise, facilitere workshops eller træne brugere i anvendelsen af rapporter, dashboards og self service-løsninger.
Kan arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen og skabe tryghed, ejerskab og adoption omkring nye dataløsninger.
Erfaring med Microsoft Fabric eller øvrige produkter i Fabric-suiten er en fordel, men ikke et krav.




Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét – vigtigst er, at du har drivkraft, læringslyst og et teknisk fundament, som vi kan bygge videre på sammen.




Et tydeligt formål og attraktive vilkår

I EIFO arbejder du for dansk erhvervslivs fremtid – og du får mulighed for at skabe reel værdi for virksomheder, der driver vækst, grøn omstilling og innovation.




Du får:

Et spændende og udfordrende job med et klart purpose og stor samfundsmæssig betydning
En arbejdsplads præget af forretningsfokus, enkelhed og tillid i en uhøjtidelig kontekst
Attraktive vilkår, fleksibilitet og plads til både ambition og balance i arbejdslivet
Engagerede og fagligt stærke kolleger i en mangfoldig og inkluderende kultur, hvor forskellighed ses som en styrke.




Er du klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV via ansøgningssystemet senest den 10. august 2026.




Som led i vores arbejde med inkluderende rekruttering beder vi dig venligst om ikke at inkludere billede, alder og civilstand i dit ansøgningsmateriale.




Vi behandler ansøgninger efter ansøgningsfristens udløb og forventer at gennemføre samtaler i forlængelse heraf.




Stillingen er en 12-måneders tidsbegrænset ansættelse med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.




Rekrutteringsforløbet består af to samtalerunder. I forbindelse med anden samtalerunde gennemføres personligheds- og logiske tests samt en mindre caseopgave. Referencer indhentes efter aftale i den afsluttende del af processen, og straffeattest skal fremvises ved ansættelse.




Vil du høre mere? Kontakt Product Owner, Rasmus Pallesen, på rasp@eifo.dk. Vi ønsker henvendelser pr. mail. Grundet sommerperioden kan der være længere svartid end normalt, og spørgsmål forventes besvaret i uge 32. Vi sætter pris på din forståelse og tålmodighed.




Hos EIFO tror vi på, at diversitet skaber bedre løsninger – derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.




Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!




Om Danmarks Eksport- og Investeringsfond (EIFO)

Danmarks Eksport- og Investeringsfond (EIFO) er danske virksomheders fælles indgang til risikovillig statslig finansiering. Vi har et samlet forretningsomfang på omkring 150 mia. kr. og har knap 500 medarbejdere. Med professionalisme og internationalt udsyn arbejder vi hver dag for at understøtte de erhvervssucceser, der kan gøre Danmark rigere på det, der gør en forskel. EIFO er Danmarks nationale erhvervsfremmende bank, investeringsfond og Danmarks officielle eksportkreditinstitut i én og samme finansielle institution.

Title: Business Analytics Consultant
Description:
Twoday er den førende digitale transformationspartner i Nordeuropa med en global tilstedeværelse. Med cirka 3.000 teknologer samarbejder vi med de mest beundrede private og offentlige organisationer for at levere banebrydende digitale løsninger. Vores dybe brancheekspertise omfatter Data & AI, softwareudvikling, digitale oplevelser og forretningsapplikationer. Vores team, der opererer i hele Norden og Litauen, genererede en omsætning på 280 millioner euro i 2023. Vi betjener over 8.000 kunder og understøtter deres digitale transformationsrejser.

Vil du være med på Danmarks stærkeste team af Business Analytics-konsulenter? Vil du arbejde med nogle af Danmark største virksomheder? Tænder du på at gøre komplekse problemstillinger til simple løsninger for kunderne? Så er twoday Data & AI det rigtige sted for dig! Vi søger nye Business Analytics-konsulenter til et af vores kontorer i Danmark.

Title: Data Scientists for Big Data, IoT and AI projects
Description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

Do you like working creatively with data analytics, big data, AI, visualisation, NoSQL and databases? Would you like to join an international organisation where we already work with data analytics and machine learning projects? Join BEUMER Group and exploit the chance to innovate, develop and test concepts for products and tools and most importantly, develop your own skill.

You will team up with colleagues, so you can share and grow your knowledge within the data science field. It also means focusing on using data from an already existing infrastructure where we collect data from more than 350 sites worldwide.

Join our Customer Diagnostics Center

You become part of our Data Analytics department, which is part of our Customer Diagnostics Center (CDC). In the CDC, which is part of our Customer Support division, we are tasked with making sure our installed base of systems around the globe are healthy and running smoothly.

Here, you join a well-established but agile team of highly sought for data scientists. You have the freedom to develop solutions across the organisation focusing on creativity and innovation on the conceptual stages of possible new products, services and tools.

In the CDC, you will find a multitude of skills and competences, and we enjoy an informal atmosphere where we combine our strengths to create brand new solutions for colleagues and customers. Moreover, you become part of a data analytics forum where we work closely with universities to expand our knowledge.

Create value through data across the organisation

Through a continuous dialogue with our business and product development, you will be responsible for defining new products, services and tools based on data and machine learning. We are a large organisation with several specialist fields, which means that we can enjoy the value of data analysis across disciplines.

Your Tasks Will Include


Initiating mining of existing data from material handling systems running in production, looking for possible bottlenecks, optimizations etc.
Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis.
Participating in the maintenance of the existing data pipeline.
Participate in defining and evaluating new techniques for data collection and analysis.
Drive the rollout and extension of our data collection to all sites in the BEUMER Group.


We have a strong preference for open-source software and are working with platforms and tools such as Kubernetes, ArgoCD, MLFlow, vLLM, Elastic stack, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Numaflow, Python/Java/Golang, Jupyter notebooks and Opentelemetry. You will test and implement prototypes, e.g. for customer solutions or for your colleagues to provide them with the right tools to perfect their work. As such, you bridge the worlds of product development, subject specialists and technology to innovate the business.

Experience with data driven decision making, big data and concept development?

Role

Most important to this role is that you have a good all-round technical foundation, allowing you to implement software, configure tools, understand our domain and be a sounding board in the creative process. To do so, we also imagine that you:


Hold a master's degree or PhD as a computer scientist, engineer, physicist or similar.
Have a great understanding of and hands-on experience with using data analytics for system and concept development.
Speak and write English fluently and it is a big plus if you understand Danish as well.


Personality-wise, you are a strong communicator who can work across the organisation and with customers. Your strength is within innovation and creative thinking, which shows itself in added value in the concept development process and tests.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Head of Global Data Analytics Anders Lildballe at +45 30 17 93 48. Please apply online via beumergroup.com/career.

We look forward to meeting you.

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

Title: Data Management Consultant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description



Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.



Responsibilities & technologies



In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.



You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.



To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.



Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.



Your responsibilites will typically include:



Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.
Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you



You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.



To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:



ETL and Database technologies.
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.



When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.



Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.



Join an inclusive community



At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.



As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.



As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.



All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.



We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. Title: Revenue Operations Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Revenue Operations Analyst

United Fintech is building a global platform that connects financial institutions with modern, scalable technology solutions. Through acquisitions and partnerships, we bring together market-leading fintech products that serve banks, exchange groups, brokerages, and investment firms worldwide.
 
If you enjoy working with data and have a keen interest in commercial operations within a fast-paced fintech environment, then you might be what we are looking for to join our team in Copenhagen.
 
What You Will Contribute
 
We are looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at United Fintech. 
 
United Fintech is scaling fast, and our commercial data needs to scale with it. We are looking for someone who does not just report what happened but helps the business understand why and what to do next.
 
You will be responsible for defining the analytical roadmap for our commercial departments, ensuring that data is not just reported but used as a competitive advantage to drive growth and efficiency. This means working across our commercial data infrastructure, spanning CRM, BI tooling, and the integrations that connect them, with a clear view of how systems speak to each other and how data flows across the customer journey. You will also be expected to continuously improve how the team operates, using AI tools and automation to make analytical workflows faster and more scalable.
 
This is a hands-on, highly operational role with real ownership and significant growth potential for someone looking to build expertise in revenue analytics, systems integration, and commercial data architecture within a fast-growing fintech environment.
 
Key responsibilities include:

Analytics and Insight - Translate commercial data into clear, decision-ready insight for leadership and commercial teams. Cover pipeline, churn, revenue trends, and ad hoc requests as they come.
Analytical Roadmap - Define the analytics agenda for our commercial departments. Identify where data is missing or misread and work proactively to close those gaps.
Systems and Data Integration - Own the data flow between CRM, BI tools, and the rest of the commercial stack. Fix problems at the source, not around them. This is the layer the team has been missing.
Workflow Optimisation – Spot manual and repetitive processes across the commercial data stack and build better alternatives. Use AI tools actively to automate analytical work, improve reporting turnaround, and free up capacity for higher-value tasks.
Data Architecture and Visualisation - Design and maintain the reporting structures that support commercial decision-making. Build scalable dashboards and contribute to our Tableau Next implementation.
Data Quality and Forecasting - Monitor CRM and other commercial data quality, identify issues, and support forecasting with structured analysis and materials for leadership review cycles.
Collaboration - Work with the RevOps team and commercial stakeholders to ensure data and insight serve real decisions. Contribute beyond your primary focus area as part of a small, high-ownership team.
 
 You will bring: 

2 to 4 years of experience in RevOps, Sales Ops, analytics, BI, or a technically oriented commercial role. A technical academic background is equally welcome.
Strong commercial understanding. Pipeline coverage, conversion rates, churn, ARR, and NRR are part of how you think.
Hands-on experience with BI tooling such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Proven experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot to optimise workflows and accelerate output, including data analysis, documentation, and process automation. Familiarity with workflow automation tools is a plus.
CRM experience is a requirement. You are comfortable working with CRM objects, fields, and data structures on the reporting and data side. Salesforce specifically is a strong bonus.
A systems thinker who understands how data moves between platforms and how to fix it upstream.
Structured, independent, and direct. You own your work and communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
 
Location & Working Arrangements
This role is based in Copenhagen. The position is full-time and will be reporting to the Senior Revenue Operations Manager. 
You will join a three-person RevOps team and play a key role in building the analytics capability that supports commercial decision-making across United Fintech.
 
What We offer 

Key Role in Growth – Be instrumental in preparing us for the next stage of growth as we expand and integrate new businesses.
Collaborative Environment – Work alongside entrepreneurial minds and experts in the fintech sector, where teamwork and innovation are valued.
Opportunities for Development – Access personal and professional growth opportunities within a fast-paced, dynamic organisation.
Work-Life Balance – Flexibility to balance professional achievements with personal ambitions while contributing to a supportive and inclusive culture.
Engaging Culture – Participate in team-building activities, global events, and opportunities to connect with colleagues.
Lunch at our office in central Copenhagen K
 
Application Process
Please submit your CV by 20 of July. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so early submissions are encouraged. The first round of interviews is expected to take place end of July.
 
We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply and are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and supportive working environment. 
 
About United Fintech
Founded in 2020 and backed by the industry, United Fintech is a Digital Transformation Platform where global Financial Institutions and cutting-edge technology providers come together to unleash their full potential and enable the future of finance. United Fintech remains on the frontier of innovation by acquiring engineering-led fintechs within Capital Markets, Wholesale Banking, and Wealth Management under a central umbrella. In just over four years, the company has acquired six fintechs. United Fintech has received strategic investments from Barclays, BNP Paribas, Citi, Danske Bank and Standard Chartered and Danish Growth Capital.

You will also be expected to continuously improve how the team operates, using AI tools and automation to make analytical workflows faster and more scalable.
 
This is a hands-on, highly operational role with real ownership and significant growth potential for someone looking to build expertise in revenue analytics, systems integration, and commercial data architecture within a fast-growing fintech environment.
 
Key responsibilities include:
  • Analytics and Insight - Translate commercial data into clear, decision-ready insight for leadership and commercial teams. Cover pipeline, churn, revenue trends, and ad hoc requests as they come.
  • Analytical Roadmap - Define the analytics agenda for our commercial departments. Identify where data is missing or misread and work proactively to close those gaps.
  • Systems and Data Integration - Own the data flow between CRM, BI tools, and the rest of the commercial stack. Fix problems at the source, not around them. This is the layer the team has been missing.
  • Workflow Optimisation – Spot manual and repetitive processes across the commercial data stack and build better alternatives. Use AI tools actively to automate analytical work, improve reporting turnaround, and free up capacity for higher-value tasks.
  • Data Architecture and Visualisation - Design and maintain the reporting structures that support commercial decision-making. Build scalable dashboards and contribute to our Tableau Next implementation.
  • Data Quality and Forecasting - Monitor CRM and other commercial data quality, identify issues, and support forecasting with structured analysis and materials for leadership review cycles.
  • Collaboration - Work with the RevOps team and commercial stakeholders to ensure data and insight serve real decisions. Contribute beyond your primary focus area as part of a small, high-ownership team.
 
 You will bring: 
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in RevOps, Sales Ops, analytics, BI, or a technically oriented commercial role. A technical academic background is equally welcome.
  • Strong commercial understanding. Pipeline coverage, conversion rates, churn, ARR, and NRR are part of how you think.
  • Hands-on experience with BI tooling such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
  • Proven experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot to optimise workflows and accelerate output, including data analysis, documentation, and process automation. Familiarity with workflow automation tools is a plus.
  • CRM experience is a requirement. You are comfortable working with CRM objects, fields, and data structures on the reporting and data side. Salesforce specifically is a strong bonus.
  • A systems thinker who understands how data moves between platforms and how to fix it upstream.
  • Structured, independent, and direct. You own your work and communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
 
Location & Working Arrangements
 This role is based in Copenhagen. The position is full-time and will be reporting to the Senior Revenue Operations Manager. 
You will join a three-person RevOps team and play a key role in building the analytics capability that supports commercial decision-making across United Fintech.
 
What We offer 
  • Key Role in Growth – Be instrumental in preparing us for the next stage of growth as we expand and integrate new businesses.
  • Collaborative Environment – Work alongside entrepreneurial minds and experts in the fintech sector, where teamwork and innovation are valued.
  • Opportunities for Development – Access personal and professional growth opportunities within a fast-paced, dynamic organisation.
  • Work-Life Balance – Flexibility to balance professional achievements with personal ambitions while contributing to a supportive and inclusive culture.
  • Engaging Culture – Participate in team-building activities, global events, and opportunities to connect with colleagues.
  • Lunch at our office in central Copenhagen K
 
Application Process
Please submit your CV by 20 of July. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so early submissions are encouraged. The first round of interviews is expected to take place end of July.
 
We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply and are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and supportive working environment. 
 
About United Fintech
Founded in 2020 and backed by the industry, United Fintech is a Digital Transformation Platform where global Financial Institutions and cutting-edge technology providers come together to unleash their full potential and enable the future of finance. United Fintech remains on the frontier of innovation by acquiring engineering-led fintechs within Capital Markets, Wholesale Banking, and Wealth Management under a central umbrella. In just over four years, the company has acquired six fintechs. United Fintech has received strategic investments from Barclays, BNP Paribas, Citi, Danske Bank and Standard Chartered and Danish Growth Capital.

Title: BI Business Analyst I
Place: Birkerød, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join us to Make an Impact

Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About The Job

Excited to make a real impact while diving into the finance world? Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights? As a BI Business Analyst, you will play a key role in empowering colleagues with business intelligence and driving data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This is more than just a job - it is an opportunity to develop valuable skills within BI and finance, collaborate across teams, and contribute to impactful projects within life sciences, renewable energy, and fundamental research.

We are involved in projects that will transform the way we live. With more than fifteen years of expertise and innovation, NKT Photonics a Hamamatsu Company strives to remain the market leader in everything we do.

Responsibilities

As a BI Business Analyst, you will be transforming numbers into insights by working intensively within Power BI and Snowflake. You will play a key role in transforming the organization into a data-driven company creating value through insights.


Act as the go-to person for BI support of new insights and issue resolution
Transform raw data into meaningful insights using Power BI and Snowflake
Gather and prioritize requirements from finance and stakeholders
Develop and maintain dashboards with intuitive visualizations
Improve and modernize Power BI solutions
Automate manual finance processes
Ensure data models support business needs
Collaborate closely with IT and business teams
Manage tickets and resolve data issues
Stay up to date with Power BI and data storytelling best practices


In you, we hope to find


Strong experience with Power BI and Snowflake
Strong ability to define and implement KPIs that measure and drive performance across key business drivers
Experience with D365 is an advantage
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to translate data into insights
Experience with financial datasets
Strong communication skills in English


You are a proactive and hands-on team player who thrives in a collaborative environment, balancing business understanding with strong technical execution.

Our culture is positive, pragmatic, and focused on delivering both quick wins and long-term value. We collaborate closely across the BI team, Finance, and the wider organization to translate data and insights into tangible business impact. Within the BI team, we cover both frontend development in Power BI and backend development in dbt/Snowflake, working in close partnership with our colleagues in IT to ensure structured, reliable data from source systems.

Because collaboration is central to how we work, we primarily work from the office.

Title: Business Developer
Description:
Commercial decisions are only as good as the insights behind them. At SELECTED, we're building a new Business Development team to help our markets make even better commercial decisions.

As one of the first members of the team, you'll work at the intersection of business and data. Together with commercial stakeholders across Europe, you'll turn insights into action and help shape how commercial decisions are made.

YOUR TEAM

You will join a newly established Business Development team at SELECTED. Together, we work to strengthen commercial decision-making by connecting business understanding, data and technology. Joining us from at an early stage, you'll have the opportunity to influence how we work, build strong relationships across the organisation and make an impact from day one.

Working closely with Country Sales Managers, Sales Representatives, Merchandise Managers and Partner Performance Managers across our European markets, you'll help shape how data creates value in the business. You'll also collaborate with colleagues in our buying organisation as well as BESTSELLER Tech to develop commercial data products that support our decision-making across the value chain.

YOUR ROLE

You'll help strengthen commercial decision-making across SELECTED by combining business understanding with data. Working closely with colleagues across our sales organisation and markets, you'll identify opportunities, develop tools and analyses and help colleagues make better and faster decisions across our markets.

More specifically, you will:


Analyse commercial performance across partners and markets to identify opportunities and recommend where actions will create the greatest value
Develop tools, analyses and AI-supported solutions that help our sales organisation make better and faster commercial decisions
Drive the adoption of data-driven ways of working through stakeholder engagement, collaboration and training
Support our buying organisation by bringing commercial insights into product-related decisions and processes
Collaborate with BESTSELLER Tech to shape and continuously improve commercial data products that create value across the business.


Your Benefits

This isn't a role where insights disappear into a report. You'll work closely with the people making commercial decisions, giving you the opportunity to challenge, advise and see the impact of your work first-hand. You'll also:


Help build a new function with room to influence priorities and ways of working
Work closely with commercial stakeholders across Europe, our buying organisation and BESTSELLER Tech
Benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home, which is a natural part of how we work at SELECTED.


YOUR PROFILE

You're curious about what drives commercial performance and motivated by making a real impact through data. You enjoy navigating between business and analytics, and you're at your best when collaborating with others to solve complex commercial challenges.

In addition, we imagine that you:


Hold a relevant Master's degree, for example within Economics and Business Administration (cand.merc.), Business Intelligence or Data Science, or a similar field
Have experience working with commercial data and business insights, ideally within fashion, wholesale, retail or a comparable industry
Understand how commercial performance, partner dynamics and product decisions influence business results
Are comfortable working with analytical tools such as SQL, Python or similar, and enjoy using modern technologies, including AI, to develop analyses and practical solutions
Communicate complex insights in a simple and actionable way to stakeholders with different backgrounds
Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.


WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Business Development Manager Alex Brink Poulsen. Otherwise, send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 4 August 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting when we find the right candidate.

Title: Senior Analyst, Membership Performance
Description:
Job Description

Are you ready to elevate LEGO Membership's performance management by driving data-driven decisions in a global role within a values-driven company? Look no further!

Join us for an exciting career opportunity as a Senior Analyst, Membership Performance with the Membership & Performance Analytics team part of our Market & Channels Central Marketing organization.

Please note The position is based at our Copenhagen HUB, and relocation assistance is not available for this role.


Core Responsibilities





Lead analysis and reporting on app user behaviours to identify trends and opportunities.
Conduct in-depth analysis on user acquisition to drive growth in our rapidly scaling digital product.
Provide insights to the CRM performance management team to boost CRM communication effectiveness.
Develop audience models to refine targeting strategies.
Implement customer segmentation to personalize user experiences and guide strategic business decisions.
Generate actionable insights to enhance our fast-growing loyalty program.
Advance your skills as an analyst using a state-of-the-art tech stack, alongside talented colleagues in a dynamic, ambitious team.




Play your part in our team succeeding

As part of the Membership & Performance Analytics team, you'll deliver insightful analysis and reporting for the LEGO Insiders app and our membership proposition. Collaborate with dedicated analysts focused on the LEGO Insiders program, a leading loyalty initiative for LEGO enthusiasts worldwide. Your work will help teams assess intervention effectiveness, fostering continuous learning and program improvement.

Do you have what it takes?





Experience in data analysis within mobile app analytics, marketing, or CRM.
Proven ability to generate impactful insights from complex data sets.
Strong proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Adobe Analytics) is a must.
Expertise in advanced analytical methodologies handling outliers, regression analysis, time series forecasting, clustering techniques.
Proactive "can-do" attitude and approach to overcoming obstacles.
Excellent communication skills to clearly present findings to stakeholders.




Additional Skills That Would Be Beneficial





Experience with app user behaviour, customer acquisition strategies, and customer segmentation.
Expertise in Databricks, including advanced features (e.g., metric views).
Familiarity with email marketing and audience modelling techniques.




Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Pipeline & Ingestion


Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.
Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.


Data Platform & Infrastructure


Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.


Data Quality & Governance


Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.
Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.
Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.


Collaboration & Stakeholders


Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.


About You


You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.


Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.


Nice to Have


Experience with data observability tooling.
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.


Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.


Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.


The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Title: Sales Insight Specialist
Description:
Faerch Group

Faerch Group is a leading European manufacturer of rigid plastic packaging for the food industry, committed to driving sustainability and innovation across the packaging value chain. The Commercial Excellence team sits at the heart of our commercial strategy, enabling data-driven growth across our markets.

Tasks

Customer Segmentation


Design and maintain customer segmentation models to identify high-value accounts and opportunity segments
Translate segmentation outputs into clear service and go to market strategies and prioritisation frameworks for the sales team.
Continuously refine segmentation approaches in line with customer and market dynamics and strategic priorities.


Sales Insights & Reporting


Analyse sales performance across regions, channels, customer segments, and product lines to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Work with Finance to define and develop dashboards and reporting tools that give real-time visibility into key commercial KPIs — including pipeline health, revenue attainment, win/loss rates, and cost to serve.
Conduct ad hoc deep-dive analyses to support commercial decisions such as pricing, territory planning, and go-to-market strategy.


Stakeholder Collaboration


Present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders in a clear, business-relevant manner.
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to align on data definitions, reporting standards, and commercial priorities.
Serve as the go-to expert on customer and market data within the Commercial Excellence function.


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure the accuracy and consistency of sales and customer data used for analysis and reporting.
Collaborate with IT and data teams to improve data infrastructure and analytical capabilities.
Document methodologies and maintain a library of reusable models and templates.


Skills Required


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in sales analytics, commercial analytics, or business intelligence — ideally within a B2B manufacturing or packaging environment.
Proven experience in customer segmentation and translating analytical outputs into commercial recommendations.
Strong commercial mindset with the ability to understand revenue, margin, volume, pipoline, customer value, pricing and growth opportuniteits.
Strong proficiency in Excel, SQL, and preferred at least one BI platform (e.g., Power BI).
Ability to communicate complex data clearly to non-technical, senior audiences.
Fluency in English


Preferred


Experience with CRM platforms, particularly Dynamics.
Exposure to advanced data analysis (e.g., clustering, regression, propensity scoring).
Background in the packaging, food manufacturing, or broader FMCG industry.


Powers Of The Position And Success Criteria

Decision-Making Authority


Owns the design and maintenance of customer segmentation models and sales reporting frameworks.
Recommends commercial actions based on analytical findings
Operates with a high degree of autonomy within the scope of the Commercial Excellence function.


Success Criteria


Quality and adoption of segmentation models by the sales organisation.
Timeliness, accuracy, and business impact of sales insights and dashboards.
Measurable contribution to commercial outcomes — e.g., improved customer targeting, pipeline growth, or sales efficiency.
Stakeholder satisfaction with analytical outputs and cross-functional collaboration.
Continuous improvement of data quality and reporting capabilities within the team.


Location / On-site expectations:

This role requires regular on-site presence and close collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders.

Therefore, we are prioritising candidates who are based within reasonable commuting distance of a Faerch site location.

Please note that this is not a fully remote role.

Title: Quantitative Developer - Python
Description:
Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped our collaborative mindset, which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.




You will join a quantitative development function that works closely with Researchers, Traders and Cloud Engineering teams to build applications, data pipelines and analytics that support research and trading workflows. The role combines software engineering, quantitative development and data engineering, with responsibility for developing production applications, supporting research infrastructure and integrating large scale datasets.




Your future role within QRT

Design, develop, deploy and maintain cloud native Python applications supporting research and trading workflows, including market data dashboards, risk analytics, profit and loss reporting, weather analytics and performance analysis
Develop quantitative tools including backtesting frameworks, optimisation tools, pricing libraries and ETL pipelines for integrating and validating alternative datasets
Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that support model development and production workflows
Monitor, support, debug and enhance existing research and trading infrastructure
Work closely with Researchers, Traders and Engineering teams to deliver production quality solutions that meet evolving business requirements




Your present skillset

At least three years of professional Python development experience
Strong knowledge of Python, including numerical libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Polars and Xarray
Strong quantitative mindset with an interest in working closely with trading and research functions
Experience developing user interfaces or an interest in building data visualisation applications such as Plotly, Dash or Streamlit is beneficial
Experience with AWS or another cloud platform together with infrastructure as code technologies (e.g. Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS or AWS CDK is advantageous)
Good knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL together with object storage technologies
Experience developing ETL pipelines and working with large scale datasets
Strong understanding of software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, packaging and deployment
Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver production solutions
Experience with parallel or distributed computing is advantageous
