Title: Netanalytiker
Place: Horsens Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Motiveres du af at omsætte data til konkrete indsigter med reel betydning? Vil du være med til at analysere og udvikle elnettet, så vi understøtter den grønne omstilling og træffer de bedste beslutninger på et solidt datagrundlag?




Hos KONSTANT i Horsens søger vi en netanalytiker, der vil være med til at udvikle og optimere fremtidens elforsyningsnet.




Hvem er KONSTANT?

KONSTANT er en del af NRGi-koncernen og sikrer stabil elforsyning til godt 255.000 kunder i Østjylland. Vi er omkring 100 engagerede medarbejdere, der overvåger, vedligeholder og udvikler elnettet med fokus på driftssikkerhed, effektivitet og grøn omstilling.




Som et af landets største netselskaber ligger vi i toppen af branchens benchmarking og arbejder målrettet med at optimere og automatisere infrastrukturen, så vi er klar til fremtidens behov.




Jobbet som netanalytiker

Som netanalytiker bliver du en nøgleperson i arbejdet med vores måledata og analyser. Du får en central rolle i at videreudvikle vores interne analyse- og visualiseringsværktøjer og sikre, at data bliver omsat til værdifuld indsigt.




Du vil blandt andet:

• Omsætte komplekse måledata til klare indsigter og beslutningsgrundlag

• Udvikle dashboards og visualiseringer, der skaber overblik

• Udarbejde og følge op på nøgletal (KPI’er)

• Sikre datakvalitet og sammenhæng i analyser

• Optimere hjemtagning og håndtering af data fra vores 255.000 fjernaflæste målere

• Understøtte forretningen med analyser, der gør en forskel i hverdagen




Du arbejder tæt sammen med både tekniske specialister og forretningen – og bliver bindeleddet mellem data og beslutninger.




Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for data, IT, ingeniørvidenskab, matematik, fysik eller lignende. Du kan være nyuddannet eller have erfaring – vigtigst er din analytiske tilgang og interesse for at gøre hverdagen nemmere for dine kollegaer.




Du arbejder struktureret, er løsningsorienteret og formår at bevare overblikket i komplekse opgaver.




I rollen får du en bred kontaktflade både internt og eksternt, og derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan kommunikere klart og skabe gode relationer. Din evne til at samarbejde og finde løsninger er med til at sikre, at vi når i mål med projekterne og skaber værdi for både kunder og organisation.




Hvad tilbyder vi?

Vi tilbyder en central rolle i den grønne omstilling og et fagligt miljø, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen og bruger hinandens faglighed til at skabe de bedste løsninger. Vi ser forskellighed som en styrke, og det er netop samspillet mellem vores erfaringer og fagligheder, der gør os stærke som organisation.




Vi er stolte af, at mange af vores medarbejdere har været hos os i mange år – et tegn på, at vi trives og har en kultur, hvor man har lyst til at blive. Her er der plads til humor, fællesskab og respekt for hinanden, og vi lægger vægt på en god balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.




Vi tilbyder en lønpakke med pensionsordning, fritvalg og en attraktiv sundhedsordning. Som en del af KONSTANT Net/NRGi har du desuden adgang til et væld af rabatordninger bl.a. på el og ladeløsninger.




Interesseret

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingschef for Netudvikling Chris Hedegaard Birch på mail chhb@konstant.dk.




Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt, men venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

We are looking for the Data Analyst who will play a key role in delivering high-quality analysis, reporting and insight across the Audiences & Data function. Working closely with the Advanced Analytics Lead, this role supports the development and delivery of statistical analysis, analytical models and insight outputs that inform commercial decision-making.




Your Role Accountabilities…

Own the delivery of day‑to‑day analysis and insight, translating business questions into structured analytical outputs.

Analyse large, multi‑source datasets to identify trends, patterns and performance drivers.

Support the execution of advanced analytical models (e.g. regression, segmentation, multivariate analysis) led by the Advanced Analytics Lead.

Prepare, clean and validate datasets used in modelling work, proactively identifying data quality issues or inconsistencies.

Build and maintain dashboards and reporting outputs using tools such as Power BI, Looker or similar.

Work closely with insights, commercial and product teams to understand analytical needs.




Qualifications & Experience…

Experience in a data analyst, analytics or insight role.

Working knowledge of SQL and experience analysing data using Excel, Python and/or R.

Experience creating dashboards or visualisations using tools such as Power BI, Looker, Tableau or similar.

Exposure to statistical modelling techniques (e.g. regression, segmentation, factor analysis).

Experience working with survey, audience, marketing or perception data.

Familiarity with media, advertising, brand or marketing effectiveness analytics.

Experience working with cloud-based data platforms.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




Position: Full-time, Permanent

Reporting to: Senior Data Analyst

Location: London (Hybrid, up to 3 days/week remote)




We're seeking a Data Analyst to join our small data function at Kin Group part of Anderson Global as we continue our adoption of modern data tools across the business.




Following our own acquisition by Anderson Global and merger with another of their recent acquisitions, we've been focusing on systems integration and the migration from legacy systems and manual processes to a modern data toolset. We're implementing the pipeline, warehouse and BI tools to introduce higher levels of automation, quality control, governance, and self-service reporting across the business. We're looking to expand the team to help maintain the pace of those developments.




This is an opportunity to work across the implementation of an entire analytics stack, working closely with teams across the business: with the Engineering team developing our in-house platform, automating regulatory submissions for Compliance, and improving the efficiency of our Operations teams by providing BI tools to automate, and provide insight into, their processes.




This would be a great role for someone ready to step up from a junior position, or for someone from a larger, siloed team looking to broaden their experience across end-to-end data pipeline tools.




The Role & Responsibilities:

Handling data requests: Respond to inbound request tickets from team members to help answer questions and maintain data integrity.
Dbt contributions: Make contributions to the models, tests and documentation within the developing dbt project which manages our data pipeline.
Business Intelligence development: Develop tools and dashboards for teams and managers within our BI platform (Hex) to provide impactful insight and automated reporting.
Regulatory reporting: Support in the generation and automation of required reports for regulatory bodies.
Operating the data stack tools: Support the implementation administration of the data team tools: user management, governance, optimisation, adoption of best practices and new features.
Ad-hoc investigations and projects: Undertake investigations or projects such as client data migrations, data quality initiatives, or management reporting.
Migration from legacy tools and spreadsheets: Support the migration from our legacy systems, and the integration with other group systems as required.
Data governance and security: Support in developing and maintaining high levels of quality control, data governance and business confidence in our data.




Other Expectations

Cultivate and maintain a client/customer centric culture through the way you work and the service you provide
Embrace change and continuously improve the work we do and the way we do it
Assume ownership of the tasks and responsibilities you are assigned
Work closely with and support your colleagues to collectively achieve success
Capacity to adjust to changing requirements and priorities




The Right Person:

Solid experience with SQL, Excel.
Experience with tools and tech used in our stack: dbt (Cloud), BigQuery, Hex, Fivetran, Postgres, git. (or equivalent)
Experience delivering impactful dashboards and data-tools.
Able to work autonomously, with good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail & curiosity. They’ll instinctively build strong understandings of systems and problems, following leads and pulling on threads in investigations to appreciate the underlying issues and data.
Team-player with a friendly, supportive, positive, can-do attitude
Strong English language skills




Nice-to-haves:

Experience of productive use of AI agents: leveraging them to improve your reach and productivity, without diminishing your understanding.
Experience working in a regulated industry.
Experience working with, developing, or defining data models, schema, metrics and semantic layers.
Appreciation of good practices across data protection, security, data privacy.
Experience with Python.

Description:
Job description:

INTRODUCTION

At Burberry, we believe creativity opens spaces. Our purpose is to unlock the power of imagination to push boundaries and open new possibilities for our people, our customers and our communities. This is the core belief that has guided Burberry since it was founded in 1856 and is central to how we operate as a company today.

We aim to provide an environment for creative minds from different backgrounds to thrive, bringing a wide range of skills and experiences to everything we do. As a purposeful, values-driven brand, we are committed to being a force for good in the world as well, creating the next generation of sustainable luxury for customers, driving industry change and championing our communities.

 

JOB PURPOSE We are hiring an APP Data Analyst to join Burberry’s Asset & Profit Protection team, supporting a global function that helps protect our people, operations and business performance.   This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, risk and operational excellence, ensuring key reporting and insights are delivered with accuracy and impact. Working across multiple business functions, you will help maintain the integrity of critical datasets, support decision-making through analytics, and contribute to initiatives that strengthen risk management and operational efficiency.   The role offers broad exposure across the business, with opportunities to develop expertise in data analytics, reporting, fraud prevention and process improvement within a collaborative and highly experienced team.     RESPONSIBILITIES
Maintain and enhance Asset & Profit Protection operational data, ensuring accuracy, consistency and data integrity across multiple sources.
Cleanse, validate and manage incident, investigation, compliance and operational datasets to support reliable reporting.
Maintain and develop Power BI dashboards, Power Apps and reporting tools used across global stakeholder groups.
Support digital fraud activities, including chargeback analysis and related data investigations where required.
Deliver analysis and reporting to support stock loss, compliance and risk-management initiatives across the business.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, automate reporting and create new data solutions that drive efficiency and insight.

 

 

PERSONAL PROFILE
Experience working with large datasets and delivering accurate, insight-led reporting.
Strong Excel capabilities and experience using Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Power BI and Power Apps.
A detail-oriented approach with a commitment to maintaining high standards of data quality.
Confidence working independently while building effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.
Curiosity and a proactive mindset when identifying trends, risks and opportunities within data.
Experience in retail fraud prevention, Microsoft Access, SAP or SQL is beneficial but not essential.

 

 

Burberry is an Equal Opportunities Employer and as such, treats all applications equally and recruits purely on the basis of skills and experience.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Hey! We're Huel, and we're pleased to meet you 👋

Our culture thrives on high performance, and we set the bar high for new Hueligans who join us.

We invite you to read the advert below for our new Data Analyst position to understand the role, and explore our 7 Huel values before applying to ensure we have the right working environment for you!

The role

Huel is looking for a Data Analyst to turn raw behavioural and commercial data into clear, actionable insights for Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail teams. You’ll build measurement frameworks, run causal analyses, and create self-serve dashboards, helping the business move fast and make confident, data-driven decisions.

Key responsibilities include:


Owning end-to-end analysis – translate open-ended questions from Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail into clear analytical briefs, run the analysis, and land unambiguous recommendations.
Designing & evaluating experiments – design A/B tests and causal-inference studies (lift analysis, hold-out tests) and communicate results in plain language.
Defining measurement frameworks – set the right KPIs and establish how new initiatives will be measured, ensuring every launch has a clear success metric and data plan from day one.
Scale our data foundations – team up with Engineering to design efficient, accurate data sets and schemas, define requirements for new data feeds, and automate the checks that keep everything running smoothly.
Championing self-serve analytics – develop and maintain live dashboards, document datasets, and run training sessions so non-analysts can answer routine questions without waiting in a queue.
AI & Automation - Champion the adoption of AI-powered analytics, using AI tools to enhance analysis, automate routine activities, uncover deeper insights, and improve productivity, while enabling colleagues to self-serve trusted data and answer business questions independently.
Spotting growth opportunities – combine behavioural and marketing data with commercial metrics to size new products, markets, and campaigns, prioritising by impact and effort.


This role is based at our HQ in Tring, Hertfordshire. We operate a hybrid working model, with office days on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the flexibility to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays.

Not yet sure if this is the right role for you? Click HERE to read a more detailed job description.

What we're looking for in you

We’re looking for a confident, curious analyst who’s comfortable working with statistics, behavioural data, and experiment design. You can move seamlessly between SQL, product analytics tools, and storytelling through slides. You’re proactive, independent, and always looking for high-impact opportunities to raise the bar on how we use data. In a fast-paced environment, you adapt quickly and communicate clearly - collaborating with both technical and non-technical teams to get things done.


SQL – you can write quick exploratory queries or optimise a multi-table join on Snowflake without breaking a sweat.
Product analytics – comfortable in platforms such as Heap, Amplitude or Mixpanel and happy to set up events, funnels and cohorts from scratch.
Statistical – solid on A/B testing, experiment design and the basics of causal inference; you know when a result is worth acting on.
Measurement mindset – you’ve built tracking plans and KPI frameworks that let teams see what “good” looks like before they ship.
Data - experience modelling data in dbt (or similar), automating checks and keeping feeds clean and accurate as they scale.


And as always, we’re on the lookout for new Hueligans who love a fast-paced environment and are always striving to be their best. We want people who aren’t afraid to think differently and push boundaries. If you’re all about setting big goals and believe that amazing things happen through creativity and teamwork, you’ll fit right in at Huel!

What do we offer in return?

We know that at times, our teams face demanding pressures, and exceptional effort deserves meaningful rewards. That's why we've created a world-class perks and benefits program designed to support our Hueligans in achieving their best, both professionally and personally, while celebrating the global impact they're making!

🕖 Hybrid working - We spend Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office together. The remaining two days have the option to be worked from home.

🌴 30 days annual leave PLUS bank holidays

🥤 Free Huel to keep you going

🏖️ 2 weeks a year to work remotely from anywhere!

🐾 Dog friendly

🙋 Paid Volunteering Days

🏋️ Free on-site gym with free classes, and we will give you your own nutrition plan

🧘 Free on-site wellness area offering infrared saunas and an ice bath🧘

🧠 Free 1-on-1 therapy provided by Self-Space.

🏥 Private Medical and Health insurance for you and your loved ones, including free life insurance covering up to 4x your salary

⚡ Electric Car Scheme with onsite charging

🚴Cycle to Work Scheme

🤰 Enhanced Family Leave

👪 Workplace Nursery Scheme

🎓 Huel Academy

💸 Paid Employee Referral Scheme

🎉 Biannual events to celebrate success - Have you heard about Huelchella?

We are Hueligans

We know diversity isn’t just important... it’s essential. It makes us stronger, sharper, and better at what we do. At Huel, we’re about people, not just sustainable nutrition - real people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

We celebrate what makes each of us unique and we actively bring together Hueligans from all walks of life. Because whilst we share the same 7 values, it’s our differences that power our thinking, challenge our ideas, and help us build better products for a global community.

Belonging matters here. So does fairness. We want every Hueligan to have the opportunity to thrive, contribute, and be heard - no matter where they come from or what path they’ve taken to get here.

We don’t just welcome diversity of thought…we go looking for it!

Meet our teams here.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Workplace: White City, London - Hybrid

Data Analyst, Central Insights

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the ITV Insight Group’s Central Insights team.

Central Insights plays a crucial role in shaping ITV’s understanding of the UK television market, evolving viewer behaviours and future opportunities in an exciting, highly competitive and increasingly complex media landscape. Our work helps the business understand how viewers engage with ITV’s content across broadcast, VOD and SVOD, and supports key decisions across content, scheduling, marketing, product, strategy and performance planning.

As part of a cross-functional team, you will partner with Insight Managers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Analysts and business stakeholders to understand their challenges and help answer the “big questions”. You will use data to create clear, accurate and actionable insight, helping stakeholders make better decisions and supporting ITV’s wider strategic objectives.

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering analytical requirements for your business area, working with the wider team to produce high-quality analysis, dashboards, reports and recommendations. You will be encouraged to sharpen your technical skills, think critically about the questions being asked, and communicate insight in a way that is clear, trusted and impactful.

The team

ITV is on a mission to Supercharge Streaming and Optimise Broadcast with data and insight right at the centre of our digital transformation strategy.

The business faces many challenges ahead to achieve this vision: What content should we commission? Which audiences are the most commercially attractive for us? What should our marketing strategy be? How do we optimise our product to improve view through rates? How do we use VOD (Video on Demand) to offset declines to Linear TV?

Whatever the question, ITV Insights is here to lead the business to its most successful future by putting insight with integrity, ingenuity, and impact, at the heart of every key decision.

Responsibilities:


Analysing audience behaviours and providing insight on our viewers to drive business value.
Provision of accurate and insightful analysis on how viewers engage with and consume the nation’s best-loved and most-watched content across broadcast, VOD and SVOD.
Communicating analytics and insight to business stakeholders in a non-technical, strategically-minded and impactful manner.
Creating analysis, dashboards and reports that help stakeholders understand performance against key business KPIs.
Supporting proof of concept analysis for new metrics, methodologies, segmentations or analytical approaches.
As part of a cross-functional team, developing and embedding dashboarding solutions for business stakeholders, enabling a culture of self-service analytics.
Evaluating the performance of content, release strategies, marketing activity and product experiments, and supporting recommendations for future tests and next steps.
Working with large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities and risks in viewer behaviour and content performance.
Supporting forecasting and performance analysis across key business KPIs.
Collaborating with subject matter experts in a range of disciplines, including Insight Managers, Data Scientists, Analysts and business stakeholders, to drive projects forward.
Helping to embed analytical best practice across the team, including clear documentation, reproducible analysis and high-quality standards in analytical delivery.


Skills you’ll need (minimum criteria)


Proven experience (or similar exposure) within a data analytics role, with the ability to turn complex data into meaningful insights
Ability to create insightful analysis and dashboards.
Comfortable visualising and presenting analysis across a range of formats, including reports, PowerPoint, dashboards and email.
Experience using SQL to analyse large datasets.
Understanding of analytical techniques and statistical concepts.
Experience using Python for analytics, data transformation or modelling.
Strong attention to detail and a drive to produce accurate, trusted and well-documented analysis.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to tell clear and impactful stories with data.
Ability to work collaboratively with analysts, insight specialists and business stakeholders.
A curious and critical mindset, with the ability to question assumptions and understand the limitations of analysis.


Other things we’re looking for (key criteria)


A passion for TV programmes and an interest in the wider media landscape.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms such as GCP, BigQuery, AWS, Redshift or Databricks.
Experience working with data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio.
Experience of working with first and third party data, ideally in a TV, media, streaming, product, marketing or customer analytics environment.
Experience using Jupyter notebooks is preferable.
Experience of forecasting or predictive modelling in a business analytics context is preferable.
Keen problem solver who can demonstrate critical thinking, coupled with strong communication skills.
Interest in improving insight capability through automation, self-serve analytics, documentation or new ways of working.

Title: Data Analyst (Payments)
Description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

The Role

We are looking for a Payments Data Analyst to join our London team. You will take ownership of the payments data layer, working at the intersection of Product, Commercial, and Engineering to ensure our acquiring business is measurable, scalable, and optimized for performance.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end payments data lifecycle, from defining core metrics to delivering insights that improve authorization rates, optimize margins, and support commercial decision-making. This is a highly proactive role suited to someone who enjoys solving complex problems and driving impact through data.

Your Responsibilities

Domain Ownership:

Act as the subject matter expert for the payments data lifecycle, covering authorisation, clearing, settlement, and reconciliation.

Proactive Analysis

Go beyond standard reporting by delivering unprompted insights. Diagnose root causes of changes in authorisation rates and identify margin leakage driven by transaction mix or fee structures.

Commercial & Product Partnership

Work closely with Product Managers to define success metrics for new features and support Commercial teams with merchant-level profitability analysis and pricing scenarios.

Data Architecture & Quality

Own the “single source of truth” for key payments metrics (volumes, revenue, margins). Collaborate with Engineering to define tracking requirements and proactively identify and resolve data gaps.

Semantic Layer Development

Build and maintain a robust semantic layer on top of payments data, ensuring consistent metric definitions across the business and enabling AI-driven workflows and Snowflake Cortex use cases.

Self-Service Strategy

Develop scalable data models in dbt and create Tableau dashboards that empower stakeholders to self-serve insights, while you focus on deeper strategic analysis.

Actionable Narratives

Translate complex terminal, POS, and eCommerce data into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders to inform product roadmap and pricing decisions.

Must Have


2+ years of experience in a Data Analytics role within Payments, Acquiring, or FinTech
Strong understanding of the card transaction lifecycle (Authorisation, Clearing, Settlement)
Familiarity with fee structures (Interchange, Scheme Fees, Blended vs IC+ pricing)
Strong proficiency in SQL and Tableau (or equivalent BI tool)
Hands-on experience with dbt and data modelling
Familiarity with Git and cloud data environments (e.g. Snowflake, AWS)
Strong analytical mindset with a focus on root cause analysis and experimentation
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience working with Card-Present / POS terminal data
Knowledge of chargebacks and dispute processes
Proficiency in Python for modelling or advanced analysis
Experience with pricing optimisation or portfolio segmentation
Exposure to international payment schemes and local payment methods


The Perks


Physical and mental health support through our partnership with GymPass, including access to gyms, therapy, meditation, and wellness apps
Enhanced maternity and paternity leave policies for greater flexibility and support
Cycle-to-Work Scheme
Private Health and Life Insurance
Pension Scheme
25 days annual leave + bank holidays
Daily office snacks
Friendly, collaborative, and informal office environment in Central London


Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

Title: Data Analyst
Place: City Of London, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Data Analyst – London




5-6 Month Contract




Up to £525 per day | Outside IR35




Hybrid Working – 1-2 Days Per Week Onsite




We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join an exciting transformation programme focused on evolving how the organisation uses data to drive better business decisions.

This role will play a key part in enabling self-service analytics by leveraging Looker to create semantic layers across core datasets. These semantic models will support Looker AI Agents (Looker Conversation), Large Language Models (LLMs) and automated push notifications, giving business users greater flexibility to explore data, receive proactive insights and accelerate decision-making.

A significant focus of this role will be working with LLM-powered AI solutions, reviewing large and complex datasets, validating AI-generated outputs and ensuring that insights delivered to the business are accurate, reliable and fit for purpose. You'll be responsible for maintaining rigorous quality assurance standards and will have the confidence to sign off AI-generated outputs before they are released to the business.

Working closely with business stakeholders, data engineering teams and analytics specialists, you'll help shape how AI, semantic modelling and trusted data are used across the organisation.




Key skills and responsibilities,

Looker expertise – Proven hands-on experience developing and working within the Looker platform, including semantic layer creation and optimisation.
Looker AI Agents – Experience working with or supporting AI Agents within Looker (Looker Conversation), helping to optimise semantic models and improve AI-generated responses.
Automated Push Notifications – Experience building or supporting automated push notifications and proactive insight delivery using data-driven workflows.
LLM & AI experience – Strong experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI-powered analytics or conversational AI solutions, ensuring outputs are accurate, relevant and trusted.
Large Dataset Analysis – Extensive experience analysing, interrogating and validating large, complex datasets, identifying anomalies and ensuring data integrity across AI-driven solutions.
Semantic Layer Development – Collaborate with business domain experts to design, build and optimise semantic layers, working closely with Data Engineering to improve performance and scalability.
Quality Assurance – Significant experience testing, validating and quality assuring data products and AI-generated outputs, with exceptional attention to detail and a critical eye for accuracy.
Results Ownership – Confident taking accountability for data quality and formally signing off whether AI-generated insights meet business and delivery standards.
AI & Machine Learning Lifecycle – Previous experience supporting AI/ML initiatives and AI agents from development through to deployment, with an understanding of model validation and continuous improvement.
SQL Proficiency – Strong working knowledge of SQL for analysing, interrogating and validating large datasets.
Stakeholder Engagement – Partner with business stakeholders to understand key business questions and translate requirements into trusted analytical models.
Adaptability – Comfortable working in an agile environment where priorities evolve, AI capabilities mature and continuous learning is encouraged.




This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-enabled analytics, helping shape how the organisation leverages LLMs, Looker AI Agents, semantic modelling and automated push notifications to transform how data is consumed and trusted across the business.




Interested? Please submit your updated CV to Dean Sadler-Parkes at Harvey Nash for immediate consideration.

Description:
Full Time/Part Time Full Time

Who We Are

At Ikano Bank, we believe work should feel meaningful and inspiring. Together, we create a great place to work where people are inspired to be the best they can be while contributing to a better life for our customers and the long-term success of the Bank. Guided by our Swedish heritage and values: common sense and simplicity, working together and daring to be different, we keep things straightforward and down-to-earth. If you like the idea of being part of a team that works hard, enjoys solving challenges together and dares to do things a little differently, you will feel right at home here.

Working in the Credit function means helping build a strong, responsible bank by setting smart credit strategies and promoting a culture of prudent risk management. It’s about supporting the business to grow safely and confidently, making a positive impact through sound and trustworthy decision-making.

Purpose of the Job Join us at a key moment as we transform how we make credit decisions — becoming faster, smarter, and more data-driven. As a Credit Decision Analyst, you’ll work hands-on with decision engines, turning strategy and data into real-time decision logic that directly impacts customer outcomes and business performance.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of credit risk, analytics, and technology — with real ownership and the opportunity to shape the future of decisioning.

Responsibilities of the Job - Design, implement, and maintain credit decisioning strategies within the bank’s decision engine


Translate credit risk policies, models, and business strategies into decision rules and logic
Monitor and analyze decision performance (e.g. decision outcome, approval rates, conversion) and identify optimization opportunities
Support development and implementation of new credit strategies (e.g. underwriting, pricing, affordability)
Collaborate with Credit Risk, Data Science, and Digital teams to ensure consistent and effective decision flows
Ensure decision logic is documented, traceable, and aligned with internal governance and regulatory requirements
Contribute to continuous improvement and automation of decision processes
Support testing, validation, and deployment of decision strategies in line with agreed frameworks
Act as a subject matter expert in credit decisioning and support stakeholders with insights and guidance


Education Level Bachelor's Degree

Experience/Demonstrated Competencies - 2+ years of experience in credit risk, decisioning, analytics, or retail banking


Experience working with credit decision engines
Experience analyzing credit performance and supporting strategy development
Proficiency in SQL, Python and/or data analysis tools
Exposure to credit risk models, scorecards, or underwriting processes
Experience working in cross-functional environments involving Credit and Digital


Language Competencies - Fluency in English

Knowledge required - Understanding of credit risk strategy, underwriting principles, and credit lifecycle


Hands on experience of Decision engine systems and rule-based systems
Understanding of scorecards, risk models, and their application in decisioning
Knowledge of key credit performance metrics (e.g. approval rate, default rate, profitability)
Understanding of data structures and datasets used in credit decisioning
Awareness of regulatory requirements and governance related to credit decisioning
Understanding of testing frameworks and performance monitoring in decision strategies
Knowledge of how decisioning interacts with customer journeys and commercial objectives


Capabilities for this job - Ability to translate analytical insights into clear and implementable decision rules


Strong analytical skills with capability to assess and improve decision performance
Capability to work with data using SQL, Python and/or analytical tools
Structured and detail-oriented approach to ensure accuracy and robustness in decision logic
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication skills, enabling effective interaction with both technical and business stakeholders
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally to deliver end-to-end decisioning solutions
Capable of identifying inefficiencies and driving process improvements.


What motivates you? - Strong ownership and drive to improve credit decisioning and customer outcomes


Interest in translating data and analysis into practical decision strategies
Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with focus on continuous improvement
Highly collaborative approach, working across Credit, Digital, and Commercial teams
Curiosity and willingness to challenge existing approaches to improve performance


Ready to apply?

Our application process is simple. Just click on the Apply Button and we will get in touch with you soon. Apply today and let us build something different together. Description:
As one of the world's largest networks of audit, tax and consulting firms, RSM delivers big ideas and premium service to help middle-market businesses thrive. We are a fast-growing firm with big ambitions -- we have a clear goal to become the premium adviser to the middle market, globally. This vision touches everything we do, motivating and inspiring us to become better every day. If you are looking for a firm where you can build a future and make an impact, then RSM is the place for you.

Make an Impact at RSM UK

At RSM, our consulting team brings together diverse advisory experts to deliver our six core solutions: business transformation, forensic, deal services, restructuring, finance function support, and risk and governance.

Our solutions are designed to address the unique needs, challenges, and opportunities our clients face as they strive to achieve their aspirations and organisational goals. Whether it’s supporting global expansion, developing acquisition strategies, facilitating private equity investments, or collaborating with boards to manage risk and governance, our consulting experts work as one cohesive team. We prioritise simplicity, providing data-driven insights, value-added assurance, and high-quality execution to empower our clients in building sustainable, future-fit businesses.

It’s an exciting time to join our consulting team, as we embark on ambitious growth plans that promise to create diverse career opportunities. We are committed to enhancing our six solutions, expanding and developing our team of expert consultants, embracing a digital-first approach, strengthening our global presence, and building strong client relationships

As an Associate Director within Technology and Cyber Risk Assurance, you’ll be responsible for advising our clients on cyber security strategy, programmes, resilience, controls and compliance, and emerging technology (e.g. artificial intelligence, and Blockchain etc.). 

You’ll benefit from ongoing coaching, career mentoring, and be supported by the TRA career pathway that was launched in 2021. This provides you with an opportunity to continue to develop market leading skills across our different capabilities and advance your professional development by undertaking accredited certifications via our training hub.

You’ll Make An Impact By


Leading and coaching high performing teams, resource management, recruitment, and development for team members. You’ll make quality time and take an interest in the team.

Driving external market activities and identifying new business opportunities.
Developing client relationships by creating proposals that demonstrate our capability to meet new and existing client needs.
Being responsible for client relationships in conjunction with the Partners to ensure our work adds value and is delivered timely and profitably.
Responsible for the ongoing management of cyber services, including capability development and quality assurance of work and reporting.


What We Are Looking For

Are you someone who thrives on variety, loves learning new things, and enjoys connecting with people? If you can spot inefficiencies in everyday life and are passionate about making improvements, this role is perfect for you!

We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Here’s what we’re looking for in our ideal candidate:


Significant experience delivering cyber security assurance and advisory services.
Have a strong external profile and extensive network of contacts across industry.
Proven experience of winning new business and leveraging existing client relationships.
Experience of creating and developing client relationships to win work and increase revenue.
Experience of creating new business proposals and responding to RFP’s etc.
Experience in managing engagements end-to-end in a professional service context.
Experience of delivering security leadership services such as vCISO.
Business and commercial minded in your approach.
Passionate to continue your career in technology, cyber, risk management, and provide defensive and offensive cyber services to our clients.


What We Can Offer You

We recognise that our people are our most important assets. That’s why we offer a flexible reward and benefits package that will help you have fulfilling experience, both in and out of work.


Hybrid working
27 Days Holiday
Lifestyle, Health, and Wellbeing including financial wellbeing benefits such as financial tools, electric car scheme and access to a virtual GP.
Access to a suite of 300+ courses on demand developed by our inhouse Talent Development team.


Diversity and Inclusion at RSM

At RSM, we want to create a strong sense of belonging so that people of all identities, backgrounds, and cultures feel they can bring their true self to work. Our clients come from all walks of life. We aim to achieve that same diversity of background, experience and perspective in our own teams, so that we can genuinely understand our client's needs. Diverse teams bring a broader range of ideas and insights to work. That's why we're working together to ensure our firm's principles and processes support a firm culture that embraces difference and strengthens inclusion.

Job Description

Helping to keep the public safe. Giving people the chance to turn their lives around. Building a rewarding professional career. There are many reasons to join the Probation Service. What will yours be?

We’re looking for empathetic, patient, and organised people to join us in this varied role, which offers the chance to make a difference, gain new skills and build a rewarding career within the Probation Service.

If this sounds like you, apply now.

If you are successful in the recruitment process to join the Probation Service, your starting salary will be £28,064, Pro-Rata for Part-Times roles.

The Probation Service offers the opportunity for annual pay progression through a Competency Based Framework (CBF), which if eligible, will see your pay increase. CBF is designed to enable you to move up through the pay band range as your competence grows.

New entrants are expected to join on the minimum of the pay band.

Probation Service also increase their pay band ranges annually in line with Civil Service Pay guidance, which will also apply an increase to band pay ranges where applicable.

Overview Of The Job

The job holder will undertake the full range of work with people on probation before and after sentence. This will include assessment, sentence implementation, offender management and producing reports. The job holder will provide case management support to a full range of people on probation utilising service procedures and practice directions that underpin professional judgement.

For further information on the summary, responsibilities, activities, duties of the role and the Civil Service Success Profile Criteria which will be used in the assessment process, please refer to the full Job Description Attachment.

Right to work in the UK

You must have the right to work in the UK and Civil Service (https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules).

Skilled Worker visa changes from 22 July 2025

In accordance with current immigration rules, this role is not eligible for a new Skilled Worker visa.

From 22 July 2025, the Government introduced changes to the eligibility criteria for Skilled Worker visas. As a result:

HM Prison and Probation Service (HMPPS) cannot consider sponsoring you to work as a probation services officer unless you have held a Skilled Worker visa prior to the 22 July 2025 changes.

If you have held a Skilled Worker visa continuously, please raise this during your pre-employment checks and your eligibility will be assessed in accordance with the immigration rules and transitional provisions in place.

If you apply to be a probation services officer and you have not held a Skilled Worker visa prior to 22 July 2025, you will need to consider your options for obtaining and/or maintaining your right to work in the UK in light of these changes.

If your application is successful, you will need to ensure that you have and maintain the legal right to live and work in the Civil Service and in the United Kingdom.

HMPPS will continue to comply with UK Immigration Rules applied in the UK and Civil Service. You can read more about Skilled Worker visas and the eligibility criteria here.

About Us:

By managing offenders in the community, the Probation Service protects the public from the effect of crime and gives offenders the chance to turn their lives around. Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive team that thrives on sharing knowledge and expertise.

Successful applicants may be based a wide variety of office, court, team, or prison locations within the Probation Service region. Allocations will be made according to business need.

To find out more about working as a Probation Service Officer please click here

About The Recruitment Process

To apply to this role you will be required to complete a short application form and detail responses to Civil Service Behaviours and Experience based question.

As part of this application, you will also be required to sit the Civil Service Judgement test (CSJT). The CSJT is a two-part test which looks at your ability to make decisions in relation to specific civil service behaviours.

The CSJT is stage one of your application process and you will have the option to complete a practice test immediately before taking the test, to give you an insight of what to expect before you start.

If you would like more information relating to reasonable adjustments and the CSJT, please see more details here. You can also watch a short a video here.

You can find out more about the CSJT and complete a practice test now here.

If you are successful in passing this stage, your full application will be sifted once the application deadline has closed. You will then receive further instruction on the progress and outcome of your application.

If you are successful in passing both the CSJT and application sift process you will be invited to interview.

If in the event we receive a high volume of applications, we may only assess candidates against the lead behaviour. There is also no guarantee that you will progress to the next stages of the recruitment process; however, we will keep you informed at each stage.

Take a look at a short video about Probation Service Officer Role here

About The Role

Probation services officers can help make a real difference to peoples’ lives. It’s not always easy to help someone turn their life around, but it can be immensely rewarding.

We’re looking for empathetic, patient and resilient people to join us as probation services officers. As well as making a difference to others, the role offers plenty of on-the-job training and a real chance to build a career in the Probation Service.

As a PSO, you’ll have a similar job to a fully qualified probation officer. The main difference is you’ll work with medium and lower risk people of probation. That’s not to say it’ll be easy. There’s no doubt this is a challenging role.

Day-to-day, you’ll manage a caseload of offenders before and after sentence. We’ll look to you to assess and manage risks, provide information to courts and work closely with agencies throughout the justice system. You’ll also do everything you can to support offenders. This could involve everything from providing practical advice about housing and employment to simply listening and empathising.

Ideally with experience of working with people who have social or personal difficulties, you’ll be empathetic, patient and resilient. Good writing skills are also essential. Title: Process Technician (Chemical Manufacture)
Description:
Process Technician (Chemical Manufacture)


Hands-on production. Real equipment. Materials that can help decarbonise the world.


Why this role exists


Promethean Particles is scaling the production of a new class of materials - metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) - that can play an important role in more energy-efficient carbon capture.


This means real manufacturing work, not theoretical development:


Full-scale and pilot-scale reactor systems

Chemical processing and post-processing equipment

Pumps, pipework, filter presses and ovens

Safety-critical procedures and quality standards

Products being manufactured for real-world use


We’re looking for a Process Technician who enjoys practical, hands-on manufacturing and wants to be part of a growing production team working on technology with genuine environmental impact.


This role is a 9-5 role, not shift work.


Who this role is best suited to


This role is ideal for someone who has worked in a batch manufacturing, production, processing, or industrial environment and enjoys doing things properly.


You don’t need to have worked with nanomaterials before. What matters is that you are practical, reliable, safety-conscious, and comfortable following processes carefully while working as part of a team.


You’re likely to be a strong fit if you:


Have experience in batch manufacturing, production, processing in chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food and drink, brewing, distilling, or a similar environment

Enjoy hands-on work with equipment and physical processes

Take pride in accuracy, cleanliness, and doing the job properly

Understand the importance of safety, PPE, procedures, and good record-keeping

Communicate clearly and work well with others

Want to build your skills in a growing advanced materials business


What you’ll actually be doing


You’ll join Promethean’s Production and Engineering team, helping manufacture high-specification nanomaterials using pilot-scale and full-scale reactor systems.


Your work will include:


Operating pilot-scale and full-scale continuous reactor systems, helping manufacture advanced nanomaterials using industrial processing equipment including pumps, filter presses, pipework and drying systems.

Following Standard Operating Procedures and working safely at all times

Recording production data clearly and accurately

Helping ensure products are manufactured to the required quality standards

Maintaining a clean, organised, and safe operating environment

Working closely with colleagues in Production, Engineering, and Process Development

Supporting basic equipment checks, cleaning, and maintenance tasks where appropriate


This is a site-based, hands-on production role. It will suit someone who likes being close to the process, working with equipment, and seeing the results of their work.


What we’re looking for


We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, practical mindset, and attention to detail.


You’ll need:


Previous experience in a manufacturing, production, processing, or similar environment

Good written and spoken English

The ability to record data accurately and clearly

Strong communication skills

A good understanding of safe working practices

Awareness of PPE requirements and COSHH principles

A willingness to work in a commercial environment where confidentiality matters

Full, unrestricted right to work in the UK - we are not offering visa sponsorship for this role


It would also be helpful if you have experience with:


Chemical manufacturing

Pharmaceuticals

Food and drink manufacturing

Brewing or distilling

Pumps and pipework

Filter presses or other separation equipment

COSHH, risk assessments, or HAZOP

Basic maintenance tasks


Why this is a strong move


This is a chance to join a growing advanced materials company at an exciting stage of scale-up.


You’ll gain practical experience with specialist manufacturing equipment, work closely with technical teams, and contribute to the production of materials with real-world environmental applications.


For someone who enjoys hands-on production and wants to develop in a modern manufacturing environment, this is a strong opportunity to build valuable skills.


About Promethean Particles


Promethean Particles is a global leader in the development and scale manufacturing of high-specification nanomaterials.


Our mission is to help decarbonise the world by unleashing the potential of metal-organic frameworks to enable more energy-efficient carbon capture.


Promethean’s patented reactor process allows for the continuous, scalable, and cost-effective manufacture of high-quality products. The company operates reactor systems at various scales, including the largest continuous-flow, multi-nanomaterial manufacturing plant in the world.


Benefits


As a growing scale-up, we believe in offering a competitive total compensation package. Our current benefits include:


Competitive salary

Annual performance-based bonus

Flexible approach to working

Company pension plan

Private medical insurance

Potential for stock options

Group life insurance


Interested?


Apply if you enjoy hands-on manufacturing, care about safety and quality, and want to be part of a team scaling advanced materials with meaningful environmental impact.


Applicants must have the unrestricted right to work in the UK.


Equal Opportunities


Promethean is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

At Hatzfeld we provide residential care for adults with varying needs such as Asperger's, Schizophrenia or eating disorders to age-related illnesses or Dementia. A person-centred care plan is produced tailored to each individual's specific needs.

With residential care services in Nottinghamshire, Lincolnshire and East Yorkshire we have a wide range of different career opportunities available supporting adults with varying levels of need, providing person centred, responsive care.

As a Medication Coordinator you are responsible for the training and empowering staff to follow the procedure set down in the policy for maintaining high standards.

Must live in the UK to apply

Responsibilities For a Medication Coordinator


Ordering of all medications, both acute and the monthly order
Booking in of medication and restocking
Stock control - quantities / dates / stock rotation etc
Storage of medication appropriately and securely
Cleanliness of medication room / cabinets / fridge etc
Key custody
Controlled drugs - security / ordering / safe administration etc
Homely remedies & over the counter medication - responsible for the welfare & education of the residents
Risk assessments as required
Training staff - support staff to have additional training / specialist techniques

Supporting policies / procedures / and daily practices
Adhering to external legislation & reviewing practices
Support and risk assess self-medicators

Support patients going on leave

Understanding PRN's & their usage
Manage medication errors & near misses - Safeguarding issues
Contingency plans in the event of an incident
First Aid boxes - ordering & replenishment
Monitoring resident health needs - sourcing / diarising & liaising with other health professionals
Overseeing new residents - transferring services etc
Death of a resident / legal requirements
Alerting & reporting systems
Reviewing staff competency / procedures etc
Support the Home's management in all aspects of medication
Understand what medication is held within the Home & staff's responsibilities for its safe keeping


Requirements


Reliable and trustworthy
Enthusiastic and motivated to bring positive outcomes and care for our residents
Good communication skills
Ability to work as part of a team
Experience working with people who have mental health conditions and/or dementia desirable

Description:
Job Description

Radiology Assistant/Spire Nottingham/Tollerton/Bank/3 Month Fixed Term Contract

Spire Nottingham, Hospital has an exciting opportunity for a Radiology Assistant to join the team on 3 month fixed term contract.

“Spire Healthcare is a leading independent healthcare group in the United Kingdom, running 38 hospitals and over 50 clinics across England, Wales and Scotland. It provides diagnostics, inpatient, day case and outpatient care, operates a network of private GPs and provides workplace health services to over 800 corporate clients. It also delivers a range of private and NHS mental health, musculoskeletal and dermatological services.”

Our vision is to be recognised as a world class healthcare business bringing together the best people who are dedicated to developing excellent clinical environments and delivering the highest quality patient care.

Duties And Responsibilities

To assist the multi-disciplinary team to provide exemplary patient care and examination, working within set protocols within the diagnostic imaging department.


Undertake routine tasks related to individual’s health and well being.
Assess the health and well being needs of people whose needs are relatively stable and consistent.
Establish and maintain communication with people on routine care matters.
Develop own and others’ personal development.
Monitor and maintain health and safety and security for self and others.
Contribute to the implementation of services.
Help to maintain quality.
Promote people’s equality, diversity and rights.
Collect, collate and report routine and simple data and information
Assist in the application of technology for measurement, monitoring and treatment.
Acknowledge the risk of Healthcare Associated Infections (HCAI) and understand own responsibility as agreed with line manager in the prevention and control of HCAI.
Assisting in maintaining agreed stock levels of consumable items
Preparing and assisting with general and specialised procedures including biopsies
Ensuring a clean and hygienic working environment
Preparing patients for treatment
Being involved in the manual handling of patients
Recognising equipment faults and reporting these immediately
Undertaking basic maintenance of equipment
Develop or gain any other skills that will complement role


Who We're Looking For


Experience in a customer facing role providing high standards of customer care
Working in teams and have the ability to use own initiative.
Working with supervision
Administrative role involving checking and monitoring
Preparing environment and resources for use during clinical activities
Has supported staff in an imaging healthcare environment.
Has supported staff in an independent healthcare environment.
Awareness of standards of patient needs and care
Awareness of Health and Safety and hygiene
English language to IELTS 7.0
Formal training at least at NVQ levels
Possess the mandatory training requirements for role including infection control and health and safety competencies
Possess Equipment and Medical Devices Competences
Trained on MS Office and other relevant packages


Benefits

We offer employed colleagues a competitive salary as well as a comprehensive benefits package which includes but is not limited to:


35 days annual leave inclusive of bank holidays
Employer and employee contributory pension with flexible retirement options
‘Spire for you’ reward platform - discount and cashback for over 1000 retailers
Free Bupa wellness screening
Private medical insurance
Life assurance


Our Values

We are extremely proud of our heritage in private healthcare and of our values as an organisation:


Driving clinical excellence
Doing the right thing
Caring is our passion.
Keeping it simple
Delivering on our promises
Succeeding and celebrating together


We commit to our employees’ well-being through work life balance, on-going development, support and reward.

Spire Healthcare are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture for all. Our people are our difference, it’s their dedication, warmth and pursuit of excellence that sets Spire Healthcare apart.

About the Role We are creating a new role within our Winning Work team to strengthen our Exceptional Experience programme and support our market-facing directors. This role sits at the heart of how we nurture client relationships, develop partnerships, and deliver a consistently excellent client experience across the practice.

This is a focused client care and executive-level support role, designed to introduce dedicated capability that adds long-term value. By providing proactive client intelligence, partnership support, and practical coordination, you will enable our directors to focus their time on high-value, outward-facing activity.

While elements of the role are operational, it is a strategically important position with real influence over how we build, maintain, and strengthen relationships. You will work closely with the wider Winning Work team, supporting directors and senior leaders through insight, structure, and thoughtful coordination.

The Winning Work team is based across Bath, Bristol, and Plymouth. The preferred location for this role is Bath or Bristol, with flexibility to travel to other studios as required. The role is anticipated to be 3-4 days per week (22.5 to 30 hours).

Key Responsibilities

The role is structured around three clear pillars:


Strategic Client Intelligence & Insight Providing timely, relevant insight to support account management and partnership development. Key activities include:
Producing regular client and opportunity reports
Managing monthly LEADS opportunity tracking to support pipeline visibility
Researching clients, business structures, and relevant industry news ahead of meetings and events
Preparing client biographies and company profiles
Researching event attendees to support purposeful engagement
Client Relationship & Partnership Support Enabling consistent, high-quality engagement with clients and key partners. This will involve:
Maintaining accurate client and relationship data in Rapport3 (our CRM system)
Tracking and recording client interactions
Preparing client intelligence briefings for meetings and key engagements
Supporting Key Account Managers with reporting and insight
Ensuring client touchpoints are logged and followed up

Coordinating diaries for directors and the Senior Leadership Team, particularly around Key Account Managers and key client meetings

Preparing and distributing meeting papers, agendas, and follow-up actions

Description:
Birmingham, Bristol, Cardiff, Leeds, Manchester, Nottingham, Swindon

GPA adopt Smarter Working and staff are expected to work flexibly – it will not be necessary to attend an office every day, although business travel to any GPA office may be needed and site visits will be required on a regular basis.

Job Summary

The Government Property Agency is the largest property holder in government, with more than £2.1 billion in property assets and over 55% of the government’s office estate.

We are transforming the way the Civil Service works by creating great places to work, leading the largest commercial office programme in the UK, working towards halving carbon emissions from government offices, and achieving greater value for taxpayers. And we are looking for innovative, solutions-focused people to join our team.

Representing the best covenant in the UK – His Majesty’s Government – we are leading significant transformational programmes such as the Government Hubs Programme, Whitehall Campus Programme and Net Zero Programme. We are also delivering cost- effective property services such as asset management, lifecycle replacement and workplace services.

Innovation And Progress Underpin Our Behaviours. We Foster a Culture Of Lifelong Learning, Where Curiosity And Self-improvement Are Encouraged. Our Four Core Values Are At The Heart Of Everything We Do. They Shape Our Culture And Guide How We Work, Lead And Grow Together:


Striving for excellence- We always aim to deliver great results
Empowering through respect- We insist on fair treatment for all, always
Acting with integrity- We consistently do the right thing
Succeeding together- We rely on each other to achieve success


We are committed to representing the communities we serve by making Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion (EDI) part of everything we do. Our strong emphasis on EDI is not just about driving inclusion across our organisation, it is also about ensuring our services meet the needs of government departments and the civil servants who use our spaces. To ensure that we are always recruiting and retaining a diverse mix of talent, we are particularly inviting applications from candidates who are disabled, ethnically or gender diverse, and people who identify as being part of the LGBTQ+ community.

Join our dynamic and diverse team that leads with purpose, improving sustainability, nurturing social value, driving inclusivity and flexibility, and kickstarting economic growth. We are driven by purpose, and you can be part of it too: where you make a meaningful impact; where you influence; where your voice really matters; where you help to shape our future direction.

Job Description

The Investment Directorate leads on Capital property portfolio investment on behalf of the GPA. The Capital Portfolio Planning & Initiation Lead will create and maintain a portfolio road map and an up to date list of projects and investments to feed into the portfolio prioritisation. They lead on a regular prioritising, and presenting this information for decision making in a clear format highlighting risks and advantages of options. The role completes the Investment directorate steps of the project initiation process, working with Capital Projects directorate. They participate in the Spending Review process as required.

Key Responsibilities

Project Pipeline - Works within the Investment directorate and other business areas to identify and categorise new projects for a decision on inclusion in the portfolio and provide regular updates on the pipeline to the Portfolio Board. Collect information to enable portfolio prioritisation and initiation processes and leads on effective project initiation by collaborating with Capital Projects and GPA front door.

Governance and reporting - Supports a clear governance framework and reporting system aligned with portfolio best practice. Support coordination of reporting from projects/portfolio plans and analyses performance at the portfolio level for review by governance bodies.

Business cases and assurance - Supports and inputs into the production of business cases, ensuring that business case production remains aligned with portfolio planning and wider property considerations.

People and leadership - Communicates and builds commitment to a shared vision and sense of purpose. Supports GPA in portfolio pipeline decision making and leads in their area of expertise.

Planning, scheduling and resourcing - Maintains the portfolio delivery map and critical path to monitor project progress, working with the Capital Projects directorate. Provides input into Spending Review decision making. Identifies and tracks interdependencies across change projects. Recommends the allocation of financial and other resources across initiatives to optimise the organisation’s return on investment. Develops strategies to address resource gaps.

Risk and opportunity management - Identifies and monitors portfolio risks, threats and opportunities, and plans and implements responses to them.

Stakeholder management - Maps stakeholder interest and influences to set priorities for engagement and communication. Communicates regularly and gathers input on issues such as communication methods. Engages in discussions to resolve issues and differences between stakeholders and challenge assumptions.

Benefits management - Works as part of the wider team of experts to support the business in developing data-driven mechanisms for measuring benefits and ensures this is incorporated into the portfolio prioritisation decision making.

Digital and data - Oversees governance and management of the data standard across the portfolio of projects and property. Uses digital tools to analyse data to support allocation of resources efficiently across projects, ensuring optimal use of personnel, budget, and time.

Job Description

The Investment Directorate leads on Capital property portfolio investment on behalf of the GPA. The Capital Portfolio Planning & Initiation Lead will create and maintain a portfolio road map and an up to date list of projects and investments to feed into the portfolio prioritisation. They lead on a regular prioritising, and presenting this information for decision making in a clear format highlighting risks and advantages of options. The role completes the Investment directorate steps of the project initiation process, working with Capital Projects directorate. They participate in the Spending Review process as required.

Key Responsibilities

Project Pipeline - Works within the Investment directorate and other business areas to identify and categorise new projects for a decision on inclusion in the portfolio and provide regular updates on the pipeline to the Portfolio Board. Collect information to enable portfolio prioritisation and initiation processes and leads on effective project initiation by collaborating with Capital Projects and GPA front door.

Governance and reporting - Supports a clear governance framework and reporting system aligned with portfolio best practice. Support coordination of reporting from projects/portfolio plans and analyses performance at the portfolio level for review by governance bodies.

Business cases and assurance - Supports and inputs into the production of business cases, ensuring that business case production remains aligned with portfolio planning and wider property considerations.

People and leadership - Communicates and builds commitment to a shared vision and sense of purpose. Supports GPA in portfolio pipeline decision making and leads in their area of expertise.

Planning, scheduling and resourcing - Maintains the portfolio delivery map and critical path to monitor project progress, working with the Capital Projects directorate. Provides input into Spending Review decision making. Identifies and tracks interdependencies across change projects. Recommends the allocation of financial and other resources across initiatives to optimise the organisation’s return on investment. Develops strategies to address resource gaps.

Risk and opportunity management - Identifies and monitors portfolio risks, threats and opportunities, and plans and implements responses to them.

Stakeholder management - Maps stakeholder interest and influences to set priorities for engagement and communication. Communicates regularly and gathers input on issues such as communication methods. Engages in discussions to resolve issues and differences between stakeholders and challenge assumptions.

Benefits management - Works as part of the wider team of experts to support the business in developing data-driven mechanisms for measuring benefits and ensures this is incorporated into the portfolio prioritisation decision making.

Digital and data - Oversees governance and management of the data standard across the portfolio of projects and property. Uses digital tools to analyse data to support allocation of resources efficiently across projects, ensuring optimal use of personnel, budget, and time.

Person specification

This role will suit an individual with a background in portfolio planning, or in a complex project or portfolio environment. As funding is subject to Spending Reviews, the individual must be comfortable working in an ambiguous environment.

The individual should have some team/matrix management and leadership experience and be able to engage a variety of stakeholders at any level of seniority, and to credibly engage and put across a well supported argument of portfolio priority projects.

They should have a good level of competence in all aspects of portfolio planning and prioritisation as well as a working level of business cases and the associated processes, including multi-criteria decision analysis, estimating/forecasting, investment appraisal and benefits.

Essential Criteria:

  • Experience of working in a complex project environment and understanding of complex project information
  • Experience in portfolio prioritisation against strategic objectives and working with uncertainty
  • Experience in portfolio planning, utilising prioritisation techniques such as multi-criteria decision analysis
  • Working knowledge or experience of business cases and the associated processes, including estimating/forecasting, investment appraisal and benefits.
  • Some experience of team or matrix management
  • Excellent communication and engagement skills

Desirable Criteria:

  • Working in a property or construction environment
